vcib_log_archive.class_identity_note: The Guid attribute is on the assembly. It is not an explicit class CLSID. No class-level ProgId, Guid or ClassInterface attribute is present. The assembly enables COM visibility. Only CreateZip and the constructor are public.

algorithm.directory: Environment.GetFolderPath((SpecialFolder)46) + \GTSPlus\InterfaceBoxLogFile. Value46 is CommonDocuments. No directory creation occurs.
algorithm.selection: mode==1 selects *.DAT and _eventlog. Every other mode selects *.TGZ and _tracelog. Directory.GetFiles uses SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly (0). It preserves enumeration order and includes all matching files.
algorithm.output: directory + \ + String.Format({0:0000}{1:00}{2:00}{3:00}{4:00},year,month,day,hour,minute) + selected suffix + .zip. These fields only name the output. They do not filter files or pass through DateTime validation. Numeric widths are minimum widths.
algorithm.space: Create DriveInfo from Path.GetPathRoot(directory).Substring(0,1). Available space starts at0 and is read only if IsReady. Sum FileInfo.Length with unchecked Int64 add. Sum>available returns2004; equality permits compression.
algorithm.retry: At most3 calls to the actual private Compress method. Return0 stops immediately. Every nonzero result attempts File.Delete(output), including the third failure. A delete exception sets2001 but does not stop the remaining attempts.
algorithm.compress: ZipFile.Open(output,(ZipArchiveMode)2): Update. For each source file, call CreateEntryFromFile(archive,source,Path.GetFileName(source)). The finally disposes a non-null archive. An entry exception returns2001 through that finally. The outer catch also converts open or disposal exceptions to2001.
algorithm.preflight_exceptions: Folder lookup, formatting, directory enumeration, root/DriveInfo construction, readiness/free-space and source-length exceptions are outside CreateZip catch regions. They escape to the COM invocation boundary.
algorithm.publication: The method writes the named archive directly through the framework Update path. A failed attempt can delete an existing same-name archive. It does not delete source files.
algorithm.auxiliary_methods: DEBUG_LOG immediately returns. The constructor only calls System.Object::.ctor.

results.2001: No matching files, compression failure, or caught archive-delete failure. A later successful attempt can replace a prior2001.
results.2004: Summed source lengths exceed available free space.

native_consumer.boundary: Native caller algorithm and COM HRESULT/VARIANT lifetime contract remain separately source-qualified. Do not convert escaped managed exceptions into an assumed native status.

execution.method: Executed the actual decoded CreateZip and Compress IL, including their actual exception tables. Framework filesystem, drive, formatting and ZIP interfaces were inert. No COM activation, Windows application, native DLL, filesystem archive, network, VCI or vehicle operation ran.

publication_contracts.scope: Host call ordering and observable failure prefixes only; no hardware crash durability or cross-file atomicity claim.
current_capture: Initial session creation writes tree, fileInfo, vehicleInfo, cooperation, event, tseName in order, then hashes and assigns buffer path. JSON writes use mode1; event uses mode2 with empty text and does not clear previous bytes. Rejection preserves the completed file prefix.

overwirteVehicleInfo verifies first, then mode1 overwrites selected vehicleInfo.json even after negative verification; only positive verification triggers refresh. Metadata failure/refresh failure does not restore previous vehicleInfo or manifest.
data.json mode0 is existence-check then create/truncate; divided suffix chunks use mode2 append. info.json mode1 can finish independently.
After completion/info rendezvous, addData mutates memory then mode1 overwrites tree.json; next createHashFile deletes old manifest and attempts new one.

Data/info failure can leave a prefix file or orphan directory. Tree failure leaves earlier content plus advanced in-memory tree. Hash failure can leave stale/no manifest while helper resolves; none rolls back prior writes.
current_export: verifyHashFile runs before activity-report copies; copy failures are swallowed. Only positive pre-copy verification permits embedded-manifest delete/create. Negative/error verification retains embedded manifest (or absence).
Root-level check manifest is always delete/create and is outside the ZIP source folder; it hashes mgr.storedBasePath, not necessarily the per-folder target under parallel multi-folder export.

PF ZIP folder compression deletes final archive first and writes the final pathname directly, without temp or rename. Compression failure attempts deleting partial final output; old overwritten archive is not retained.
Failures before compressor entry leave old archive; after destination deletion old archive is lost. Failure during cleanup can leave partial output. Workspace is not cleared by export.
DataSync copy is after successful archive. Its rejection produces result:false although final archive remains. Parallel folder exports are not rolled back; successes may remain when another rejects.
legacy_export: Delete old list.txt, enumerate recursive files, calculate salted hashes, create/truncate Shift-JIS list.txt and dispose writer.
Create ZIP beside source named temp_yyyyMMddmmssfff.zip (minutes, not hours), includeBaseDirectory=false, Shift-JIS entry encoding.
Timestamp temp names are not an exclusive random-name protocol; a preexisting same-name ZIP makes CreateFromDirectory fail rather than safely replace it.
Only after ZIP creation, delete existing destination and File.Move(tempZip,final). Failure before delete preserves old destination; Move failure after delete loses it and leaves completed temp ZIP.

Compression/rename catch returns error with no temp-ZIP cleanup. ZIP creation failure can leave partial temp ZIP; manifest write failure can leave partial list.txt. No atomic replacement or durable flush.
graph_writeback: Both verification-false and request-failure paths still call JSON writer. Writer opens FileMode.Create BEFORE serialization, so even serializer failure can destroy previous data.

Positive verification: data write -> delete embedded manifest -> asynchronous PF CreateHashFile. Delete/create failure does not restore data/old manifest. False verification retains now-stale manifest.
Hash-create success and failure emit identical UI notification. No archive re-publication is performed by these callbacks; they update extracted workspace only.
import: Browser basename splits only backslashes; clear existing workspace -> PF extract to workPath/basename -> enumerate root and choose first folder, ignoring changedFolderPath response.

PF sniffs ZIP/gzip, chooses unused _NNN destination directory, creates it, extracts sequentially. ZIP member paths use GetFullPath(Combine(dest,FullName)) with no explicit containment test; member extraction overwrites=true.
Extraction exception attempts recursive deletion of selected extraction directory; no prior-workspace restoration. Cleanup does not cover paths normalized outside destination.

After successful extraction, hash/JSON/tree/info/cache reconstruction failure only sets isOpenErr/isVerifyErr and resolves flags. Extracted/partially reconstructed workspace and partial maps remain; no catch-time delete.
publication_contracts.flush_and_replace: Owned managed streams are disposed; graph/buffer close notifications are not OS flush barriers. Legacy File.Move follows destructive destination deletion.

Wraps communication text and UTC send time; serializes over local ER_CommunicationLogOutput named pipe via UTF8 BinaryWriter, Flush and WaitForPipeDrain; errors go to InternalLog.

ER_CommunicationLogOutput server reads serialized UTF8 BinaryReader packet, truncates InputString to StringMaxLength, stamps UTC ReceiveTime; mode2 only buffers; other modes mark/enqueue temp output; AddFixed bounds history. Token cancellation terminates listener.
ER_CommunicationLogClear obtains report/save locks, marks retained records TempLog=true, closes temp writer via TempSave(0,true), then deletes com_*.log.
ER_CommunicationLogOutputSetting updates numeric mode; leaving buffered mode2 for mode0 marks history already-temp; other non2 mode enqueues previously unpersisted history.
ER_CommunicationLogTransfer serializes bounded history with GetNextFixed(true), consuming source entries; flushes writer and waits pipe drain before disposal.
Cancellation-aware delay at TempSaveInterval; under save lock writes queued records, and cancellation branch closes/disposes active temp writer.
Writes UTF8 CsvHelper records to identifier_timestamp.log; rotates at TempFileMaxSize and prunes by TempFileMaxCount; flushes batch and optionally disposes writer.
Builds CSV in memory, compresses GZip/Zstd/ZIP per enum, Base64+header then CryptManagerWrapper.EncryptFileCS; rotates/prunes temp logs; all owned streams disposed.
Creates temp directory if absent, otherwise deletes matching identifier_*.log; errors logged.
In mode2 queues previously unpersisted history, then base Save(path,false) flushes/copies plaintext communication temp logs into report staging.
Selects base Save(path,true), requiring encrypted action-log snapshot.
Identifier act and Editor-header-info:ActionLog header identify encrypted action log payload.
Under report lock: captures screens into cap_timestamp_index.jpg, saves error/PC metadata, action log, communication log and InternalLog; screenshot and component errors are caught.

Optionally edits latest error metadata and deletes screenshots; compresses trace folder using configured codec into requested.gtsr; requested staging deletion occurs after compression catch too; Saving reset in finally.
Collects error/action/communication/internal logs into autosave staging then compresses archive; optional staging deletion and finally Saving reset.
Drains queued logs with selected encrypted/plain writer; copies temp files to requested report directory and trims oldest excess snapshots; no files returns-1; copy errors are logged.
Under lock appends; Count>MaxCount removes oldest entry0 and adjusts transfer cursor.
Returns next entry; true removal flag decrements cursor and removes transferred source entry.
Authenticates packaging DLL, resolves packaged passphrase path and key-type policy, then calls native DoFileEncryptionCS; no account credential involved.
Copies ABSystem limits/paths into collector settings; compression codec/level come from DistributorDepending ErrorReport settings.
Public/CommonDocuments subfolders: GTSPlus/ErrorReport/{ActLog,ComLog,Trace,TraceAutoSave,Unsend,Send}; upload GTSPlus/DataSync/Logs/GTS-E02; report extension.gtsr.
AB_ErrorReportSave event gates queued trace/save/complete messages; snapshots retained to Trace then packaged to Unsend/timestamp.gtsr; send flag optionally stages package.

If upload file already exists return without re-staging. Copy archive to Send or configured autosaveSend, then move original to Public/Documents/GTSPlus/DataSync/Logs/GTS-E02; errors logged, no network send here.
ER_ErrorReportSave server reads request, queues data and signals AB_ErrorReportSave.
ER_ErrorReportAutoSave server resolves configured AutoSaveUnsend destination and runs AutoSaveErrorReport.
ER_ErrorReportSaveComplete queues completion marker and signals report-save event.
Loads TemplateFileName, ValidExtensions, BinarySkipDataNames from appSettings.

Serializes UTF8 err_timestamp.log with system/app/vehicle/error metadata; applies bounded trace retention, copies configured include files and selected one-file samples; individual copy errors logged.
Clear marks retained history TempLog=true rather than erasing bounded list, preventing replay into temp output.
Deletes previous act_*.log, starts setting pipe, encrypted-save wait task, and action-input listener; does not start1000ms plain CSV timer.
ER_ActionLogOutput reads serialized action log, bounds/truncates input and history; queued estimated CSV size reaching TempFileMaxSize signals ER_TempSaveEncrypt_act and resets size counter.
Waits named ER_TempSaveEncrypt_<identifier> event, then under lock encrypts queued records; cancellation check before write exits without final queue drain.
Signals encrypted-save wait event, waits all tasks. Following shared cancellation, wait exits before encryption; low-volume unsnapshotted queue has no final-save guarantee.
TaskFactory.StartNew runs encrypted-save wait callback; catches/logs task startup failure.
Delegates directly to TempSaveEncryptWait.
Receives only when invoked by request-response helper; uses CancellationToken.None; returns accumulated UTF8 text; no unsolicited GUI-relay dispatcher.
Reads one socket message and deserializes response; does not inspect GuiRelayMsg/RelayData.CommandId or correlate inner cancellation command.

Sends requested command and reads response into its provided RE handler, then ends; no persistent background receive subscription. A queued unsolicited GUI relay can be consumed as a response, but cannot cancel conversion.
Conversion may send translation requests through same request-response helper; this is another possible unsolicited-relay read point, not a command99 receiver.
Translation response handler returns ApiArgs; contains no relay/cancellation branch.
Awaits parser task without cancellation token; caught failures delete destination, not cancellation acknowledgement.

Parses outer request; wraps original Data string unchanged as GuiRelayMsg.Data and API id, routes named peer sessions, replies send result. Inner JSON command99 is not parsed and does not kill process or cancel task.
Wraps session/SSL/message unchanged and invokes WebSocketWrapper.SendAsync; no inner relay-command processing.
Routes target name match excluding sender session and GTSPlusLicense; no commandId predicate.

mode0 checks File.Exists then uses append=false; mode1 uses append=false; mode2 uses append=true. Creates parent directory; StreamWriter(path,append,UTF8Encoding(false)), Write, finally Dispose. No temp, rename, File.Replace or explicit durable flush. Existence check is not CreateNew.

Rejects an existing manifest; recursively inventories and hashes files before opening output. .cpt encrypts UTF8 manifest, then FileStream(FileMode.Create,FileAccess.Write) writes IV+ciphertext and disposes; plaintext uses WriteAllText UTF8 without BOM. Write exceptions attempt File.Delete; no temp publication or rollback of caller's earlier delete.

Reads .cpt IV+ciphertext or UTF8 lines, parses Target File/Target Folder paths with Path.Combine, recursively enumerates actual files excluding manifest, reports changed=0/missing=1/extra=2; VerificationResult=true only when difference list empty. Hashing is read-only, not a write barrier.

Expands requested paths, rejects missing input or file-valued output; sniffs gzip/ZIP bytes, chooses unused destination suffix _001 etc when directory exists, creates destination then extracts. Extraction exception attempts recursive deletion of chosen destination, not restoration of prior workspace; cleanup exception can escape. Later JS verification/JSON errors have no extraction cleanup.

Converts level, deletes destination if present, then CreateFromDirectory(source,destination,level,false). ZIP root excludes source directory. Final path is written directly; prior archive is lost before compression succeeds.

For each ZIP entry: GetFullPath(Path.Combine(destination,entry.FullName)); create parent; nonempty entry.Name -> ExtractToFile(entry,path,true). No StartsWith/relative-root containment check occurs in this wrapper. Earlier extracted files remain until PF catch attempts deleting chosen destination; files resolved outside it are not covered by that cleanup.

Delete old manifest -> inventory/hash -> write list.txt -> compressionDir -> changeExtZipToGTSE; phase catches return negative status and contain no temp ZIP cleanup. Final destination is touched only after ZIP creation succeeds.
File.Exists then File.Delete. Legacy changeExtZipToGTSE deletes final destination before File.Move(tempZip,final); not File.Replace and not rollback-safe.

Mode 1 selects DAT/eventlog; other values select TGZ/tracelog. Date fields only name the archive. Empty selection returns 2001; source sum greater than free space returns 2004. Up to three compression attempts delete the archive after each nonzero result. Preflight exceptions escape.
Open archive in Update mode 2. Add source basenames in enumeration order. Finally dispose a non-null archive. Entry, open and disposal exceptions return 2001.
Immediate RET with no side effects.
Only calls System.Object constructor.
Both hash-create success and failure send the same UI message WM_USER/22/15; callback notification does not certify a matching regenerated manifest.
Both hash-create success and failure send the same UI message WM_USER/22/15; callback notification does not certify a matching regenerated manifest.

All884 materialized method bodies inspected. No RelayData.CommandId/GuiRelayMsg read, relay-event subscription, or conversion-task cancellation-token edge. Only Websocket.dll has cancellation calls, for connection deadline; actual send/receive use CancellationToken.None. Request-response reads also occur for translation during conversion; unsolicited99 may remain unread or be consumed as an ordinary response, never dispatched as task cancellation.

CDAExecGetDatMonValue validates ECU buffer and pointer+packet width; missing ring returns0xc0270002, missing ECU buffer0xc0270005; reads each packet via CRingBufferBase::ReadBuffer and aborts on first error.
CDAExecCreateDrsFile allocates CDatMonBuffer per monitor entry, delegates CCommCtrlMain::CommandExecute, reports command status, destructs/frees every allocated buffer.
SettingFileName reads common productFolder via settings DLL, joins Public/CommonDocuments/DataLogger/latestDrsFile and timestamped.drs/.drsp; settings-load/parse failures return explicit errors.
CDrTempFile destructor with valid handle seeks offset0, writes8-byte header on successful seek, then CloseHandle; it does not delete temp file.
CFileWriter::WriteEnd backpatches table length(end-start-4), restores end position; not an OS durability FlushFileBuffers.
NI MdfInterop initializes COM, parses RegServer/UnregServer/per-user commands, enters COM server; this is installer-distribution support, not evidenced vehicle MDF output.

Managed CalculateFileHashDevide wraps native export: CreateFileW(GENERIC_READ,FILE_SHARE_READ,OPEN_EXISTING,FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL), 1MiB ReadFile loop, CloseHandle, append fixed20-byte salt to SHA256. Native tests handle against zero rather than INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, and ignores ReadFile BOOL, using only bytesRead; a failed zero-byte read can therefore finalize a prefix hash. No native writer/flush/rename participates in manifest publication.
Creates VIN-scoped working tree and timestamped session with vehicle/file/cooperation/event/name metadata, then hash and buffer path assignment.
Open first clears working data, extracts archive, verifies hashes, reads tree/info and reconstructs caches; separates open and verification errors.

Exports working JSON tree using native archive API, copies activity report, refreshes hashes, creates requested saved file, then copies archive to DataSync staging when configured. Export does not clear workspace.
Prior-workspace recovery can skip export and clear, or export then ignore resolved failure before clearing; wildcard deletion is not gated by successful archive preservation.

File save validates extension/path length/duplicate, allows overwrite refusal and retry/cancel. Inner save failure Try Again re-enters save; outer chain normalizes a resolved FAILED to SUCCESS, so caller completion alone is not proof of a saved file.

Buffer worker writes full/chunked data.json with separate ACK/completion. Whole/final ACK-enabled write finally settles worker deferred, but rejected nonfinal chunk leaves it pending and close stalls.
Caller waits saveFinish plus info.json before adding tree node and refreshing hashes. Close call itself only posts a command and resolves, not a synchronous disk flush.
DataList sorts/deduplicates timestamps, retains 2.8-hour rolling window; save all/last/flag-window or configured pre/post-trigger slice normalizes recordTime and sequence numbers.
DRS-derived monitor data and metadata use session JSON layout; flush hashes then archives, choosing current hash.cpt policy after2025.

Native monitor/active-test CSV exporter receives parameter.json, app6; UI polls JSON absence or connection disappearance for completion and sends command99 on cancel. Web formats export separately; completion is not a per-output success proof.
Compare app5 receives selected and comparison paths separated by |; monitor worker and periodic connection-name check own UI disable/reenable lifecycle; launch failure stops monitor.
Offline execution of authenticated constants gives current extension.gtse, format0.0.1, JSON member names and list.cpt current/list.txt legacy hash manifests.
Ordinary Graph Viewer app2 gets selected stored-data relative path; monitor exists before launch and is stopped if launch rejects.

Acquisition joins recorder/header logs->CreateVdasFile->delete logs->optional CSV. VDAS create failure is caught/resolved, so log deletion still runs; interruption sets flag, cancels command, removes logs and attempted VDAS/CSV outputs, then polls200ms for producer completion. PCS app3 receives complete VDAS path; folder launcher app1 receives saved folder.

Nonfinal divided-write rejection before ACK posts Failed and resolves only local return; appended deferred remains pending so savingProm and cmdClose never settle. Final ACK-enabled write finalizer instead resolves deferred even on error.
Per-key completion handler is installed only by saveAck. Failed completion without ACK has no callback and is dropped; caller defSave remains pending, even if whole-save worker deferred settles.
Live Datalist saveAll/saveLast/saveFlag/saveType1 paths invoke divided saving; pre-ACK chunk stall is reachable from normal recording save.

Recovery clears for verified root manifest or missing folder list, after skipped ineligible-version export, and after eligible export resolves result:false from caught failure. Returned export result is not tested; wildcard deletion is not gated by preserved archive.

Shipped action10000/communication3000 entry bounds; configured1000ms interval is used by communication writer, action is size/event-driven;10MiB and5file rotation; trace history4. No user log contents are read.

gtse_compression.manifest: list.txt encoded Shift-JIS with Target Folder header
gtse_compression.archive: ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory with Shift-JIS entry encoding, then File.Move .zip to .GTSE

ring.record_width: Binary records contain a 4-byte little-endian UInt32 timestamp and sum(frame byte lengths) data bytes. The parser processes 8 + 2 * sum(frame byte lengths) hexadecimal characters.
ring.unsigned_decode: UInt64 parse, bit-mask, then right shift

csv_export.flow: decompress VDAS -> read UTF-8 json.log -> MakeImgOpeDdrCsvData -> append native hash text -> write UTF-8 CSV

recorder_image_parameter_tables.row_semantics: Values are exact ordered source constructor arguments, not assumed field values; row schemas preserve constructor and typed parameter order. Nested list entries remain nested in source order. Resource keys are symbols, not translated text. Constructor/getter policy stays in named image contracts.

language.name: typed-expression-control-flow-v1
language.coordinates: All offsets are hexadecimal-byte-compatible integer offsets relative to first IL opcode (not PE file). Each method body framing/hash is exact complete raw body including header/EH. Block keys and effect offsets locate source instructions. Program IDs are exact body SHA256;identical-body sharing does not merge MethodDef identities.
language.execution_model: Blocks bind p0..pN from edge arguments;locals l0.. carry method-frame state across edges;temporary r<offset hex> assigned by ordered effects. a0 is this for instance methods,else first argument;remaining arguments follow exact interface. &l/&a are addressable slots,not copied values. All local/argument reads snapshot a value at their source offset. Typed locals and init_locals in method metadata define initial state. New object/new_array creates actual specified managed type;No mocking or output synthesis is implied.
language.effect: [sourceOffset,destination,expression];destination null means evaluate for side effects,not discard invocation. String literals are {string:...};bare strings are register/local/argument references except named operands/types/methods. field/static/array/dereference destinations mutate those exact storage locations. Casts/boxing/array operations retain their CLR operation name and declared widths. Call identifiers include source MethodDef or external MemberRef token;interfaces are call_interfaces;substitute generic !i from owner type arguments and !!i from generic_arguments.
language.arithmetic: Type-directed CLR arithmetic. Integer +/-/* wraps at stack width where source has no checked opcode;shifts mask count31 for32bit,63 for64bit. /trunc and %trunc mean CLR div/rem:integer quotient truncates towardzero and remainder follows dividend;floating operands use floating division/remainder,not truncation. Signed/unsigned comparison labels mean CIL comparison convention;onfloating .un also includes unordered NaN. Numeric_cast matches stated CLR conversion width/signedness;explicit Decimal methods retain their own conversion/overflow rules. Math and System.Convert calls use their exact typed framework overload.
language.exits: return(value);if(predicate,branchWhenTrue,targetEdge,fallthroughEdge) uses CLR zero/null/false test. switch indexes listed case edges,otherwise default;negative/outofrange default. br/goto transfers edge arguments. leave empties evaluationstack and executes applicable finally blocks before transferring. throw raises supplied exception.
language.exceptions: handlers preserve exact half-open try/handler ranges and metadata catch type. exception_type0=catch,1=filter,2=finally,4=fault. Any instruction effect may raise CLR/framework/callee exceptions;dispatch by ordered/nested CLR EH semantics,not invented nearestcatch. Catch/filter enters with exception p0;finally/fault empty. end_finally resumes exceptional unwinding or pending leave continuation. Calls outside matching handlers propagate;partially-mutated state is not rolled back.
language.parameterized_fields: field-read returns receiver field;field-write assigns exact value,returns void. Static variants analogous. No validation,normalization,copy,notification or events unless program present.

recorder_contracts.interpretation: Interpreted current-source business behavior; static source/body qualification is not application, vehicle or transport execution. Managed template TSE, native DatMon and native DRS remain distinct formats.

ordered_semantics: Initialize out path/json null and error/warning StringBuilders. Compute temp by string concatenation GetTempPath()+"vdas"+"PcsDataViewerTemp" (normally %TEMP%\vdasPcsDataViewerTemp). Recursively delete existing directory BEFORE validating new input. Register temp for process-exit removal.

Ionic.Zip.ZipFile.Read(path); ExtractExistingFile=1; ExtractAll(temp). Only AFTER extraction reject Entries.Count>1 with ERROR_003. Select Entries.First() and OpenRead(temp+"\"+entry.FileName). Empty ZIP is not explicitly rejected by count check: First fails.

Construct DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(VdasEntity)). Create unused Char[checked(nativeint stream.Length)]. StreamReader(stream,Encoding.GetEncoding(1252)) reads all; StreamReader disposal also closes stream. Reencode resulting text as UTF8 bytes, MemoryStream, ReadObject cast VdasEntity. Serializer exception replaced with new Exception(ERROR_003); first-entry/path/ZIP errors outside that catch retain original message. ZIP/file stream disposed in finally; MemoryStream not explicitly disposed. DataMember attributes have no Name override (01000000 blob), so exact viewer JSON members are lower-case declared property names: root gts, nested formatversion/version,carinfo,cmninfo,ddr,pcsffd,pcsimg,pvmimg,lcsffd,adsffd,adseng,adsimg,tss3ffd,rcimg,dmcimg,absolutetime,aduddr,aduffd; primitive data. No caller reads formatversion/version during admission; version001 is producer metadata,not a viewer equality gate.

SaveEachCommLogData2TmpFile builds ordered temp log binding dictionary. Unconditionally dereferences required carinfo/ecuinformation/pcsffd/ddr/absolutetime. Optional ADU ECU identity starts empty and overwrites when present; other optional feature entries added only when nonnull. For each entry File.OpenWrite(temp+key), StreamWriter.Write(value), dispose, THEN validate rewritten file.

CommLogFileChecker opens ASCII reader and accepts only A..F,a..f,0..9,LF,CR, otherwise throws Exception("Unexpected charactor"). This is not general CSV/JSON admission or whitespace-tolerant hex. File exists even when later validation rejects it.

OnExtractVdasFile commits controller fields on true and returns default Result(success=true); on false returns Result.Success=false with error builder text. Process-exit singleton enumerates all registered directories, recursively Delete(dir,true), swallows each deletion exception, disposes enumerator.
errors_cleanup: Extract catches WarningException: append Message+CRLF to warning builder and still return true. General Exception: append to error builder; if Message.IndexOf("IOException")>0 delete temp, then return false. The cleanup condition is message substring, not exception type; DeleteTempFolder may itself throw wrapped Exception(Message). No rollback of partial extraction/log writes or previous deleted workspace.
observed_quirks: >1 member rejection is post-extraction; zero-entry rejection is indirect. Existing report assertion of pre-admission exactly-one ZIP is too strong.

Fixed shared temp directory causes all loads in this process to reuse same root; no per-file random workspace. File.OpenWrite does not truncate pre-existing longer bytes. Singleton registration is not synchronized or deduplicated.

outputs.models: BasicInfo,MemoryInfo,DDR/ABG/ADU/ADS lists,OperationFFD and each image/error list
outputs.result: default successful Result, or ordinary DDRExtractor.Extract Result if invoked; all-empty forcibly sets Success=false; nonempty does not reset an earlier false Result

ordered_semantics: CreateCarInfo resets BasicInfo and both message builders, then parses Airbag part/software, ADU part/software, Odo, KeyCycle temp logs. Copies VIN, profile.DealerCode, profile.IncomingDate from JSON. ADU missing decoded part/software uses " -". WarningException/general Exception appended to warning/error builder respectively; returns partially assigned BasicInfo.

Create AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer and CreateAbsTimeTable(AbsoluteTime.log). Allocate all result lists. If JSON.ddr exists first try ABGDDRExtractor.Extract(VCH.log,temp,absTime,out ABGList,errors,warnings), cast results to ABG; ONLY when ABG count==0 run ordinary DDRExtractor.Extract(VCH.log,out MemoryInfo,...). ADUDDR if present always separate; initialize ADUOpeFFD shared tables next. JSON.adsffd is ADSDDR input, not ADS operation.

If region is JP,CN,OT skip ALL operation-FFD parsing block. Else: ADUOpeFFD.Extract(AduOpeFFD.log) then if nonempty set static OperationFFDSystemType="TSS4"; PcsFFDAnalyzer.Extract(PcsOpeFFD.log,system0); LCS uses system1; TSS3 uses system3, all share operation list. JSON.adseng drives ADSOpeFFD.Extract(AdsOpeFFD.log).

Images are independent of region operation skip: JSON.pcsimg first ADUImageFFDExtractor.ExtractFCM; only if BOTH returned good/error lists empty use legacy ImageFFDExtractor.Extract. Identical ADUPVM-first then legacy PVM fallback; ADS and RC use own wrappers; DMC ADU-first then legacy DMC fallback. Nonempty error-only ADU result suppresses legacy fallback.

Per-family try catches append warning/error text and continue to later families. WarningExceptions go to warnings for ordinary DDR, PCS/LCS/TSS3/ADS operation and legacy FCM/PVM; other per-family exceptions to errors. Core abs-time setup/static initialization and ADU-first image calls follow exact EH ranges in evidence rather than universal catch-all assumption.

Commit all model lists and messages near end. Result.ErrorMessage is warning-builder string, while controller.RtnMsg stores errors. All lists empty (including image error lists) force Success=false; nonempty does not force true, so an earlier ordinary-DDR failed Result can remain failed while another family succeeds. BasicInfo outer catch returns failure early if CreateCarInfo unexpectedly escapes.
errors_cleanup: No acquisition or device command is sent by this load pipeline. Family exceptions do not undo earlier model/file mutations; casts and setup outside family handlers can escape.

ordered_semantics: Airbag part: scan lines in order. A leading 1A81 request sets flag (outer line-length gate only>=2, but Substring(2,2) requires4). First subsequent length12 response prefix5A decodes remaining10hex chars. Alternatively exact length30 prefix620105 decodes from6. Prefix62F191 when length>=34 decodes Substring(12,24), requiring36 despite gate. First accepted result breaks; EOF yields empty.

Software: first length38 prefix5A8801 decodes from6. Prefix62F181 with len>=8 reads count hex at6; only len>=40 then count0 stops empty else decodes8..39. Prefix62F188 len>=44 reads count at8, count0 stops empty else decodes12..43.

ChangeASCII: odd-length input returns empty. Parse every hex byte; only inclusive0x20..0x5A becomes character, all other bytes become ASCII space (not general ASCII or lowercase). Malformed hex throws.

Odometer first matching line wins: 62A003 len>=14 uses UInt32.Parse(Substring(6,8),NumberStyles0x203)/10, format F1+km; 620103 len>=14 unit=Substring(6,2),value=hex Substring(8,6), unit01 km,02 mile,other unknown; 6128 len>=10 value=hex Substring(4,6)+km; unmatched EOF empty.

Trip: 62A800 len>=20 payload Substring(6,14), output payload[0:4]+"_"+payload[4:12] (last byte discarded). 61E1 len>=20 payload=Substring(8,12), output first4+"_"+hex2(payloadByteAt4 &0x1F)+payload[6:12]. Lowercase hexadecimal from Convert.ToString can be retained.

CSVFileCreator.Create(path,BasicInfo) uses StreamWriter(path,false,Encoding.UTF8), concatenates resource CarInfoBaseValue+CommonInfoBaseValue and naive Replace for dummy_vin/airbag_hinban/airbag_software/adu_hinban/adu_software/tripcount/odometer/dealer_code/incoming_date. Tripcount if nonempty uses first4chars parsed hex->decimal. Calls writer.Write(template,Encoding.UTF8) (overload receives encoding as format arg); closes and disposes. No field quoting/escaping added here.
errors_cleanup: Readers disposed in finally. Short substrings and invalid hex propagate to CreateCarInfo warning/error handling. CSV constructor opens/truncates before all template replacements can fail.
observed_quirks: Part gates 1A81 and62F191 under-check lengths; preserve app exceptions rather than add bounds.
Odo physical conversion does not use independent OdoUnit JSON field.

ordered_semantics: If input.Length==14 use input unchanged; otherwise prepend"20". TryParseExact yyyyMMddHHmmss,CurrentCulture,DateTimeStyles0. Failure returns false leaving output empty.
Ordinary ConvertTimeZone additionally parses original input.Substring((Length==4||Length==14)?2:0,2) decimal and rejects>38. ConvertTimeZoneOver2038 omits this fragment gate.

ConvertToLocalTimeZone returns parsed DateTime+TimeZoneInfo.Local.BaseUtcOffset. It does NOT perform DST-aware timezone conversion. Selector1 returns Year.ToString(D4), selectors2..6 corresponding component D2, other returns yyyyMMddHHmmss; then true.
errors_cleanup: Null/too-short input or component parse failure throws, not converted to false. DateTime overflow/local settings are runtime inputs.

ordered_semantics: MakeOutputFolder recursively deletes existing output directory BEFORE creating new one. Delete failure throws IOException(ERROR_001 formatted path); create failure IOException(ERROR_002). No replace-on-success or rollback.

OnOutputCsv creates CarAndCommonInfo.csv first; if ordinary DDR count>0 run DDRExtractor.Output and retain its Result and extra warning builder; otherwise ABGDDR.Output.
