managed.typed_inputs_results: Result default/boolean constructors and static IsSuccess(string,bool)/IsFailed(string,Exception,bool) return PCSDataViewer.Result. Complete typed signatures in viewer evidence, MethodDefs06000CFD..06000D08.
rules: Default constructor sets Success=true, ErrorMessage=String.Empty, leaves Exception=null. Three-argument constructor stores supplied Success/ErrorMessage/Exception unchanged.
HasError returns !Success. A successful Result can carry nonempty warning/error text; HasError is not a text or exception predicate.

IsSuccess(message,normalize) optionally InsertNewLineAtMessageEnd, then new Result(true,message,null). IsFailed(message,exception,normalize) similarly new Result(false,message,exception). No automatic status inference from message.

InsertNewLineAtMessageEnd first message.TrimEnd(char[]{CR,LF}); then if not IsNullOrEmpty append Environment.NewLine. Null throws at TrimEnd before IsNullOrEmpty, whitespace other than CR/LF remains. Default newline is host environment input, not hardcoded for offline parser.
IMainForm/IViewBase emptyinterfaces; IView<T> abstracttyped Controllerget/set MethodDefs RVA0, no executablebody bymetadata.

FFDTriggerMap.TriggerName(emptystring)=>Resources.TRIGGER_NAME_PCS; else exactdictlookupwithoutnormalizing suffix,missing=>Format({0}[{1}],TRIGGER_NAME_EMPTY,input). Full27entryresource-symbol dictionary pinnedbelow;case-sensitive defaultString equality;nullinput failsContainsKey.

ImageFFDTriggerMap.TriggerName/TriggerNameJpegImage append_0 iff no underscore anywhere,thenlookupdistinctsource dictionaries;unknown=>localizedunknown[normalizedid]. No generalizedPCS/TSS3mapmerge. Source-liftedmapsbelow;nullstringthrowsIndexOf.

SelectedFFDData ctor delegates SelectedVdasData base constructor unchanged Grid+row parameters;get_SetNo resolves COLUMN_SET_NO_KEY by TabName through HeaderColumn.ColumnIndex then heldDataGridView[column,CurrentRow].Value.ToString(),no parse/validation/copy.

CommLogFileChecker.Check opensStreamReaderASCII and iteratesReaduntil<0,validcharonly inclusiveA..F,a..f,0..9,LF,CR;invalidthrowsException(Unexpected charactor);finallyDispose. Emptyfileaccepted. .ctorObjectonly. OtherinputencodingBOM autodecode governedStreamReaderASCII constructor and BOM detection.

managed.title: Hex, bit and decimal arithmetic
rules: ConvertStringToByteList(string)->List<byte>: drop the last character if input length is odd, then parse consecutive two-character substrings using NumberStyles=0x203. Null and invalid hex exceptions propagate.

GetValueForBitPosition(string h,int startBit,int bitLength)->Int64: Convert.ToInt64(h,16), convert to base2 and PadLeft(4*h.Length,0), then parse Substring(7-startBit,bitLength) as base2. The numbering is MSB-first within the first byte; this is NOT a little-endian integer shift.

GetValueForByteUnit(string h,int startCharacterIndex,int bitLength)->string: return empty when bitLength%8!=0; otherwise Substring(startCharacterIndex,2*(bitLength/8)). Caller getter already converts a one-based byte table position to a zero-based character index.

CalculateDifferenceOfDecimalValue(double a,double b)->double: count characters after the first dot in each Double.ToString(CurrentCulture), choose maximum n, scale=decimal(10^n), return double((decimal(a)*scale-decimal(b)*scale)/scale). Source does not set invariant culture or handle scientific notation specially.

managed.title: Spec-indexed dictionaries and source-qualified data
rules: All lifted_static_fields preserve source field names, constructor argument order and dictionary/list/array order, including localized Resources getter expressions. No TSS3 table substitutes any image family. Row constructor interface names are recorded in constructor_schemas; source_pins bind every cctor and Row constructor.

Lazy Instance getter creates singleton when null, without locking. Initialize(specNo) replaces subordinate table objects in source order. Base ctor stores its passed table index; subordinate constructors look up DataTableIndexList[specNo]. PKSB/DMC explicitly reject unsupported spec with failed Result before mutations; ADS returns false; PVM Initialize has no admission check/catch and its dictionary errors propagate. None catches later constructor exceptions, so partial earlier replacements remain if a later constructor throws.

PVM and PKSB supported spec=02; DMC=01,02; ADS=01. DMC shares most tables between specs but RoB table index differs: spec01 pre/post=30/6 sec; spec02=6/2 sec for RoB2820. PVM RoB2820/2850/2851/2852 direction map is source data, not inferred camera ordering.

Header table row (dataID,dataName,startBytePosition,startBitPosition,dataBitLength,lsb,offset,dataType,invalidValue). GetStartBytePositionIndex returns (startBytePosition-1)*2. DID min lengths stored in bytes, returned as hex-character counts by multiplication by2. Lookups select First predicate match in active spec row array, never collapse duplicates.

PVM/PKSB/DMC guarded table selectors catch Exception and return typed sentinels: strings empty (directory getter falls back to original RoB), ints -1, doubles -1. ADS selectors use First/get_Item without these catch fallbacks. GetAllDataName/GetAllDataID project ordered rows. PVM split DID reflection orders by FieldInfo.Name before reading values.

Image rows: PVM160x120, PKSB160x120, DMC160x100, ADS160x98; all indexed8bpp, key0xAA, filename {0:D3}.bmp. PKSB canonical image6018 min19200 bytes, splits6019..601F; DMC canonical6001 min16000, splits6002..6007; ADS6001 min15680. PVM direction first split IDs Front6002,Back6019,Right6047,Left6030.
ADS read-info row contains length4 bytes and area count5; IsValidReadInfo compares full hex line length>=8 and count byte at characters6..7<=5.

managed.title: Grayscale image decoding and the actual encryption transform
rules: For every encrypted input byte x, output reverse_bits8(x) XOR0xAA. This is independent byte permutation/XOR, not AES, compression, JPEG, or a chained cipher. Encryption flag is exact string01.
PVM Create(hex,bool)->Bitmap normalizes to exactly width*height*2 hex characters: truncate surplus or append character5 (byte0x55 filler). No catch; parsing/bitmap/marshal failures propagate.

PKSB/DMC Create(hex,bool,out Bitmap)->Result normalizes to canonical DID min length, then converts bytes and optionally decrypts. Bitmap/all parsing operations inside catch(Exception) return INFO_*_003 failed Result with output null. Normalization outside that catch can throw.
ADS Create(hex,encryptionString)->Bitmap does not normalize internally: ADS DIDData has already padded/truncated canonical6001. All failures propagate.

Each creates Bitmap(width,height,PixelFormat=0x30803 Format8bppIndexed), sets all256 palette entries ARGB(255,i,i,i), LockBits full rectangle WriteOnly, Marshal.Copy all byte-list bytes to Scan0, UnlockBits then returns. There is no try/finally around LockBits, no stride adjustment, and no explicit disposal of a partially created bitmap on error. Decryption list enumerator is disposed in finally.
PVM root spec01 Decrypt parses uppercase nibbles manually (0..9 subtract48, everything else subtract55), then same bit reversal/XOR; invalid/lowercase input is not validated by this method.

managed.title: Legacy EB33 framing and nonfatal DID warnings
rules: Hex logs are case-sensitive StartsWith matches, not transport execution. GetRoBCode requires>=8 chars and returns chars[4:8]; frame field requires>=16 and returns chars[8:16]. PKSB/DMC additionally test every frame character with Uri.IsHexDigit before constructing FrameNumberData; malformed frames become failed Result and skipped by split scanner.

PKSB/DMC payload begins at character16 with a two-character DID count, then each record has4-char DID, length field8 chars when DID StartsWith6 else2 chars, parsed byte length doubled to hex chars. Iterate at most count records, break on missing header/data or zero data length; append source-qualified INFO warnings, preserve parsed prefix, ignore surplus after count. Dictionary.Add means duplicate IDs throw, not overwrite.

PVM payload begins at character18, ignoring count at16..17. Parse until fewer than4 chars remain, with the same variable-width length rule. Non-image DIDs enter dictionary; each DID beginning6 replaces a separate FFImage string, so last image DID within one line wins. Malformed length/data appends INFO_PVMIMG_009 then stops, while GetDIDDataList returns Success with warning text.

Truncate methods construct a new dictionary: retain source-recognized split image DIDs unchanged for PKSB/DMC; recognized non-image DIDs must meet min hex length then are truncated to min, too-short values warn and drop, unknown IDs drop silently. PVM FFImage is stored outside this truncation. Missing required DID/name methods compare against active ordered table rows, not an arbitrary input census.

Short RoB/frame/DID logs become family failed Result with output initialized empty/null. Scanner appends ErrorMessage and skips HasError cases. Numeric parse and duplicate dictionary failures outside explicit handlers propagate. All dictionary/list enumerators use finally Dispose.

managed.title: PKSB/DMC entrypoint admission and result lifecycle
rules: Extract(logPath,AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer,ref List<ImageFFDExtractData>,ref List<ErrorImageFFDExtractData>)->warning string; caller lists must already exist. Scan one StreamReader forward for spec reply PKSB621103 or DMC621403, extract chars6..7, set static SpecNo, Initialize tables; then continue forward for encryption reply PKSB622031 or DMC622004; never rewind.

Encryption parser requires>=8 chars; PKSB uses chars6..7==01. DMC622004 uses that first flag alone when line length<10, otherwise OR with chars8..9==01. Failure Results are promoted to Exception(ErrorMessage). Missing reply reaches EOF and triggers ERROR_*_001; there is no resetting previously initialized static tables when a new file lacks spec.

Continue for EB21 or EB31: EB21 is explicitly unsupported and throws ERROR_*_003; EB31 dispatches split scanner; no marker throws ERROR_*_002. Convert every normal parameter to root ImageFFDExtractData and every error bucket to ErrorImageFFDExtractData; image-type enum2 PKSB,3 DMC. Both output lists empty=>ERROR_*_003. Existing nonempty caller lists affect this final test.

StreamReader disposed in finally even on errors. Extract does not catch its own exceptions. It is offline file interpretation; contains no diagnostic request submission, cancellation token, transport retry or ECU cleanup.

managed.title: PKSB/DMC consecutive split grouping and assembly
rules: Frame string halves A=hex[0:4],B=hex[4:8]. If A==0000 use n=hex(B), TimeSeriesNo=-1; otherwise n=hex(A), TimeSeriesNo=hex(B). Decimal formulas: SetNo=ceil((n%512)/10), TriggerNo=((n%512-1)%10)+1, SplitNo=floor(n/512). .NET decimal remainder sign retained. TriggerType3 if TimeSeriesNo>-1, else2 if TriggerNo>1 else1.

Split scanner maintains FirstFrameNumberData(RoB,frame), accepted log list, expectedSplit=1. Group equality requires same RoB,SetNo,TriggerNo,TimeSeriesNo, but not SplitNo. Ignore EB33 length8. Read frame/RoB failures warn and skip. On group change, flush accepted old group, else warn missing group when previous state exists, clear list, create new group, reset expectedSplit.

Accept only EB33 whose SplitNo==expectedSplit and increment; out-of-sequence frames are not repaired/reordered. Non-EB33 lines ordinarily ignored; a final non-EB33 line enters boundary processing and flushes prior group. Final EB33 additionally flushes its accepted group immediately. Empty pending group warning reconstructs first frame by subtracting512*(SplitNo-1) from active half.

CreateDIDDataInfoWithCombinedImages scans each accepted line, appends warnings, stops on HasError or when no known split image DID is found. Uses first matching split DID in family split-ID list. First nonempty parsed dictionary becomes metadata copy minus that first split key; append that split payload from every accepted line. If no metadata dictionary =>failed Result; otherwise concatenate image under canonical6018(PKSB)/6001(DMC) when length>0 and return Success even after a later early break.

AddImageFFDExtractDataParameter initializes family HeaderData from combined dictionary, appends all warnings, calls AddParameter, propagates HasError as failed Result; otherwise success. No whole-source TSS3 table is involved.

managed.title: PKSB/DMC trigger datasets, time windows, error buckets
rules: AddParameter(DIDData,HeaderData,AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer,RoB,FrameNumberData)->Result first checks all required DIDs and header names. Missing canonical image =>INFO_*_011 failed without image. Other missing values =>INFO_*_012, render recoverable error image/bucket, failed. TRIP or ADD_TIME_COUNTER containing Invalid =>INFO_*_013 and same salvage. Missing is distinct from invalid.

Type1 creates a new FirstTrigger(SetNo,AreaNo,Trip,Timestamp,TriggerID,TimeCounter,pre,post); pre/post come from RoB table; either -1=>INFO_*_014 plus salvage. Creates BasicInfo from trip/add-time/unique/trigger, image timestamp0, CSV marker*, and new Parameter. First-trigger timestamp uses raw0501/0511 and time helper precedence.

Types2/3 FindParameterIndex returns first existing parameter with equal trip,set,area and FirstTrigger.IsValidTimeCounter. d=abs(t*1000-firstT*1000)/1000. Type2 requires t>=firstT and d<=post. Type3 permits preceding t within pre and following t within post. No match=>INFO_*_015 and salvage; no alternative grouping.

For a match: interpolate timestamp from first timestamp and integer-truncated(firstT*1000),integer-truncated(t*1000), render image, set relative seconds=t-firstT, append image plus CSV DetailRow. Type2 marker=Resources.MULTI_TRIGGER; type3 marker=empty.

AddErrorParameter renders image; render failure returns INFO_*_002 without adding. Group error buckets by exact RoB equality; first gets CSV header, later rows append. Marker/time are dash. Error image list filenames are assigned at retrieval, not from capture transport.

Normal image retrieval sorts numerically by relative timestamp and mutates filename to Format(index) from0; CSV normal retrieval independently sorts numerically by TimeStampForSort and applies same index format plus replacement of BEFORE_CONVERT_TRIGGER_ID with first trigger ID. Error retrieval preserves insertion order and formats indices without that replacement.

managed.title: Table-driven scalar header decoding
rules: Initialize iterates all active header names, gets associated DID, writes dash and warning on absent DID; otherwise dispatches trigger/trip/time/add-time/ODO/date fields explicitly, then generic measured conversion. PVM returns Result with warnings; PKSB/DMC returns warning string; ADS constructor retains warning builder.

Trip/time invalid check compares the exact selected byte-unit substring to table invalid hex; then MSB-bit extraction and measured conversion. Add-time compares entire DID to invalid marker; extract table-selected field, measured conversion, parse double, divide1000 and format F1. ODO01=>km,02=>mile,other=>Invalid(hex).

ConvertToMeasuredValue(raw Int64,lsb double,offset double)->string uses decimal raw*decimal(lsb)+decimal(offset), n=decimal-digit count in lsb.ToString determined by dot, floors(value*10^n)/10^n, returns decimal.ToString. Negative numbers floor downward, not truncate; no invariant culture.

Trigger ID parses two bytes as decimal strings: first0=>BEFORE_CONVERT_TRIGGER_ID placeholder for PVM/PKSB/DMC, second0=>first else first_second. Exact whole-DID invalid sentinel first returns Invalid(value). ADS trigger follows second-zero rule without the first-zero placeholder.

Date components are decimal/BCD-text TryParse, not hex integer: year0..38,month1..12,day1..31,hour0..23,min/sec0..59; out-of-range=>Invalid(original). Valid fields ask RM.timezone ConvertTimeZone(originalFullDate,out component,selector1..6); false=>original substring. Invalid formatting is literal Invalid({0}) for modern families.

ADS header uses source row lookup with unhandled errors; trip/time first extracts bits and converts uppercase unpadded hex before invalid comparison. ADD_TIME_COUNTER and ODO_meters have separate invalid rules (ODO uses raw substring2,6). WRITE_COMPLETE_FLAG and ENCRYPTED_OR_NOT remain raw strings. Date info is added afterward from0507; missing/short date yields six dash fields, otherwise per-component bounds then timezone helper. DataExistBitArea is a Row property, not an admission gate in HeaderData ctor.

managed.title: Timestamp precedence, interpolation and fallback syntax
rules: PVM/PKSB/DMC first trigger extracts trip bytes from0501; add-time field from0511 is uppercase hex PadLeft8; unique field decimal string. Invalid trip/add-time returns corresponding trip_time+0 syntax, substituting valid raw parameter only for valid field.

Valid calendar components take precedence: concatenate20+year+month+day+hour+minute+second, TryParseExact yyyyMMddHHmmss CurrentCulture and format yyyy-MM-dd-HH:mm:ss.fff. The source takes final14 characters before parse. If this fails, call AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer.AbsTimeCalculation(trip,timeHex,unique,100,out s); false=>s+"+0", true=>s.

CreateTimeStampInFirstTriggerFormat(firstStamp,firstMs,currentMs): delta=firstMs-currentMs. If firstStamp contains dash and TryParseExact succeeds, return parsedDate-TimeSpan(0,0,0,0,delta) in same format. Otherwise remove final2 characters unconditionally and append sign(delta<=0?+:-)+abs(delta). This assumes +0 fallback and does not robustly parse arbitrary existing suffixes.

ADS first trigger: validate raw trip/time sentinels; if valid and raw0507 nonempty try timezone-backed calendar, otherwise same AbsTimeCalculation lsb100 fallback+0. ADS calendar helper trims to first12 chars only when longer12, converts timezone selector0, prefixes20 unless converted length14, then DateTime.ParseExact; format yyyy-MM-dd-HH:mm:ss.fff. Its interpolation overload takes an additional trip argument but operates on first timestamp/delta as above.

RM.operation.absolute-time join: bool instance AbsTimeCalculation(string trip,string timeHex,string unique,int32 lsb,out string): only trip!=FFFF,unique==0,existing trip anchor yields absolute DateTime. deltaMs=Int64(timeHex,16)*lsb-Int64(anchor.timeCount,16)*100; add TimeSpan seconds trunc(deltaMs/1000),millis deltaMs%1000. Otherwise out=trip+"_"+timeHex,false. No catch; parse/range errors propagate.

RM.timezone join owner parent: prepend20 unless length14; TryParseExact yyyyMMddHHmmss CurrentCulture; ordinary year fragment>38 rejects; local BaseUtcOffset only, not DST; selectors1yearD4,2..6componentD2,else full. No live OS application execution was performed.

managed.title: PVM spec02 admission, split collection and direction grouping
rules: Root PVMImageFFDExtractor first scans file for621103>=8 chars, stores chars6..7 as SpecNo. If02, delegates PVMImageFFDExtractProcessor.Extract(specNo,logPath,AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer,ref outputs), bypassing old memory-image branch. Processor initializes tables first, scans forward622031 encryption byte==01, then EB21 or EB31. EB21=>InvalidDataException ERROR_PVMIMG_001, absent marker=>ERROR_PVMIMG_003. Analyzer failed Result=>InvalidDataException. Reader always disposed; both output lists empty=>ERROR_PVMIMG_001.

PVM frame parsing: A=hex(first4),B=hex(last4),n=(A==0?B:A),set=ceil((n%512)/10),split=floor(n/512). A==0 =>triggerNo=((n%512-1)%10)+1 and type1 ifNo1 else2. A!=0=>triggerNo=B+1,type3. Exact constants512,10 are static Decimal fields.

Only EB33 lines and not length8 are admitted. Extract RoB/frame/DID and append Result warnings; HasError skips. Try append to LAST SplitTempData ONLY; requires exact RoB,set,type,triggerNo,current split+1 and existing nonempty FFImage. On success update split and concatenate FFImage. No search/reorder across other groups. Otherwise incoming split must1; later split warns with reconstructed first frame and drops. First split initializes HeaderData and creates SplitTempData.

After whole-file scan, no SplitTempData=>failed ERROR_PVMIMG_004. Group processing is distinct area numbers sorted ascending, then set numbers ascending, type order1,2,3 restricted to present types, then trigger numbers ascending. For each group and direction order1,2,3,4, FindIndex exact area/set/type/trigger/direction takes FIRST matching temp item. Create OneDirectionTempData and decode image (may throw); missing image warns. Entire group all-null images=>skip; otherwise AddParameter.

Unknown area/direction entries (ExistsAreaNoAndCameraDirection false) are processed separately as one-direction error parameters when image exists; missing image warns/drops. Error parameter image-type1 PVM. Root ImageFFDExtractData carries four-direction PVMImageFFD list, existence flags, CSV and areaNo, not a generic single image.

SplitTempData caches area/direction using active RoB mapping; its frame object is updated only for ImageSplitNo when appending, while original frame string and first-split header remain. This matters for grouped output and first frame warnings.

managed.title: PVM four-direction first-trigger matching and outputs
rules: AddParameter(area,set,List<OneDirectionTempData>,type,AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer) validates required DID/name fields of FIRST direction only, then TRIP/ADD_TIME_COUNTER Invalid checks on FIRST direction only; errors aggregate RoB strings and call AddErrorParameter for recoverable directions. Image presence was checked separately by collector.

Type1 creates per-direction timeCounter dictionary by parsing each header ADD_TIME_COUNTER and per-direction timestamp dictionary using0501/0511/header/time analyzer. Pre/post durations taken from first direction RoB; -1 fails with warning/error salvage. FirstTrigger stores first frame, first trip, dictionaries, triggerID and windows. BasicInfo uses first direction trip/unique/trigger and FIRST dictionary time value, not min/average.

Build PVMImageFFD(front,back,right,left,relative="0") from first matching direction entries, absent directions null. Each present direction contributes CSV DetailRow(type,RoB,direction,directionTimestamp,header). Create Parameter(area,set,FirstTrigger,BasicInfo,PVMImageFFD,CSV).

Other types compute per-direction counters, FindIndex first existing parameter with equal area/set and FirstTrigger.MatchFirstTrigger(firstTrip,firstCounter,type). Matching compares trip then first stored timeCounter only; type2 disallows preceding times and bounds post; type3 allows pre/post as in single-family contract. No match=>INFO_PVMIMG_016 and per-direction error salvage.

Matched groups interpolate timestamp separately per direction only when both first timestamp/counter and current counter dictionaries contain key. Source repeats current-counter ContainsKey check. Relative PVMImageFFD timestamp uses decimal difference of FIRST current counter and FIRST stored counter, not direction-dependent. Append bundle and direction CSV rows.

Parameter getters sort whole PVMImageFFD bundles numerically by bundle relative timestamp and assign formatted index filenames. Existence flags are Any(image.direction!=null) per F/B/R/L. CSV maintains separate F/B/R/L detail arrays sorted numerically by header counter; normal GetOutputData serializes header once then F rows, B rows, R rows, L rows, each index starts0 and placeholder trigger IDs replaced. Error detail array remains separate insertion-order output.

Error parameters group by RoB and preserve individual decoded Bitmap images; metadata may be incomplete. Lists/dictionaries are returned by reference; property setters and constructors do not clone images or automatically dispose them.

managed.title: ADS record flags, frame list and DID normalization
rules: IsValidRecordFlag requires line length>=18 else InvalidDataException ERROR_ADSIMGFFD_002; byte chars6..7 must2 else Exception ERROR_ADSIMGFFD_005; parse next5 bytes chars8..17 and require at least one byte2 (predicate is byte!=2; All(predicate) triggers error) (predicate source pinned nested closure); all bytes !=2=>same exception. Returns true otherwise.

GetSpecInfo requires>=8 chars then chars6..7. IsValidReadInfo requires>=ReadInfoLength*2 and parsed count at6..7<=GetAreaNumber; oversized count=>Exception ERROR_ADSIMGFFD_003. RoB parser requires>=8 chars, reads chars4..7 and consecutive8-char frame strings from8 onward, silently ignores partial final fragment, no frames=>WarningException INFO_ADSIMGFFD_012.

AnalysisTriggerType: frame first4!=0000=>type3(TimeSeries) and add first4 to time-series prefix list; zero-prefix frames initially type0. For each zero-prefix frame, if any time-series prefix equals its last4 =>type1(first), else type2(multi). Duplicate full frames throw Dictionary.Add. GetFrameNumberAndTriggerType requires>=16, exact RoB equality, then dictionary lookup by chars8..15; failed lookup=>WarningException INFO_ADSIMGFFD_008, RoB mismatch=>_007, short=>_009.

CreateImageFFDExtractDataParameter requires>=18 and passes substring18 onward to DIDData, ignoring count byte. ADS DIDData iterates variable-width records as framing contract. Unknown DID lookup exception skips the full declared record. Nonimage declared length<min warns and skips; otherwise take min chars.6001 pads character5 to min or removes surplus, warning INFO_ADSIMGFFD_014 for short image. Consumes original declared length, not normalized length. Unlike PVM/PKSB generic framing, no zero-length early break is added here.

DIDData checks enough chars for DID/length header but data Substring/Remove can still throw for truncated declared payload; warnings are not a blanket exception catch. Header ctor/parameter creation can throw into root ADS wrapper, whose ownership is RM.operation root contract.

managed.title: ADS dataset association, recoverable errors and first-frame predicate
rules: CreateImageFFDExtractDataParameter constructs DIDData and HeaderData, appends warning builders. If required image6001 or ENCRYPTED_OR_NOT missing=>WarningException INFO_ADSIMGFFD_010. Other missing DID/header names=>salvage into passed ErrorImageFFDExtractDataParameter plus warning. Invalid trip/add-time=>same salvage with INFO_ADSIMGFFD_001.

Type1 creates timestamp(raw0501,0511,0507,time analyzer), FirstTrigger(frame,trip,timestamp,counter,RoB pre/post), BasicInfo, decoded image0, CSV marker*, then new Parameter. Pre/post failures are not explicitly checked here as in PKSB.

For type2/3 FindParameterIndex uses first parameter whose FirstTrigger matches trip, frame, and time. MatchFrameNumber(candidate) is candidate.StartsWith(firstFrame.Substring(4,4)); not full frame equality. Type2 requires t>=firstT and d<=post; type3 bounds pre/post. Missing match=>salvage+INFO_ADSIMGFFD_002.

For match interpolate with int32-truncated ms counters, render6001 using ENCRYPTED_OR_NOT, relative=t-firstT, append image/CSV row with multi marker only for type2. Additional trip argument is decimal string produced by Int32.Parse(headerTrip,0x203).

ErrorParameter keeps one image list and CSV; first row creates header, later adds DetailRow. ExistParameter returns true if imageCount!=0 OR CSV.detailCount!=0 (not equality/consistency). SetImageFFDFileName iterates insertion order and image filename format. Normal Parameter retrieval sorts images numerically and assigns0-based filenames; CSV formats in same numeric order. No transport/ECU side effects.

managed.title: Parameterized data-field, enum, constructor and container contract
rules: Each trivial getter returns its exact ldfld/ldsfld backing storage, each trivial setter writes it with no validation/copy/events; per-method field_reads/field_writes and typed signature are the parameterization. Enum types have zero MethodDefs and their field constants are retained in enum_constants.

All .ctor/.cctor identities and typed arguments are pinned. Constructor field writes and own setter-call sequence define parameter-to-storage initialization; table Row constructors retain raw byte/bit/length/scaling metadata. Nested closure constructors only call Object ctor; closure predicates perform exact comparisons/substrings/nullable checks shown by their call/constant/branch evidence and bind to enclosing named algorithm.

DataSetBasicInfo(string basicInfo) normalizes CRLF to LF, takes second comma field from lines0..3 as Trip/AddTimeCounter/UniqueCountInfo/TriggerID with no length checks. Value constructor stringifies double add-time with CurrentCulture. GetOutputData emits four key/value lines for Resources.COLUMN_KEYCYCLE_KEY,ELAPSED_KEY,CLOCK_KEY,TRIGGER_KEY in that order.

CSV DetailRow retains value string and numeric sort key from header add-time. Header columns are active CSV table row order filtered to keys actually present; standard string.Join/comma formats do not quote or escape data. Initial * row is first trigger, localized MULTI_TRIGGER marks additional triggers, dash marks salvage/error. Sorting numeric comparison returns1/-1/0 by Double difference; equal-key List.Sort has no promised stable ordering.

Nested Parameter.AddParameter appends images and detail rows; error parameters append or initialize CSV; retrieval mutates sorting and filenames and returns held list, not immutable snapshots. FFImageBitmap/image bundles have no IDisposable wrapper or ownership transfer enforcement in these models.

managed.title: Family bitmap and CSV filesystem export
rules: PKSB/DMC Output(outRoot,normalList,errorList) maintains normal per-RoB set counter starting1, chooses RoB directory table (fallback raw RoB), creates Path.Combine(root,localized family camera type,RoBDirectory,Resources.DIR_NAME_SET formatted counter), writes each image filename as BMP and UTF8 {lastDirectoryName}.csv from HeaderInfo.

Error output uses localized error directory under same family/RoB path; no per-set nesting. Writes every error bitmap plus UTF8 {directoryName}.csv from error CSV. Existing files may overwrite and duplicate logical buckets are not deduplicated. Exceptions propagate; already-written directories/files remain (no rollback).

PVM spec02 Output groups counters by area, creates family/area/set then direction subdirectories and saves only nonnull images, plus CSV once per set. Error buckets use RoB-specific error path. Root spec01 output uses Windows separator concatenation, area counters and output-direction flags; filenames enumerate000.bmp etc and CSV resource filename formatting. It tests Directory.Exists before image.Save and does not delete stale files.

All enumerators have finally Dispose. No output method disposes model-owned Bitmap/Image objects, no atomic write transaction, no cancellation branch. Scratch files created by old PVM analysis are not deleted by any assigned method; parent form/temp lifecycle owns broader directory cleanup. Shared temp-root concatenation is GetTempPath()+"vdas"+"PcsDataViewerTemp", not a bare PcsDataViewerTemp path.

managed.title: DDR and OperationFFD image matching
rules: ConnectingToDDR returns when either list empty; for each nonnull DDR HeadDataList entry normalize CRLF, split lines, build first trigger[trip,elapsed,trigger,*] by localized header key selection. Additional rows require first field Contains(MULTI_TRIGGER), nonblank trigger and line lacks Invalid: time=firstElapsed+column3/1000, trigger=column1 optionally_+column2 when column2!=0.

FindTargetDDR requires exact trip, trigger equal or compatibility(imageTrigger,DDRTrigger)=(27,27_1),(25,18_11),(23,23_1). delta=(imageTime*10-triggerTime*10)/10; select abs(delta)<=6 and strictly smaller than incumbent initialized6.1. Ties keep first encountered. Return null on no match. offset normal=delta; multi=delta+abs(firstTriggerTime-currentTriggerTime). Source auxiliary correction variable is overwritten for each trigger-compatible candidate before threshold/nearest selection, so multi correction can reflect LAST such candidate rather than selected one.
ConnectingToDDR passes selected dataset with Math.Round(offset,3) to DDRExtractorData.SetImageFFD(headIndex,image,offset); no candidate removal allows reuse across triggers.

ConnectingToOpeFFD clones input image list for EACH FFDExtractData; header first trigger uses trip/elapsed/OperationFFDExtractData.RoBCode and*. Multi-trigger rows come from ParameterInfo.OutputData. Counter selector prefers exact equality Resources.FFD_TSS3_ID_0511_2, else exact Resources.FFD_TSS3_ID_0501_2 divided1000, missing=>null. RoB uses exact Resources.FFD_TSS3_ID_ROBCODE. All selectors are exact Resources-bound predicates, not substring/suffix matches.

Unique RoB normally RoB+_0. RoB2098 uses first parameter name equal Resources.FFD_TSS3_ID_5792; absent=>2098_0; if selected data length1 prefix0; otherwise source leaves temporary hex empty (does NOT copy length2 data), then calls RoBCodeDefine.GetNumbering(5792,temp). This source quirk is retained.

FindTargetOpe requires trip and image-trigger->allowed-operationRoB membership in dictionary selected by enum, same6-second nearest predicate and strict tie behavior as DDR. Removes matched image index from per-FFD candidate copy, prevents reuse within that record only; selected image reused for next FFD record. Calls FFDExtractData.SetImageFFD(image,Round(offset,3)). Multi correction has same last-candidate-variable behavior.

Exact dictionaries: PVM,PKSB25=>20DD_0,2291_0,227E_0; DMC25=>227E_0 and35=>229E_0. Common also defines FCM mapping; lifted_static_fields retain all exact pairs, but FCM extraction algorithm belongs sibling contract. These joins parse/rendered CSV strings with no quoting/field-count checks; malformed numeric/index input exceptions propagate.

managed.title: ADS DDR/operation dataset association
rules: Both ConnectingImageFFDToADSDDRExtractorData and ConnectingImageFFDToADSOperationExtractorData delegate same ConnectingData(List<ADSExtractorData>,List<ImageFFDExtractData>). Per ADS DataSetList entry normalize CRLF/split CSV. Header scan appends trip,elapsed,trigger in encountered source line order (not fixed keyed assignment except trip variable). Add marker*. Additional rows require first field exact MULTI_TRIGGER; tuple[trip,column2,column1,MULTI_TRIGGER].

FindTarget requires exact BasicInfo trip and trigger, no legacy compatibility aliases, no image consumption. delta=(imageTime*10-triggerTime*10)/10; closest abs<=6, strict improvement from6.1. Auxiliary correction=abs(firstTriggerTime-currentTriggerTime), assigned during each compatible candidate visit, not saved with winner. Normal offset=delta; multi=delta+correction. Even when no match offset assigned6.1(+correction) but caller ignores because result null.

SetImageFFDExtractorData(datasetIndex,image,Math.Round(offset,3)) mutates ADSExtractorData. Same image may associate multiple records. Header/CSV field-count/numeric errors and null inputs propagate; enumerators disposed in finally, no empty-list early check before outer iteration.

managed.title: Original PVM spec01 request/response memory log admission
rules: Root Extract always requires ExtractSpecNo. Non02 falls through original branch; only spec01 is present in source readFFDInfoLogLengthList,mdicAreaNumList,mdicTriggerNumList. Unsupported spec raises via read-info dictionary or related source lookup, not a fabricated fallback.

ExtractFFDInfoAndMakeMemoryImageFile(outDir,logPath,ref info)->Int64 response count creates UTF8 cleansed log with File.OpenWrite (not truncate mode), progresses expected states621101 pre-read,621103 spec,621102 read-info, then collects only lines starting23 or63. Early states require matching StartsWith; no rewind. Counter increments on63 lines only. Reader/writer disposed in finally. Zero63 count=>root WarningException INFO_PVMIMG_001.

Pre-read>=22 chars; byte[6:8] parsed hex must2; scan remaining byte pairs and require any2; otherwise WarningException. Spec>=8 reads chars6..7 into info. Read-info spec1 expected153 bytes=>>=306 chars. AreaCount=hex chars6..7 <=7; per-area trigger-table index map {1:5,2:0,3:2,4:1,5:3,6:4,7:6}.

For area index a, T=7,N=areaCount,j=mapped trigger index: HeaderSize=hex[12:14]; FFD1SetSize=hex[14+8*j:22+8*j]; maxSets=hex[14+8*T+176+2*N+2*a:...+2]. Start addresses start at14+8*T+8*sum(previous.maxSets),8 chars each, maxSets entries. Extraction failures in address loop=>InvalidDataException ERROR_019.

StorableMax=byte(hex[14+8*T+176+2*a:...+2]/maxSets), integer division. ActualSetCount=hex[14+8*T+176+4*N+2*a:...+2]; dataSize19200 bytes; SamplingTime=hex[14+8*T+176+6*N+4+2*j:...+2]; AllDataSize=(HeaderSize+19200*StorableMax*4)*ActualSetCount. Zero maxSets can divide by zero and propagate.

Root warns for each area ActualSetCount<maxSets; then repairs per-camera scratch files, skips empty memory file, derives camera flags from per-set folder strings. Source tests FindIndex(flag==true)<=0 as acceptable and warns/skips if first present set index>0; no generic input-validation/retry layer.

Scratch path suffixes are literal \PVMImgFFDCleansed.log,\PVMImgFFDMemoryImg{area}_{camera}.log,\PVMImgFFD-Trig{set}MemoryImg{area}_{camera}.log. File.OpenWrite may preserve trailing old bytes; assigned code performs no delete on completion/error.

managed.title: Original PVM address-ordered hole repair and scratch segmentation
rules: Uses area maxima10 pre,10 trigger,10 post for all7 areas. For each area and camera c=0..3 rescan cleansed log from beginning and write per-camera memory image with OpenWrite. State variables: expectedKind23,firstStartAddress,expectedAddress,previousRecordNo,lastImageAddress,expectedSet=1,bytesWritten=0,setEnd=0,headerPending=false,headerWritten=false,syntheticPrevious=false. Initialize per-set validCamera[4]=false and imageCounts empty.

Derive camera startAddress=firstStart[0:2]+hex(c*4)+firstStart[3:8], parse hex. For23 request line: sizeLength=int decimal(line[2]),addressLength=int decimal(line[3]); address=line.Substring(6,2*(addressLength-1)); requestBytes=hex(line.Substring(4+2*addressLength,2*sizeLength)). Reject address first nibble not equal firstStart first nibble. ExpectedKind63 does not require response prefix check explicitly: non23 input gets substring after2 chars if state63 and declared response byte length must match requestBytes.

If incoming set digit address[1] exceeds expectedSet: advance setEnd by H+(preMax+triggerPostMax)*D. If current set/camera invalid and priorEnd==bytesWritten, pad absent image bytes and include H only when neither headerPending nor headerWritten; mark syntheticPrevious, reset expectedAddress to current set/camera/10000. Else pad positive setEnd-bytesWritten. Fill skipped sets with H+(maxPre+maxTrigger+maxPost)*D bytes0x55 using source pvmImgFFDMaxRecordList[areaIndex] (zero-based lookup inside this branch is a source quirk); if incoming set>ActualSetCount exit scan, else update expectedSet and clear previous/header flags.

Address[2:4]==FF means next matching63 is header (headerPending=true). For nonheader request with headerPending or no headerWritten, reset image maxima to defaults and write H filler bytes, then headerPending=false/headerWritten=true. RecordNo=hex(address[2:4])&0x3F; camera=(hex(address[2])>>2). Reject other camera, zero available counts, record within unused pre-gap(actualPre<record<=10), record beyond10+triggerPostCount, address before expectedAddress, or record in old/duplicate pre region.

If address==expectedAddress accept response. Otherwise for a new record/address at boundary: special record1/offset0 with syntheticPrevious or exact previousD boundary advances expectedAddress without filler; else pad prior partial image toD, then missing records (recordNo-lastRecord-1 minus unusedPre when recordNo==11)*D; set-switch/nonfirst record case may pad(recordNo-1)*D. Positive address low16 offset is filled with0x55. For same-record positive address gap pad delta; nonpositive gap rejects response. Accepted request sets lastImageAddress and expectedKind63.

For matching-size63 header response: GetHeaderInfo, GetTriggerImgNum (clamp each per-camera pre/trigger/post to10 and emit ERROR_PVM_001 warning on excess), store per-set maxPre and max(trigger+post) across4 cameras, create header CSV. If responseBytes>H source writes first(responseBytes-H)*2 chars (not firstH); responseBytes<H appends(H-responseBytes) filler bytes but increments bytesWritten by responseBytes; equality writes all. Then headerPending=false/headerWritten=true.

For matching-size63 image response: off=hex(address.Substring(4)); n=min(responseBytes,D-off) as implemented by overrun arithmetic; write prefix2*n, increment bytesWritten byn; expectedAddress is incremented by ORIGINAL requestBytes, not clippedn; lastRecord=RecordNo and set/camera validity=true. Set expectedKind23. Wrong response length does not advance state.

At EOF if bytesWritten>0 advance setEnd by H+(preMax+triggerPostMax)*D. Invalid current camera=>append all image filler and leave (does not append another header here). Else fill positive setEnd-bytesWritten. Zero bytes=>INFO_PVMIMG_004. Store each set validity as comma-separated Boolean.ToString four-camera string. Reader/writer finally Dispose. No rollback of scratch files.

DivideEachMemoryImage maintains charSkip. Empty counts skip2*(H+30*D); missing camera/set flag skips2*(H+(preMax+triggerPostMax)*D) and warns INFO_PVMIMG_005. Present sets discard accumulated chars via Reader.Read, read exactly2*(H+(preMax+triggerPostMax)*D) into char array (Read count not enforced), write separated scratch, reset skip. GetTriggerImgNum returns max per-camera pre and max per-camera(trigger+post), not global sum of separate maxima.

managed.title: Original PVM header decoder and temporal image rendering
rules: HeaderInfoBitAssign exact source table is lifted from06000AD0, with entries(label,startCharacter,lenCharacter,lsb,offset,unsigned,invalidHex). Header fields: trigger0,4; trip4,4; time8,8(lsb100); overwrite16,6; triggerOffset22,2(lsb100); decrypt24,2; four direction count triples starting26 increment2; nineteen trigger/time pairs starting50/54 stride12; write-complete278,2. Missing input padded with spaces to2*H.

GetHeaderInfo extracts each source tuple, space-containing=>localized NODATA. Invalid exact sentinel=>localized INVALID(hex); TripCount keeps raw invalid string and otherwise hex text; TimeCount still calls CreateTimeStamp with trip+raw time. TrgID creates per-byte numeric IDs via decimal raw*lsb+offset and joins second nonzero; WritingCompletionFlg remains raw. Other numeric values use Int32.TryParse(hex,0x203,null,out raw), ignore bool result, then decimal raw*lsb+offset; failed numeric parsing therefore uses raw0. All source formats/culture preserved.

GetTriggerImgNum uses header list indices6+3*c,7+3*c,8+3*c; NODATA=>0. Clamp pre/trigger/post independently to10 if exceeded with warning; return max(pre[c]),max(trigger[c]+post[c]). CSV header generated from first17 source fields then timestamp/file rows. Later trigger rows limit min(triggerPostCount,csvDetailsIndexList.Count=19). Invalid/nodata relative values emit dash; zero trigger IDs inherit first trigger ID according source formatting.

CreateImageFFDExtractData loops stored sets with nonempty imageCounts. For each direction whose separated file exists, read2*FFD1SetSize chars into reused buffer, mark direction present; absent directions remain null. No file=>create empty bundle list/basic string with original folder flags and header CSV; normal path uses FIRST present direction header as canonical metadata.

Canonical metadata trigger bytes0,2 decimal with optional second; trip hex[4:8]; unique=(hex[8:10]&0xE0)>>5; timeHex=hex-string of(hex[8:10]&0x1F) padded2+chars[10:16]; triggerOffset=hex[22:24]; decrypt flag=hex[24:26]!=0 (different from exact01 modern flag). Trim H*2 chars from each direction payload. Frame count=min(preMax+triggerPostMax,StorableMax). Per frame slice2*D chars; optionally root Decrypt; create160x120 indexed grayscale as raw-image contract.

Relative timestamp for index i<preMax: (SamplingTime*100*(i-preMax+1)-triggerOffset*100)/1000; i==preMax=>0. For i>preMax,k=i-preMax: if canonical header TrgID at chars2*(25+6*(k-1)),len4==FFFE, omit whole frame after rendering; else currentTick=((byte at2*(27+6*(k-1))&0x1F)<<24)|remaining3 bytes; relative=(UInt32(currentTick)-UInt32(firstTick))*100/1000 with unsigned subtraction semantics. Bundles include four bitmaps/null and relative Double.ToString.

BasicInfo elapsed=(UInt32(firstTick)*100/1000).ToString(F1), trip as hex Int32 conversion, unique decimal, trigger string. No absolute timestamp assigned to root bundles; header CSV timestamps use CreateTimeStamp/AbsTimeCalculation. CreateTimeStamp returns localized no-data if either trip/time no-data, joins Invalid fields with underscore, else splits packed time bits and invokes AbsTimeCalculation lsb100, ignoring returned bool.

Output spec01 uses sequential bundle index filenames, not raw triggerNo. The PVMImageFFD and PVMImageFFDjpeg root models both retain four Image references plus TimeStamp/ImageFileName and plain field accessors; jpeg name alone does not implement JPEG decoding in these classes.

managed.title: Root extractor and trigger-name adapters
rules: RCImageFFDExtractor is PKSB adapter: Extract delegates PKSBImageFFD.Extract, Output delegates PKSB.Output; DataConecterToDDR uses common join, DataConecterToOpeFFD enum3(PKSB). DMC adapter equivalent with enum4(DMC). PVM adapter enum2(PVM). These enum values are connector selection enum, not root image-type enum (PVM1/PKSB2/DMC3).

RC/DMC GetTriggerName parses DataSetBasicInfo and passes TriggerID to family map. Every map appends _0 if input lacks underscore, checks ContainsKey and returns map value, else TRIGGER_NAME_EMPTY+"["+normalizedID+"]". PVM GetTrgName extracts trigger from BasicInfo line3 and chooses TriggerNameSpec2 when GetSpecNo<=2, else TriggerName. Full dictionaries/Resources getter expressions are source-qualified in lifted_static_fields; no guessed localized label text.

PVM root SpecNo is static, so Output branches on last extracted spec, not each dataset spec. Modern spec02 delegates processor output; other spec uses old root output. No synchronization/reentrancy guard. Root adapters do not add retries, cancellation or native calls.

managed.title: Offline FCM system selection and root pipeline
behavior: Extract(logPath,tempDirectory,legacyImageList,tss3ImageList,errorImageList,AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer) reads prerecorded text;  it does not initiate diagnostic communication.

AnalyzeSystem scans from file start and stops at the first recognized record: 610B  =>  system0;  621203  =>  system1 ASP;  621103  =>  system2 TSS3. ASP/TSS3 update MainForm.ImageFFDSystemType;  GSP/CSP label is set later by 610B data-size-unit parsing. Static system defaults to3;  no-match scan does not reset prior state.

ASP path: cleanse/admit three metadata records, warn for missing sets per area, supplement memory, skip areas with zero sets or empty memory file, divide memory into sets then decode each set. Legacy path: cleanse610B/E401, reject absent E401 with WarningException(INFO_IMG_001), append INFO_IMG_003 per absent set, supplement/divide/decode. TSS3 delegates to FCMImageFFDTTS3.Extract using Path.Combine(tempDirectory,ImageFFD_Trigger{0}.log);  this passed name is not written by current TSS3 body.

Extract appends informational strings in processing order. No cancellation token or cancellation branch occurs in these methods. File exceptions and unchecked malformed-substring/hex/conversion/arithmetic failures propagate unless caught in explicitly identified callees.

managed.title: GSP/CSP metadata, gap repair and raw bitmap decode
behavior: Cleanser first accepts a610B record, then writes only E401 records to temp\ImgFFDCleansed.log via File.OpenWrite + UTF8 StreamWriter. It returns number of accepted E401 lines;  streams disposed by finally.

610B length must be>=28 hex characters. After stripping610B, parse byte0 flags: ((flags&0x30)>>4)==2 else WarningException(INFO_IMG_001);  (flags&3)==2 else WarningException(INFO_IMG_002). Remaining payload offsets in hex characters: capacity[2:4], maximumSets[4:6], sets[6:8], sampling[10:12], unit[12:14], startMemoryAddress[14:22], headerBytes[22:24]. Short record => InvalidDataException(ERROR_011).

Unit1 => 13440 bytes,160x84,GSP;  unit2 => 10240 bytes,128x80,GSP;  unit3 => 2028 bytes,52x39,CSP;  other unit => InvalidDataException(ERROR_004 formatted unit). allBytes=(headerBytes+imageBytes*capacity+4)*sets;  bytesPerSet=allBytes/sets (sets0 is not specially guarded).

Reconstruct expects E401{length:X,width2}{address}, initially length56 and source start address. If matching prefix, append payload after prefix. Advance expected address by56 (not actual payload length);  next expectedLength=min(56,allBytes-bytesWritten). Formatting is alignment width, not X2/X8 zero-padding.

On mismatch read address from record.Substring(6,8);  missingBlocks=(receivedAddress-expectedAddress)/56 using signed integer division. For each missing block append56 copies of55, and store each missing relative byte address as a decimal string in static lackedAddrList. Then append received payload. After EOF append55 for positive remaining bytes and mark missing byte addresses. No sorting, duplicate rejection, backwards-address recovery, checksum or explicit upper-bound clamp on appended records. lackedAddrList is static and not cleared here.

DivideEachMemoryImage reads2*bytesPerSet chars per set into a reused fixed array, writes the entire array to per-set file even when Read returns short. Names: \imgFFD-Trig{index}MemoryImg.log;  ASP adds area number. Output uses File.OpenWrite, so an existing longer file is not explicitly truncated.

Legacy CreateImageFile strips header bytes and decodes capacity images. Header unit1/2: trip hex[0:4], unique=(hexByte4&0xE0)>>5, counter=(hexByte4&0x1F formatted lower-case hex width2)+hex[6:12]. Unit3 shifts trip to[8:12] and unique/counter to byte0 plus[2:8]. Common fields: stored=(byte6&0xFC)>>2;  trigger=(byte7&0xF0)>>4;  encryption=byte6&3;  offsetMs=(byte8&0xFE)>>1;  completion=byte8&1;  version=byte7&15.

Legacy decrypt always XORs each parsed byte with0xAA. For units1/2 first reverse all eight bits;  for unit3 bypass reversal. It does not use the parsed header encryption flag to bypass this transformation. Hex conversion recognizes digits by48..57 and treats other chars as char-55;  this is not general validation.

Create8bpp indexed Bitmap, fill palette Color.FromArgb(255,g,g,g), LockBits(writeOnly), Marshal.Copy all decoded bytes toScan0, UnlockBits. No stride correction in legacy/ASP copy. Relative image time in seconds: units1/2=(sampling*10*(imageIndex-9)-offsetMs)/1000;  unit3=(sampling*10*imageIndex+offsetMs)/1000.

Legacy tripFFFF becomes localized Invalid(FFFF). Counter invalid detection is source-specific and case-sensitive: unique3 && counter==1fFFFFFF, or unique!=3 && counter.EndsWith(FFFFFF);  invalid timestamp combines invalid trip/counter;  otherwise calls AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer.AbsTimeCalculation with100ms scale. Missing header-byte marks rewrite display fields: offsets0..5 => timestamp no-data,6 => stored/encryption,7 => trigger/version,8 => offset/completion. Missing image pixels still decode from inserted55.

managed.title: ASP specs01,02,03,04 metadata and address reconstruction
behavior: Cleanser is an ordered state machine:621201 pre-read => 621203 spec => 621202 read-info => 23 request or63 response records. Out-of-order earlier records are ignored. Writes23/63 lines and counts63 lines;  zero returned count causes root warning.

621201 minimum18 chars;  byte[6:8] must equal2 and at least one subsequent parsed byte must equal2, otherwise INFO_IMG_001 WarningException.621203 minimum8 then read spec[6:8];  only01/02/03/04 exist. Full minimum byte lengths are11/12/13/13.621202 byte minima74/103/104/104. Unknown spec maps to ERROR_013 InvalidDataException;  short toERROR_011.

621202 area count=hex[6:8], overwriteMax=hex[8:12];  maximum supported area counts01 => 5,02 => 6,03/04 => 7;  exceeded maximum throws Exception(ERROR_012 formatted count). Trigger record counts01 => 7 and02/03/04 => 8. Data-including-area count for02/03/04 is7. All source pointer formulas and table fields are retained in method contracts0x06000A45/46;  these are separate layouts, not one TSS3 format.

Spec01 reads set-size list of7 uint32-be hex values starting char14. Header size at char12. Per-area start addresses follow set-size list;  then capacity[],maxSets[],sets[];  one sampling byte and unit byte after those arrays. Only unit1 supported => 16320-byte160x102 images. Area1 maps size-index0;  areas2..5 map2..5. allBytes=(header+imageBytes*capacity)*sets (no legacy+4).

Spec02..04 derive sampling list from ((initialPointer+4+2+(triggerCount+1)*8+7*8+7*2*3)+8);  initialPointer=8. Read first set-size list from char14 for triggerCount-1 entries, skipping input index5. First five areas have header at12, start addresses at14+(triggerCount-1)*8+i*8, followed by5-element capacity/max/sets arrays. Spec04 divides capacity bymaxSets with no zero guard. Unit1 only;  imageBytes16320.

Additional areas reuse first-area header/unit/image-size;  read additional set-size entries after first region and corresponding address/capacity/max/sets arrays. Area6 uses set-size/sampling index6;  area7 index7. Source uses area-index-based mapping rather than a first-match heuristic. Full formulas preserved at0x06000A46 IL_02A0..04A1.

For each area rescan cleansed23/63 log. In23 request: decimal-parse one-character length width at[2],address width at[3];  address=Substring(4,addressWidth*2), except addressWidth>4 => Substring(6,(addressWidth-1)*2). Request start must be within [areaStart,areaStart+allBytes). Request length is hex at char4+2*addressWidth for2*lengthWidth.

Positive gap from expected address to new request is filled with55;  negative gap is ignored. Only response bytes whose payload length (after63 prefix) equals requested length are appended. On match advance expected address by requested length and await23. Header parsing occurs when request address equals one of areaStart+setIndex*bytesPerSet. No bytes for area  =>  INFO_IMG_005 and skip decoding;  positive short tail filled55. Streams disposed on every ordinary/exception exit.

ASP image count is pre+at+post from header bytes13,14,15;  maximum counts per area1..6 are10,10,10 and area7 is3,0,0. Counts exceeding maxima append ERROR_ASP_005 then clamp each component, not reject whole set. Header encryption byte12!=0 enables reverseBits(byte)^0xAA;  zero copies parsed bytes unchanged.

ASP relative times: pre image i  =>  [sampling*100*(i-pre+1)-triggerOffsetByte*100]/1000;  image i==pre => 0;  later images use embedded secondary trigger/time entry at byte16+6*(i-pre-1). Trigger IDFFFE skips that image;  otherwise unsigned32 modular difference between secondary and first29-bit counters times0.1 seconds. Bitmap160x102 with grayscale palette.

managed.title: ASP header layout, invalid and no-data markers
behavior: HeaderInfoBitAssign contains48 source tuples [name,charStart,charLength,LSB,offset,unsigned,invalid]. Exact list is decoded in tables artifact including all19 secondary trigger/time pairs. Main fields: TrgID0/4 invalidFFFE; Trip4/4 invalidFFFF; Time8/8 scale100 invalidFFFFFFFE; Overwrite16/6 invalidFFFFFE; TriggerOffset22/2 scale100 invalidFE; Decrypt24/2; Pre26/2; At28/2; Post30/2;  secondary TrgID starts32+12*j with4chars andTime36+12*j with8chars;  completion260/2.

InitializeHeaderInfo creates per-set no-data CSV placeholders;  start-address list is computed from area start plus setIndex*bytesPerSet. GetStartAddrIndex compares source addresses by numeric conversion. GetHeaderInfo right-pads short header with spaces to2*headerBytes. Any field containing space => localized no-data;  otherwise exact case-sensitive invalid equality => localized Invalid(raw). Invalid Trip propagates to timestamp;  invalid TimeCount is handled by CreateTimeStamp.

Trigger conversion decimal-parses each two-character hex byte, applies Decimal(raw)*LSB+offset, emits firstByte if second==0 else first_second. Generic numeric fields use Int32.TryParse(hex,NumberStyles515,null,out) without testing success, so malformed raw may become0;  writing completion is kept raw.

CreateTimeStamp no-data inputs => no-data;  Invalid-containing inputs => trip_counter concatenation;  otherwise extracts unique top3 bits and masks low5 bits of counter first byte, builds counter string, calls AbsTimeCalculation(trip,counter,unique,100,out). Its first-byte masked counter is converted to decimal string then PadLeft(2,0), an exact difference from legacy image path lower-case hex conversion.

CSV header/detail rendering uses localized titles and explicit comma/newline formats;  completion/invalid/no-data values are not silently coerced. Exact literal templates and branch-specific writes are in method evidence.

managed.title: TSS3 format admission and ordered EB33 grouping
behavior: AnalyzeExtractionsType scans entire file until first EB21 => type1 orEB31 => type2. No marker => Result.Failed(ERROR_FCMIMGFFD_TSS3_005);  Extract converts failure to InvalidDataException. EB21/type1 deliberately fails ERROR_FCMIMGFFD_TSS3_004;  only split EB31 path implemented.

GetImageFFDInfoForSplit uses one forward-only StreamReader: seek first621103, parse spec[6:8] after min8, initialize exact FCMDataTable (05 or07 only);  then seek first622081, after min8 encrypted=(Substring(6,2)==01);  then collect subsequent EB33 records except length8. Out-of-order data consumed while looking for metadata is not replayed. Missing spec/encryption does not have a distinct missing-record failure in this helper;  scan exhaustion may leave static prior table/spec state.

EB33 RoBCode=Substring(4,4), require length>=8;  frame=Substring(8,8), require>=16. Bad record returns informational failure and caller appends message then skips record. FrameNumberData parsing/conversion exceptions are not caught by these getters.

Group key is exact RoBCode+SetNo+TriggerNo+TriggerType. A group starts expectedSplit=1. Only exact expected split is added;  skipped/duplicate/out-of-order splits are not reordered or retried. On key change flush previous nonempty dictionary, or append INFO_FCMIMGFFD_TSS3_005 with reconstructed missing-first frame. Reset dictionary and expected split1. Last-record flush is triggered by String.Equals(current,lastLogString), not by an index, so repeated identical last-string content can trigger early flush.

For occurrence frames high16==0000: split=floor(frame/512), occurrenceTrigger=((frame%512-1)%10)+1, set=ceil(decimal(frame%512)/10);  triggerType1 if trigger1 else2. Time-series high16!=0: split=floor(high16/512), trigger=low16+1, set=((high16-512*split-1)/10)+1 using signed integer division;  type3. Constants512 and10 are source static fields.

Missing-first display frame removes512*(split-1) from high16 for time-series, or low16 for occurrence, formats X4 and preserves other half. Group flush invokes LogAnalyserEB33List, HeaderData.Initialize, ImageFFDExtractDataParameter.AddParameter, appending Result.ErrorMessage. Output success/error lists are appended, not replaced. Both lists empty => Result.Failed(ERROR_FCMIMGFFD_TSS3_004). InvalidDataException is thrown by outer Extract for failed stages.

managed.title: ADU FCM/PVM/DMC source-present admission
behavior: ExtractFCM/PVM/DMC accept logPath, AbsoluteTimeAnalyzer, ref List<ImageFFDExtractData>, ref List<ErrorImageFFDExtractData>, return informational string, and append supplied lists. One reader processes metadata then encryption then payload;  no rewind.

FCM/PVM seek623542,min10chars,spec=Substring(6+2*Target,2),TargetFCM0/PVM1. FCM specs08/0B; PVM03/06. DMC seeks6212C3,min8,spec[6:8],only03. Unknown spec => familyERROR_*_002;  malformed metadata => ERROR_*_001;  outerInvalidDataException with trailingCR/LF removed.
FCM/PVM625B41,min10,encrypted=(hexByte[8:10]&0x80)>0. DMC625101,min8,encrypted=([6:8]==01) OR whenlength>=10([8:10]==01);  exact string equality not mask for DMC.

If spec remains empty andEOF return empty text without output. Spec found but encryption missing consumes payload while seeking encryption and does not replay it. No distinct missing-metadata failure in helper.

Collect7101 excludinglength10.7101D000 is map:UDD[10:16],RID[20:24],SSRs=[24:] chunked8chars. Minimum>=24 or exact20; exact20 succeeds without map entry.
