Successful compression ->MoveJsonDirectory(work,root,false) recursively DELETES generated JSON root (not backup in normal call). Delete upgraded _NEW.TSE in per-file success path.

Any handled conversion/read/write/compress nonzero reports status and leaves ENTIRE remaining batch; does not continue next target. Method can return true after handled conversion failure: async task success is not all-files conversion success.
algorithm.backup_branch: MoveJsonDirectory(...,backup=true) moves root to _Bak/<lastComponent>_<Utc yyyyMMddHHmmssfff>; normalcaller passes false.

errors: Upgrade code101/103/106/default ->read-error class;102/107 ->write-error class. Async inner exception catch sets result_flag=false and outputs message+stack.
cleanup: Async wrapper finally unlocks controls after completion. GFCDeleteStoreData occurs ONLY at ordinary TseConvert bottom, not outer finally; exceptions before bottom can leak native handle. FileStream inside per-file try disposed in finally. Failed handled file may retain upgraded _NEW.TSE/generated tree/partial GTSE; no rollback.

algorithm.encoding: Locale.CodePage==0 ->Encoding.Default.CodePage else supplied; Encoding.GetEncoding chosen for binary strings. Template always Shift_JIS TextFieldParser, CommentTokens=["#"], delimiter comma, HasFieldsEnclosedInQuotes=false.
algorithm.admission: Progress.Report before file checks. Template absent->-1; input absent->-2. Direct columns indexing, no schema/header verification. First15 name columns hierarchy; GetKeyName selects last nonempty. Col15 Type,16 Size,17 SizeF,18 IsList,19 LevelF,20 ExistF,21 PositionF,22 PositionSkipF.
algorithm.projection: After recursive binary parse, GetFatData removes top-level ヘッダ情報 and 初期車両情報. Empty result ->-21; 15-level dictionaries, repeated list keys first unnumbered then _002/_003...; BOOL and ring data retain RawValue.

errors: FileNotFound templatephase -1/inputphase-2; template exception-11; binary parse exception-12; parse OOM-91; flatten exception-13/OOM-92. Recursive parser return count is not a separate validation gate.
cleanup: TextFieldParser/BinaryReader/file streams disposed by finally; no cancellation.

traversal: Iterate template index from start through endpoint while stream.Position<Length. Construct BinaryStructure from current row Type/SizeF/IsList/LevelF/ExistF/PositionF/PositionSkipF.
PositionF==1 resets section state at current stream offset and checks configured skip name; scanner -1 skips row, positive scan result seeks to it. System(ECU) row increments ECU counter.

ChkDataExistCase false skips dependent subsequent ExistF==1 rows until SizeF12 boundary. True with nonblank Size reads value; pending SizeF1 state substitutes PRIOR value as size for next nonblank-size row.

PositionF2 treats the consumed value as marker; compare dictionary case-insensitively; advance template skipping PositionSkipF1 rows or ECU block through ＊ECU最終位置, synthesize header/reset state when next PositionF1 found. Some section boundaries rewind stream exactly8bytes so outer traversal re-reads marker.
SizeF1 sets next-size flag; SizeF2 on System(ECU)数 stores ECU list count; SizeF11 updates/sets dic_exist_case_keys[key]=value. Add node.

If next row IsList numeric greater than current: locate child template interval while next IsList>=initial child level; allocate current node ChildList; recurse once for each count from1..Cast_ToInt(current.Value), appending children; advance parent past child-template block. No validation of negative/huge count or end indexes beyond ordinary exceptions.
algorithm.marker_scan: Physical record8bytes, shape FF FF FF FF selector FF FF FF. Generic scanner recognizes selectors0x01..0x33 and0xFE; ECU skip restricts0x30,0x33,0xFE. Position dictionary values are 8byte logical hex strings FFFFFFFFFFFFFF<selector>; scanner byte location is not same string byte order.

conditional_presence.default: true if function missing/unrecognized or not SizeF12.
conditional_presence.healthcheck: For ヘルスチェック+SizeF12 default false; ダイアグ数(Current/Pending/History/Permanent) included iff Version情報=="0"; ダイアグコード取得コマンドデータ included iff Version情報!="0"; other SizeF12 keys remain false.
conditional_presence.recorder_versions: SizeF12 通信フレームのID: if バージョン_L5_1(ObjectVer)>3 mutate Type=WORD,Size=2. へルプID if version>2 mutate Type=DWORD,Size=4. フレームインデックス and フレーム長 branches compare L4 ObjectVer>2 but BOTH paths return true (no actual gating).

errors: No local catch; parse/index/encoding errors propagate to BulkRead status mapping. Marker recovery is explicit scanner behavior, not generic validation/retry.

algorithm.dispatch: Type trimmed uppercase, Split('*')[0] selects base type; full type token retained for repetition count. Exact source comparisons override conventional C type expectations.

types.BYTE: ReadBytes(Size); ring-key sets RawValue byte[] and Value=""; other byte fields stringify source per layout.
types.WORD: ReadUInt16; *N type suffix loops and commajoins values
types.DWORD: ReadUInt32; *N suffix loops and hex string concatenates source values
types.SYSTEMTIME: Read eight UInt16; format {0}-{1}-{2}-{3}-{4}-{5}-{6}-{7}, widths4,2,2,2,2,2,2,3 (source sequence, not DateTime constructor)

algorithm.time_fields: 時系列の時間情報 =>hex X2 byte join. 時系列範囲開始/終了 =>ReadBytes(Size), hex X2 join in source order, Int32.Parse with NumberStyles0x203; GetTimeIndexRange second arg unused. No byte reversal here (ring parser timestamp separately reverses).

errors: ReadBytes may return short array at EOF; fixed-width readers throw. No normalize/sign-extension based on familiar C type names.

algorithm.inputs: Dictionary keys フレームテーブル,信号テーブル,リングバッファ. Frameインデックス and lengths parsed comma-separated int32. Signal count アイテム総件数; データモニタ信号 then _002... nested データモニタ信号情報. MUL/DIV/OFFSET/minmax integer conversion then float32.
algorithm.frame_table: For each listed frameId: if dictionary already ContainsKey(frameId), BREAK ENTIRE frame loop; else dictionary[frameId]=lengths[frameId], NOT lengths[ordinal].
algorithm.records: byte[] ->hex X2 string; chunkChars=8+2*sum(frameLengths). WholeChunks yields final SHORT chunk too. First8 HEX CHARACTERS reversed by byte-pair then UInt32.Parse(HexNumber): 4-byte little-endian timestamp, NOT8 bytes. Frames follow in frame-table enumeration order.
algorithm.frame_split: For each configured frame consume min(frameLength*2,remaining hex chars); exhausted subsequent frames become empty strings. No sorted order or alignment repair.
algorithm.signal_slice: Substring(startByte*2,min(byteLen*2,wholeFrameHex.Length)); cap does NOT subtract start offset. Numeric conversion is called BEFORE datatype4 raw character conversion, so text may throw numeric parse before char branch.
algorithm.byte_order: Numeric signal payload hex substring is NOT little-endian reversed. Only timestamp uses ConvertLittleEndian; it reverses byte pairs and ignores unmatched final nibble.
algorithm.signed: byteLen=(endBit-startBit)/8+1 C# integer division; signed>0 parses SByte/Int16/Int32/Int64 HexNumber for widths1/2/4/8, other widths use raw0. Signed path ignores bit mask and shift.
algorithm.unsigned: UInt64.Parse(hex,HexNumber) & signExtendedInt64(int32Mask), then shift right trailing zero count computed from reversed Convert.ToString(mask,2). Zero mask indexes beyond string and can throw.
algorithm.mask: int32 mask=0; lo=startBit%8; hi=endBit-startByte*8; for j=0..byteLen*8-1: mask<<=1; if lo<=j<=hi mask++. int32 overflow retained. E.g startBit1,endBit3,width1 ->mask0x70, not0x0e.
algorithm.engineering: float32 y = ((floatRaw*MUL)/DIV + OFFSET) / (float32)Math.Pow(10,decimalPlaces). Value string=Single.ToString("F") CURRENT CULTURE/default2 digits, not decimalPlaces formatting.
algorithm.character_type4: Each selected hex byte ->int32->char; no multi-byte text encoding and no null trim.
algorithm.column_rows: Per-signal columns filter rows with matching frameID preserving original record order. No sort, interpolation or common-timestamp union.

errors: No local catch for malformed hex, short chunks, frame-id/array lookup, zero-mask, divide-by-zero results, or invalid substring bounds; exceptions propagate. WholeChunks has no size>0 validation.

algorithm.signals: Parse ring and transpose columns, optionally retain selected PID list. Processing destructively removes signal metadata entries from source dictionary AND matched parsed column from mutable list; not a pure projection.
algorithm.reference_time: Create rawTimestamp->relativeTime map ONCE from first nonempty selected signal. relativeTime=unchecked uint32(rawTimestamp-baseTime). For duplicate rawtime keep first map insertion. Later series access SAME dictionary by exact timestamp; missing timestamp throws, no interpolation.
algorithm.rows: SeqNumber=ordinal+1. GetRingBuffData_PassedTimeIndex finds exact passedTime and returns zero-based index nullable; GetRingBuffData_SeqNumber exact recordTime ->first sequence nullable.
algorithm.triggers: Emit only when raw trigger timestamp exists in reference-time map; convert to relativeTime; sequence exact match in FIRST signal-data array. No nearest-time snapping.
algorithm.flags: Emit only raw timestamps present in map; retain source ordinal+1 FlagNumber so filtered gaps remain. Memo from Note; optional exact seq.
algorithm.elapsed: GetElapsedTime uses LAST iterated signal-data/value pair rather than min/max/aggregate. Unit mapping MS/ミリ秒=>158; S/SEC/秒/TRIP=>71; else nullable.

errors: Unchecked empty-first-array/index use and exact-map missing keys can throw and propagate to writer error mapping.
notes: Compare/graph later trimming may renumber flags; do not apply graph mutation semantics to this source writer.

algorithm.ordering: Region/production/VIN calculation occurs outside WriteJsonFile catch. Inside catch writes tree, then info; later result can overwrite earlier result. Function-specific WriteData_* writes info.json then data.json under selected tree nodes. Root tree and per-function output are a sequence, not atomic transaction.
algorithm.serialize: WriteFile creates output FileMode.Create; JsonReaderWriterFactory UTF8 JSON writer owns stream; DataContractJsonSerializer UseSimpleDictionaryFormat=true; write directly to destination (no temporary replace).
algorithm.projection_scope: Recorder DataList,DriveRecorder/EFI32,ActiveTest,DualDataList,DualActiveTest paths join shared ring/marker projections above. DTC/HealthCheck/history/monitor DTO-specific scalar mappings retained in exact body evidence; no new binary/image business parser claimed here.

errors: OOM within WriteJsonFile catch ->-93; other exception ->-51. Pre-catch metadata extraction can escape.
cleanup: Close writers/streams in finally. Already written tree/info/data remains on failure; no rollback, no cancellation.

algorithm.source_admission: TrimEnd(backslash) on root; directory must exist else-2. Delete existing root/list.txt before recursive file snapshot.
algorithm.manifest: EnumerateFiles("*.*",AllDirectories) in filesystem enumeration order. For each file read complete bytes, append fixed20byte salt e7b77797f2e62ce74b5dc58f8d15c82c574d8a4a, SHA256 uppercase X2. No normalized path sort.
algorithm.file_read: Allocate byte[file.Length as int]; FileMode.Open,Read; repeated Read(min(1024,remaining)) until remaining0. Read==0 does not break => can stall if source shrinks/truncates concurrently.
algorithm.manifest_text: Shift_JIS list.txt; header line "Target Folder"; each relative Uri.MakeRelativeUri.ToString.Replace(slash,backslash)+" : "+hex; URI escapes NOT decoded. Last tuple via Equals(list.Last()) has no trailing newline; empty list.Last throws.
algorithm.zip: CreateFromDirectory(root, parent/rootTemporaryName, Optimal,false,Shift_JIS entry encoding). temp name="temp_"+DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddmmssfff")+".zip"; format omits HOURS and uses minutes after day.
algorithm.destination: target=Path.Combine(destinationDir,gtseName). DELETE existing target THEN File.Move(tempZip,target). Failure can lose prior archive and leave tempZip.
algorithm.progress: Progress overload starts 1000ms Timer, calls core, stops and disposes timer; no cancel token.

errors: delete IO -2 /other-1; enumerate/hash/write manifest IO-12 /OOM-91 /other-11; zip/move IO-22 /OOM-92 /other-21.
cleanup: File streams/SHA disposed by finally. No restoration of deleted list.txt/oldGTSE, no deletion of partial zip on failure.

algorithm.input: Main no args=>return; first argument only is parameter JSON path. Start(...).Wait(). ReadJsonFile<T> uses FileStream Open and stream deserializer; catches any failure ->null.
algorithm.prepare: If nonnull params: await connect(ConnectionName); set language/UserSettingUnit; call UnitConverter.Prepare only when unit settings nonnull; Translate.GetJsonFile(url,language); use nullable OutputDataType.Value (missing can throw).
algorithm.dispatch: Launch ALL file conversion tasks before awaiting. EXACT case-sensitive FunctionId=="DualDataList" OR "DualActiveTest" dispatches dual parser, everything else ordinary parser. Await normal WhenAll then dual WhenAll; errors swallowed in catch, inspect each task separately.
algorithm.dual_rename: For successful dual tasks replace requested filename placeholders with returned translated ECU names sanitized by removing [\/:*?"<>|]. File.Move(originalDestination,expandedDestination), no overwrite. On exception print Error and DELETE originalDestination. Other task failures print task exception.
algorithm.destructive_finalization: Start broad operation catch swallows exceptions. Cleanup deletes the PARAMETER JSON PATH even for malformed/null params, THEN awaits disconnect. Common.FileUtility.Delete: if exists and ReadOnly, set attributes Normal0x80, then File.Delete. Delete failure can skip disconnect (no independent finally).

errors: No cancellation input. Async Wait can expose outer task fault; broad internal catches are not evidence of successful export. Filename expansion failure can delete a completed temporary CSV.

algorithm.path_checks: Null source/dest ->ArgumentNullException; suffix .json/.csv required via EndsWith OrdinalIgnoreCase(5), otherwise ArgumentException; no content validation before destination creation.
algorithm.ordered_effects: Path overload opens source FileMode.Open then destination FileMode.Create (truncates prior CSV), constructs OutputCsvForGTSPlus and emits common header BEFORE function data parser admission/completion. Invalid function/JSON may leave truncated/header-only output.
algorithm.stream_checks: Null streams rejected; supported FunctionId gate. Function parser exceptions wrapped DataCannotParseException("Failed to parse. See inner exeption.",inner); unsupported-selector gate is outside wrapper.
algorithm.dictionary_json: Function source DataContract DTO deserialize, not alternate generic JSON parser. JsonConverter string APIs use SimpleDictionary settings; stream interface uses DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(T)) without setting SimpleDictionary.

errors: Original output is not restored after parse failure. No overwrite opt-in, cancellation or atomic rename.
cleanup: File streams in path overload disposed finally. OutputCsv StreamWriter AutoFlush=true but not separately disposed by parser; owns its destination stream if directly used/disposed.

algorithm.rows: NonDS: region1 layout1;region2/4 layout2;region3 layout3; unknown no vehicle row. DS:region3 layout1;region2 layout2;others no vehicle row. Then mileage row, production-date row, VIN row,blank.
algorithm.nonDS_vehicle: VehicleName region1/3=IT3_Model else VehicleName; ModelYear region1=IT3_ModelYear,2..4=ModelYear elseempty; type region1=VehicleType,3=first(VehicleType,IT3_ModelCode),2/4=first(VehicleType,IT2_UserSelect1); engine1/3=first(IT3_EngineType,EngineType),2/4=first(EngineType,IT2_UserSelect2); brand1/3=IT3_Division,2/4=BrandName.
algorithm.DS_vehicle: Only regions2/3 select IT3_Model/IT3_ModelYear/IT3_Division, VehicleType and first(IT3_EngineType,EngineType); other regions empty. Options preserve configured source-order join.

algorithm.normalization: Aggregate SignalInfoList and SignalDataList to dictionaries via dict[SignalId]=value =>LAST duplicate wins (initial key insertion order remains). Intersect data.Keys with info.Keys, no sorting. Translation success substitutes metadata/ECU strings; null response keeps originals.
algorithm.datalist_selection: Use CustomList[0].PidIdList EXACTLY, not all signals or union customlists. For each PID select .Where(SignalId==pid).First(); absent metadata/data throws rather than silently skipping.
algorithm.active_selection: Synthetic target/current output first; selected PID set=Union(activeTestIDs,CustomList[0].PidIdList) preserving first occurrence. Target category DataType1 if categories supported else2; current initially2, category exceptF02. Current metadata aliases only panels N04,N05,F03,M05 when CurValPidId.HasValue and matching signal exists; BinaryFormatter DeepCopy metadata then replace ID/name/nameID.
algorithm.active_values: min==max expands bounds +/-1; target display "-" replaced empty.
algorithm.dual: Convert base and dual ECU data independently, offset dual SignalId by10,000,000 for separate identity. Output complete base block, blank, then complete dual block. NO timestamp merge/alignment. Return translated ECU names for app rename.
algorithm.calculated_load: Only ECU ID0x222 AND info SignalId0x151 present: access signals0x14f numerator and0x150 denominator directly; parse bool results ignored. Denominator0 =>0 else numerator/denominator. Seq/time copied numerator by same ordinal (no alignment). Insert reconstructed337 info/data at info.Keys index of337; dual uses ID offset. Missing referenced data can throw.

errors: No missing-PID repair, timestamp reconciliation, row length padding, or fallback customlist. Duplicate dictionaries hide earlier source rows.
notes: Shared synthetic active-test ID literals and output projections pinned in ParserModule exact IL; not browser business duplicates.

algorithm.layout: ECU name,blank, translated r_item_i3663 formatted "{0} {1} \t{2}" with blocknumber literal1 and storedDate. Header resource r_item_i3511 + names; secondheader r_item_i3512 decimal dot replaced CurrentInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator + units.
algorithm.row_count: FIRST selected signal DataList.Count determines output rows and record time. Other series indexed SAME ordinal. No timestamp checks or shorter-series padding; first empty list means no rows even if later data exists.
algorithm.time: RecordTime integer milliseconds. seconds=t/1000, ms=t%1000, sec=seconds%60,minutes=seconds/60. Format "{0:D2}:{1:D2}{2}{3:D3}" with CURRENT decimal separator; no hours rollover.

output_types.1: DataStr as supplied; empty ->empty. Status/categorical labels retained even numeric isNaN.
output_types.2: Data NaN ->empty; else ToString("F6") CURRENT culture.
output_types.other: time-only rows; no sample values appended.

algorithm.text_format: TAB-delimited despite .csv suffix; base string[] writer joins delimiter without quoting/escaping. Raw tabs/newlines can create cells/rows. Default UTF8 StreamWriter, AutoFlush=true. Encoding-taking overload assigns Encoding field AFTER writer construction with UTF8; requested encoding does not change constructed writer.

errors: Mismatched list lengths/empty first-series indexing can throw; parser wraps as DataCannotParseException. No CSV RFC escaping or invariant-culture normalization.

algorithm.preparation: Prepare appends unit entries to static lists WITHOUT clear; then Init sets profile/translation. Signal decPntCount is SHARED static updated for each conversion; only pattern-map block locked, not all conversions.
algorithm.parseAsDouble: Initialize out NaN; first require Double.TryParse(str,currentculture). On success also Double.Parse(str,NumberStyles0x1ff,ca-ES) and en-US; comma anywhere=>ca-ES result; else dot=>en-US; else firstparse. Both additional Parses run, exceptions propagate into caller catch.
algorithm.linear: round(x*LSB+Offset,d), where round=Math.Round(x*10^d)/10^d (default MidpointToEven), rounding catch returns0; ValueStr=ToString("N"+d,currentculture), including grouping.
algorithm.reciprocal_bug: Source checks LSB==Double.NaN using IL beq. IEEE NaN equality is false, so intended100/x reciprocal path is not selected for NaN L/100km unit. Normal linear branch yieldsNaN; do NOT repair this during behavioral reconstruction.
algorithm.none: Value=roundedraw, ValueStr formats ORIGINALraw with "N"+d. Same ineffective NaN equality tests occur.
algorithm.hex: Int32.TryParse DECIMAL text; ToString("X").PadLeft(ceil(bitLength/4),'0'); no truncation to bitlength; numeric value=int result.
algorithm.pattern: Cache by SignalId while map nonempty; create Dictionary<double,string>.Add from patterns; duplicatekeys throw/caught and may leave partial map. Convert numeric toint32 (truncate) then lookup; missing ->empty label.
algorithm.minmax: If numeric>=Max clamp Max and use label from MAX PATTERN KEY; <=Min clamp Min + MIN PATTERN KEY label; interior raw numeric.ToString. No sort/nearest search. Empty patterns can throw ->null result.
algorithm.time: conv.i4 seconds->TimeSpan(0,0,0,seconds).ToString("mm\:ss"), prepend "-" if rawnegative. Name convertTimeHHMM is misleading: minute component wraps60, not hours.
algorithm.rawtext: ConvData(Value=NaN,ValueStr=rawinput). Nonparseable numeric/status text likewise preserved as NaN with raw display string by fallback.
algorithm.catch: ConvertDataList broad catch ->null; callers do not all null-normalize.

algorithm.tuple: [id,LSB,Offset,displayName], y=x*LSB+Offset unless datatype selects another algorithm.
algorithm.genre_setting: 1 Temperature;2 Speed;3 AirPressure;4 AirFlow;5 Weight;6 VaporPressure;7 FuelPressure;8 AirPressure;9 VaporPressure;10/12/14 AirPressure;11/13/15 VaporPressure;16 Distance;17 Volume using FuelConsumption setting1->unit2,2->unit3,elseunit1;18 FuelConsumption;19/20 Distance. Default unitID1 if no profile.
algorithm.genre_table: 1temp,2speed,3/6 absolute pressure (pressureType selects abs/gauge),4airflow,5weight,7fuelpressure,8/9 gauge pressure (type selects abs/gauge),10..15 otherpressure,16km,17volume,18fuelconsumption,19m,20mm. Unknown genre=>identity unit1/LSB1/Offset0/emptyname. Find configured ID firstmatch else null.
algorithm.labels: Translated labels may replace built-in names, so raw display constants are not invariant output.

algorithm.json: DataContractJsonSerializer UTF8. String APIs simple dictionary enabled; stream interface default constructor without simple dictionary override. Serializer strips __type property using regex "\"__type\":[^,}]+(,|(?=}))". Serializer errors rethrow; MyJsonDeserializer catches->default(T); Try returnsfalse with out not replaced on failure.
algorithm.copy: BinaryFormatter.Serialize object to MemoryStream; rewind Position0; Deserialize; finallydispose. In-memory DTO deep-copy only, not file admission. Errors propagate.
algorithm.translation: GET url+"/resources/"+language.ToLower()+"/resource.json"; HttpClient.GetAsync(ResponseHeadersRead), EnsureSuccessStatusCode, ReadAsStringAsync, DataContract deserialize stores dictionaries. Exception ->empty dictionaries. Missing resource keys ->empty string (not key-name fallback).

cleanup: All owned streams disposed. Http/network is typed external side effect; source bodies analyzed, no requests executed.

algorithm.selector: Function matching OrdinalIgnoreCase(5). SetFuncData clears ALL typed cached records first, then deserializes chosen data from RDRootDir/RDFileData/StoredDataPath/data.json; unsupported throws. Dual parses base then creates dual items and distinct signal dictionary. DDR obtains cacheDataGUI/cache data path separately.
algorithm.basepath: ResumeLoad derives StoredBasePath via two parent directories from combined stored path, reads fileInfo.json there through platform REReadFile step2. No generic ZIP import in this method.
algorithm.load_steps: Step1 info.json ->FunctionID and flags; DDR requests cache GUI config, others background SetFuncData. Step2 fileInfo ->vehicleInfo.json parent(dataPath) step3. Step3 normal REStartDiagnosis then translation; DDR ready-window messages. StartDiagnosis success collects translation IDs, removes unusable IDs, requests translation or signals ready.
algorithm.profile: REGetUserProfile stores profile, loads language JSON async, gets SpecificFolderNo1. First returned folder only Trim(backslash). Request GetSettingFileInfo FileType2 KeyList=[specificSubFolders,tseFileWork1].
algorithm.errors: Receive callbacks catch/log source exceptions, do not uniformly unwind old state. Clearing cached types occurs before read/deserialize can fail.

cleanup: CloseConnectionAsync external websocket close; no cancellation/rollback transaction for local typed cache population.

algorithm.begin: Store object in TempSaveData. Choose hash list by GtsVersion split on dot: parse FIRST component int and test >2025. <=2025/malformed =>list.txt;2026=>list.cpt. Send VerifyHashFile{HashListName=StoredBasePath/hashlist,HashTarget=StoredBasePath}.
success_event_order: REVerifyHashFile.ReceiveSuccessEvent IL0000..0038 writes TempSaveData to data.json FIRST.

ONLY after write, IL003D..0052 reads VerificationResult. Iftrue: IL0086 File.Delete(oldhashlist), send CreateHashFile{HashTarget=StoredBasePath,HashListName=fullhashlist}. Iffalse: send save completion windowmessage (0x400,0x16,0x0f).
algorithm.failure_event: ReceiveFailureEvent ALSO writes TempSaveData to data.json atIL0038 and sends samecompletion; does not recreate hash.
algorithm.createhash: ReceiveSuccessEvent and ReceiveFailureEvent both signal completion; completion is NOT hash-success guarantee.
algorithm.native_boundary: Actual VerifyHash/CreateHash algorithm lives behind managed platform API; typed join only, no claim same salt/protocol as TSE.

errors: Callbacks catch exception, log ToString, swallow. File data may already change with failed verification or hash creation; no oldhash preservation.
cleanup: No rollback, no atomic data+manifest transaction, no cancellation token.

algorithm.read: FileMode.Open; DataContractJsonSerializer UseSimpleDictionaryFormat=true; deserialize runtime requestedT; exception rethrow; closefinally.
algorithm.write: FileMode.Create opens destination BEFORE serialize to MemoryStream. object.GetType picks runtime data type; DataContract simpleDictionarytrue; UTF8 decode memory and Replace("\/","/"); StreamWriter.Write; direct destination, not temp/replace. Even serialization failure can truncate existing file.

errors: Exceptions rethrow to caller callback catches.
cleanup: Nested stream/writer disposals finally; no restoration.

algorithm.targets: Clone selected non-DDR DataList/EFI32/ActiveTest/DualDataList/DualActiveTest via Clone(true); dual trims base and dual lists separately. DDR not a TrimSave write branch.
algorithm.window: Retain rows with trim_start<=RecordTime<=trim_end inclusive. Bounds-search predicates are called but results POPped: requested bounds are NOT snapped to existing row times.
algorithm.row_mutation: Build list using ORIGINAL sample objects, retain them then mutate SeqNumber=1..N and RecordTime-=trim_start. Replaces cloned arrays with these lists: original sample object references can also be mutated despite initial deep Clone(true).
algorithm.markers: Retain flags/triggers inclusive in window; subtract trim_start. seqNumber exact equality lookup against FIRST retained signal series; notnearest. getSeqNumber catches missing/empty and returns-1. Flags renumber retained1based; triggers no flag number.
algorithm.persist: Pass clone to WriteFuncData; all hash/save ordering above applies. UI TrimSave disables panel and shows loading while Task.Run executes, completion closure restores UI.

errors: Missing row match =>seq-1 after logged exception; no interpolation. Existing rows and flags may already be mutated before later failure.
cleanup: No rollback or separate immutable trim result guarantee.

algorithm.dirty_order: Set DataChangedFlg=true BEFORE actual mutation. Fetch flag list; add/update by FlagNumber (memo/time/pin) or remove matching FlagNumber; sort ascending RecordTime; renumber all flags1based; assign array to typed source data.
algorithm.ddr_difference: DDR flag getter returns empty list; flag setter DDR branch only tests IsTargetDdr and discards it (no record write). Trigger getter/setter DOES support DDR.
algorithm.failure: Exceptions logged/swallowed, dirty flag not reset on failure.
algorithm.sampling: First nonempty converted series: Math.Round(last.RecordTime / series.Count,0), NOT delta/(N-1) nor minimum sample interval. Default/error=>0.
algorithm.timing: Nearest-frame search uses minimum absolute time difference and first matching tie; exact marker seq lookup is a different operation.

algorithm.functions: Only DataList/ActiveTest typed compare load paths. Each compare index has its own source data and converted dictionary; two records are not merged into one timeline.
algorithm.match: Iterate BASE signal info order. Search FIRST counterpart in remaining other list. If both SignalNameId are nonzero, require exact ID equality; unequal nonzero IDs NEVER fallback to name. Otherwise compare exact SignalName string. Remove matched counterpart fromremaining (no reuse). Ignore unit/ECU equality as matching condition.
algorithm.matched_row: Base SignalId retained; counterpart ID=-99 ifmissing; display placeholder="-". Initial display firstsampleDataStr, NaN sortvalue=Double.MaxValue else numeric. Name/unit sourced BASE metadata. ActiveTest [Target]/[Current] classification affects fixed ordering.
algorithm.unmatched: Append each remaining counterpart originalorder: baseID=-99, placeholders, own name/unit.
algorithm.time: Each source uses FIRST selected signal timeline independently. Globalstart Min(two starts),globalend Max(two ends); errors start0/end-1. Pairing does NOT interpolate, synchronize, convert units between source records, or merge row timestamps.

algorithm.pin: UpdateFlg(index,flag,pin) looks up FlagNumber in CPDataList[index].GetFlagInfoList and ONLY assigns Pin. No Memo/RecordTime mutation, renumbering, dirty/persistence/hash write path in this method.
algorithm.point: Index0 selects CP1 point-change path; any other index CP2. Separate source timelines remain separate.

errors: Exceptions logged/swallowed.

algorithm.request_id: DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddhhmmssfff") (12-hour hh)+SerialNumber.GetAndAdd().ToString("0000"); oldcounter returned then increment; >9999 resets0; no lock.
algorithm.envelope: Common.Ack nullable0; Free.FreeMsg=RequestID. API map CN000001 SetConnectionCondition, CN000002 CreateChallengeCode, CN000003 CheckApiAuthentication, SC000001 StartDiagnosis, DV000074 GetTranslatedString.

ordered_behavior: Controller constructor retains commonInfo/headerPaneController, owns EventDispatcher and nullable model/view. init(storedId) constructs stored model/view, opens loader, awaits view.initView, registers LINK_BTN, calls model.getStoredActivityReport({storedId}) via activity_report.getStoredActivityReport, then setViewArea; catch inherited controller.onErrorCommon; finally closes loader.

Worker init retains commonInfo/ecuCache, installs exactly activity_report.getStoredActivityReport/getStoredInfo handlers bound (model,param), constructs StoredDataManager. Worker API only forwards supplied objects with GtsWorkerApi.send; worker command payload is read from param.parameter.

getStoredActivityReport resets storedCache then sequentially awaits StoredDataManager.instance.getStoredActivityReportData(storedId,true), getStoredFileInfoData(true), getStoredVehicleInfoData(0,true). These are existing stored-session inputs, not a fresh ECU report capture. Gets setting file {fileType:2,keyList:[languageList]}; parses apiArgs.fileData as gts.util.SettingType.ARRAY, or [] on request rejection. All other worker errors reject unchanged through onErrorCommon.

getStoredInfo forwards {relativePath} to mgr.getStoredInfo and returns its {storedId,functionId}; manager matches dataMap.path suffix (first match), coerces numeric key or retains string, default {storedId:0,functionId:undefined}. View link->controller evt.detail.args[1]->model.getStoredInfo(relativePath)->controller linkBtn event(storedInfo). This promise has no local catch/loading dialog/retry.
dispose empties view through disposeView, disposes controller dispatcher and resolves. showHelp opens createHelpInfoUrl(commonInfo,gts.SPECIFICATION_ID.ACTIVITY_REPORT) in _blank.
createViewData splits raw activityReportData on newline; initializes userInfo/vehicleInfo/gtsInfo mainInfo/detailInfo plus misspelled acticityReportlist and languageList.

Baseline user fields come from fileInfo userName,userId,dealerName,region,country,userType,language. GTS fields mode,vim,vimFirmwareVersion,gtsVersion also come from fileInfo; VIN/decisionVin/options from vehicleInfo. selectParameter selects first truthy candidate (not first defined).

DS4 and destination DESTINATION_DH.OTHER(2): vehicleName=[vehicleName], modelYear=[IT3_engineType,IT3_modelYear], vehicleType=[IT3_modelCode], engineType=[IT3_model]. Other DS4: [IT3_model],[IT3_modelYear],[IT3_modelCode],[IT3_engineType]. Non-DS4: [IT3_model,vehicleName],[modelYear,IT3_modelYear],[vehicleType,IT3_modelCode,IT2_userSelect1],[IT3_engineType,engineType]. This exact apparent model/engine swap is preserved, not corrected.
Mileage blank unless Number(mileageInfo.value)!==0 OR mileageInfo.unit!==empty. Then convertODOMeter(value,1,commonInfo.unitSetting), Math.round value and stringify; displayed odo=value+unit.

For each nonempty line JSON.parse; if userInfo exists replaces entire result.userInfo, else vehicleInfo replaces entire result.vehicleInfo, else gtsInfo replaces entire result.gtsInfo, otherwise append record. Per-line exceptions only outputLog and continue. Metadata overrides therefore preserve log values even if inconsistent with baseline/session. No schema validation or recovery merge.

initView loads activity_report/s11200-01.html gts_main_panel, sets document title r_item_i1479, hides function/status panes, appends status/view/control children, calls intentionally empty initEventHandler, draws resources, triggers resize; catches inherited view.onErrorCommon. dispose empties these panes and dispatcher.

translateResource JSON-deep-copies data; region 1/3/2/4 -> NA/JP/EU/OT; country getResourceCountry; user type getResourceUserTypeName or original; language uses data.languageList.filter(code===requested)[0].name || empty (missing match throws before fallback). decisionVin indexes [r_item_i0588,r_item_i0587,r_item_i0588,r_item_i0587,r_item_i0587]. mode strictly 1 uses r_item_i1564 else r_item_i1565.

setViewArea condition is literally data.userInfo.detailInfo.region===DESTINATION.NA OR transData.userInfo.detailInfo.region===DESTINATION.EU. Since translated EU is string EU but constant is numeric 2, normal numeric EU does NOT enter extended-user branch. Extended branch includes userName/dealerName; all branches display userId,translated region,country,type,language. Vehicle name,VIN,odo,recognition,type,engine,year,options joined
; GTS mode,VIM,firmware,version. Text values are appended as HTML, not uniformly escaped.

createActivityReportDom synthesizes leading dataType1 record(time:first.time,batteryVoltage:-,networkStatus:undefined,functionName:-) if a nonempty list starts with another type. It mutates the translated list only. convertTime splits time at space and takes hour:minute with no malformed-time guard.

Per record creates checkbox acd-check{index}, corresponding label class dataType{type}, detail class when applicable, time cell; title when functionName truthy else subtitle. Subtitle uses String(subTitle) HTML newline->
. dataType1 starts parent .list, flushes previous parent, title functionName + batteryVoltage/network 0->offline resource 1565,1->online 1564,otherwise -. Detail flag is next record exists and next.dataType!==1. Creates innerBox.

dataType2 appends accordion only. dataType3 appends accordion and detail span.text(detailInfo) iff defined. dataType4 appends accordion plus tables regardless of detail defined: each info header cells .html(head.value), body.record cells .html(reco.value). dataType5 adds link class, click bound to actRepo.link->view linkbtn. Final parent flushed at end; unrecognized dataTypes have no switch action. No client sorting/filter, upload, delete, or live ECU fetch in this report view.

Constructors create base controller/view/model/dialog and dispatchers; model retains fileInfo,tasCasesUrl,sendfile as undefined. init shows no-button S20400-DL-001 loading dialog immediately, awaits main view then worker initErrorReport({}), stores result.tasCasesUrl and misspelled result.sendFlie, fills list/control visibility, registers fileName/back/TAS events; inherited error catch; finally loading.close.

Click filename reads data.args[1] {fileName,isSent}, disposes main view, creates detail view and stores fileInfo, opens loader dialog, initView then worker getErrorReportDetail({fileName,isSent}); derives isOffline=!result.networkStatus; fills detail/control guards, registers back/save/TAS/dispose/send; inherited catch and finally closes dialog. No auto-save when leaving.

BackToHome triggers backToMainMenu; detail Back calls backS2040001: loading dialog->getErrorReportList({})->createS2040001->finally close. createS2040001 disposes old view, creates main view, clears model.fileInfo, repopulates result.dataList, restores TAS visibility and events. TAS uses window.open(cachedUrl,_blank).
Save opens loading dialog, sends {fileName,comment:view.getComment()}, catches inherited onErrorCommon, finally closes; no success UI/list refresh.

Dispose and Send both first show S20400-DL-002 r_msg_n0284 OK(r_item_b0022)/Cancel(r_item_b0021), autoClose true. Cancel resolves false and returns to list (does NOT keep editor); no destructive/send request. OK opens loading dialog and invokes deleteFile({fileName,isSent}) or sendErrorReport({fileName,comment}). Both inspect result.isProcessError; if true close loading, show S20400-DL-003 r_msg_w0285 single OK, reopen loader then rebuild list; otherwise directly rebuild list. Errors inherited catches; loading finally closed. No automatic retry.

Dialog001 title r_item_i1418, message r_msg_l0283 and no buttons. Dialog003 OK resolves undefined. Unexpected button IDs leave the deferred unresolved. showCommonErrorDialog passes sErrorCode,execResultCode with single OK labeled r_item_i0756. showHelp ERROR_REPORT opens help URL in _blank.

Model setters/getters store exact values including setSendFlie/getSendFlie spelling; getErrorReportDetail/deleteFile read fileInfo.fileName/isSent; save/send read fileName and supplied comment; init/list use {}. WorkerApi methods map unchanged to error_report.initErrorReport/getErrorReportDetail/saveErrorReport/deleteFile/sendErrorReport/getErrorReportList.
Controller dispose calls current view.disposeView, dispatcher.dispose and resolves; no work-folder deletion or send cancellation on dispose.

Both views replace #b_pane with corresponding template body, set document/title r_item_i1418, show title/hide function buttons, draw resources, set top position, register handlers and trigger resize. setViewAreaTopPos chooses first displayed v_s_pane then f_pane else s_pane; top=offset.top+parseInt(height)-40. Disposal empties cached body pane, disposes dispatcher, unregisters onResize.

Main list renders each dataList item as li.record with raw appended fileName and click event fileNameBtn(data). For DS4 suppress sent/unsent badges entirely, otherwise isSent true uses class send/resource r_item_i1462 else unsend/r_item_i1463. No list-side extension filtering or selection sorting; supplied order retained. TAS button visible iff URL truthy.

Detail uses .text for timestamp,countryCode,vehicleName,VIN,version,GUID,VIM name; comment textarea.val; composes VIM DLL/API first two pairs with full-width spaces/parens/slash. Clears image area then adds img src=data:{mimeType};base64,{imageData}. Comment disabled iff data.isError OR selected isSent.

data.isError hides save/send; otherwise shows both. isSent disables both. Else sendfile===0 disables send only; else offline disables send only; else enables both. DS4 then unconditionally disables send. No corresponding send prohibition in worker; UI alone enforces these guards. Dispose/back remain available even parse-error or sent report. TAS visibility independent of network.

Main binds back and TAS; dynamically created list entries bind filename. Detail binds back/save/TAS/dispose/send; handlers only dispatch their ViewEvent. getComment returns full textarea string, with no input length validator (only load-time truncation in worker).

Worker init retains commonInfo and commandThread and registers six exact error_report handlers. initErrorReport resets cache paths to empty strings, setting values to undefined, data/images and view data. Sequential setting reads all individually catch-and-continue: getSpecificFolder({folderNo:2})->apiArgs.folderInfoList[0].folderInfo as GTS base; getSettingFileInfo({fileType:1,keyList:[path,errorReportFileWork]}); {fileType:1,keyList:[path,errorReportFile]}; {fileType:1,keyList:[path,errorReportFileUnsent]}; work/sent/unsent paths=base+fileData.

Then getSettingFileInfo({filePath:commonInfo.settingFileInfo.distributorDepending.countryInformation.userType.filePath,keyList:[ConfirmTasCases,url]}) -> TAS URL, then {fileType:2,keyList:[errorReport,sendFile]} -> parseInt(fileData,10). Their failures retain undefined. Calls getErrorReportList and returns {dataList:result.dataList or [],tasCasesUrl,sendFlie:sendFile}; exact misspelling part of frontend protocol.

getErrorReportList resets data and viewData (including images/fileInfo/extracted paths). Queries sent folder then unsent folder {path} using getFolderInformation, independently swallowing rejection. Takes every fileInfoList entry without file/directory/extension filter, maps {fileName,isSent:true/false}, concatenates sent first then unsent, sorts ascending lexicographic fileName comparator (equals0,less-1,else1), returns {dataList}. No native deletion/movement inferred from folder naming.

getErrorReportDetail captures fileName/isSent, uses existing cache. First deletes {path:workFolderPath+\*}; failure swallowed. Removes last filename extension via /\.[^/.]+$/ to construct extraction folder workFolderPath+\+baseName. extractFile {fromPath:(isSent?sentPath:unsentPath)+\+fileName,toPath:folderPath}; stores apiArgs.

getFolderInformation({path:folderPath}); findFileName clears capFileNameList and errFileName. Chooses lexicographically greatest fileName matching new RegExp(^err_.*.log$) (dots in pattern are unescaped). If chosen, image pattern ^cap_+errName.slice(4,-4)+.*.jpg$ (also unescaped dots); collects matching filenames; sort comparator a-b on strings retained literally (typically NaN, not lexical).

If no errFileName reject; else readFile({path:folderPath+\+errName}), JSON.parse(apiArgs.data); if body.vehicleInfo truthy JSON.parse its nested string. Store cacheData.fileInfo. Sequentially readImageFile({imageFilePath:folderPath+\+capName}) and push each apiArgs. getDateTimeLocaleFunc intentionally resolves without request.

Return viewData {data:{timestamp,comment,countryCode,vehicleName,vin,version,guid,vimName,vimDll0/vimDll1/vimApi0/vimApi1 default empty},images:[],isError,networkStatus:commonInfo.getNetworkStatus()}. body.errorInfo.timeStamp Date.parse->Date local getFullYear/month+1/day/hour/minute/second -> gts.util.convertLocaleTime(dateObj); truthy comment sliced [0,2048).

Vehicle name prefers categoryNameList categoryId===12 contentsName, then carInfoList id===4 value, else empty; VIN=vehicleInfo.vinCode. Version/GUID from gtsplusInfo; VIM name and first two versionList dllVersion/apiVersion if present. Country code from pcInfo.osInfo.countryCode. Each truthy cached image becomes {mimeType,imageData}.

Any extraction/list/read/JSON/image/projection error sets isError=true then calls same createReturnValue against whatever cached data/images exist; partial prior data can be displayed, because this method does not reset fileInfo/images itself. It does not retry or delete extraction folder on return; next detail load clears work wildcard. Error inside the recovery createReturnValue itself can still reject.

saveErrorReport gets selected fileName and comment, ensures fileInfo/body shells but leaves errorInfo undefined when absent. Object.assign(fileInfo.body.errorInfo,{comment}) therefore can throw on malformed missing errorInfo. Nested vehicleInfo temporarily JSON.stringify before serializing whole file then JSON.parse back. Serialization path returns JSON string.

Sequential requests: writeFile({path:expandedFolder+\+errFileName,mode:1,data:json}); archiveFile({compress:1,fromPath:expandedFolder,toPath:workPath+\+fileName,overwrite:true}); copyFile({fromPath:workPath+\+fileName,toPath:unsentPath+\+fileName,overwrite:true}); returns undefined. Entire failure path also resolves undefined: save success is not proven by UI resolution.

deleteFile chooses sent/unsent folder from supplied isSent and calls {path:folder+\+fileName}. Rejection sets isError=true and continues. Always refreshes getErrorReportList and returns {dataList,isProcessError:isError}. Does not delete expanded work copy here.

sendErrorReport first awaits saveErrorReport (whose failures are swallowed), then sendErrorReport({errorReportFilePath:unsentPath+\+fileName}); API rejection sets isError=true and continues; refreshes list and returns {dataList,isProcessError:isError}. No sent-file movement, server request schema, endpoint, success acknowledgment transformation, retry, or upload cancellation is implemented in these bodies. Sending an older archive after swallowed save error is not excluded by frontend logic.

All report filesystem/send calls cross GtsPFApi->GtsPFRawInterface unchanged except shared writeFile chunking: max 20,000,000 string units per call, first original mode, subsequent mode2; intermediate receiveAck false, last original. Request IDs retained separately; API names do not establish native execution role.

Live constructor owns main/currentView/cmnDlg/model plus EventDispatcher and ActivityLogger. init logs title r_item_i2855, constructs live view/dialog/model, forms resources.printPattern using r_item_i3161..i3166 with r_item_i6160/i6161 between 3164 and3165; shows noninteractive DL001.

Live init awaits initDmcHealthCheckReport({resources}), then processBatteryFunc. If initArgs?.isStoredData true skip all battery requests; else connectBattery()->getSignalValue(batteryKind), swallowing any battery failure. Next readTemplateJsonFile with swallowed rejection. Then calls mainView.initView().then(bind events,createViewData,setValueByViewData,await convertHcDataToReportData(initArgs.data),setHcViewData). Crucially this inner promise is NOT returned from outer then: outer finally closes DL001 before full view/conversion completion and caller init completion does not mean populated UI.

Stored init uses Stored view/dialog/model, same resource array and init/read-template sequence, never invokes its declared processBatteryFunc. That local function is present but unreachable in init; stored connectBattery/getSignalValue wrappers exist but not called from stored report path. Its view init/create/conversion inner promise is likewise not returned; stored conversion synchronous.

Worker init retains commonInfo/commandThread, registers nine dmcHealthCheckReport.* methods. initDmcHealthCheckReport resets cache.data to signalList:[],folderInfoList:[],printInfo:{},dmcTemplate:{} and retains resources; returns undefined. Both models use same WorkerApi; no live/stored flag passed to worker init; fresh cache reset prevents stored report from inheriting live battery signal values.

Model wrappers preserve named payloads: init {resources}; connect/read/create {}; live getSignalValue {batteryKind}, stored helper getSignalValue {} (unused by normal stored init); saveTemplate {tel,staffName,staffFile,staffPict}; add {name,comment}; update {id,name,comment}; delete {id}. WorkerApi direct send dmcHealthCheckReport.<sameMethod>. CREATE_VIEDW_DATA constant spelling maps correctly to createViewData.

Print event controller starts DL001, saveTemplate with tel,staffName,staffFile,staffPict or empty when no filename, then activity log text subtitle r_item_i3016 retainedData=chosen print pattern label; finally closes DL001. It does not await or initiate browser print itself (view opens report window independently).

Exit dispatches BackToPrevScreen; parent health-check owns return transition. dispose calls currentView.disposeView; nulls current/main/model; disposes controller dispatcher. No worker command cancel/disconnect/template rollback/report-window closure in dispose.

input_provenance.separation: Enhanced/generic captured DTC rows come from parent health-check input; only live optional battery signal enrichment is newly requested by report worker.

ordered_behavior: connectBattery reads commonInfo.getMountedEcuInfoList(), detects ECU619/632. Filter HEV battery table: if619 mounted exclude632; else if632 mounted exclude619; else retain all. Deduplicate ecuId order. HEV complete iff every required ID in mounted list; BEV complete iff every ID in BEV table mounted. Exactly one complete set required: HEV&&!BEV->kind1, !HEV&&BEV->kind2; neither or both reject without checking connections.

Sequentially for chosen required IDs call checkEcuConnect({groupId:ecuInfo.groupId,ecuId:ecuInfo.ecuId,busId:ecuInfo.busId}) using commonInfo.getEcuInfoByEcuId. Only apiArgs.connect===1 accepted; any other value or API rejection rejects; entire live init catches and continues without enrichment. Returns numeric batteryKind only after all required checks.

getSignalValue({batteryKind}) maps kind1 to ECU620 PIDs[288,297], kind2 to ECU398 PIDs[288]; other kind leaves ecuId undefined/PIDs[] and may fail getEcuInfoByEcuId/field access. startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}) then getSignalValue({signalIdList:pidIdList}); cache signalList=response?.apiArgs?.signalList??[]. Signal request rejection rejects; once start succeeded, finally endGeneralComm() with no argument. If start fails, end is not called. end failure can replace success; parent catches all.

No explicit battery communication abort/cancel UI, polling, retry, PID value conversion or unit selection. Exact captured signal.data strings are used in report; connection/native implementation not inferred.

readTemplateJsonFile gets specific folderNo1 -> cache.folderInfoList, reads first.folderInfo+\HCReport\printInfo.json then +\HCReport\dmcTemplate.json. Each read API failure is swallowed; JSON parse failure resets corresponding {}. getSpecificFolder failure stops reads and is swallowed at outer catch. No existence/create-directory call or fallback folder supplied.

createViewData returns companyInfo, default undefined/empty vehicleInfo skeleton (not populated elsewhere in this method), userInfo, printPattern/templates and ecuBatteryItems. Company name/dealer name come from current commonInfo.settingFileInfo?.pcSetting?.dealerInformation; tel/staff/file/pict from local printInfo.company, not stored captured vehicle data. User fields receiptNumber,address,userName,registrationNumber,vehicleModel,chassisNumber,brand,registrationDate,odometerReading,receptionDate come from current commonInfo.sharedData.hcLinkageInfo?.userInfo or empty; workDescription and month always empty.

All eight print patterns exist internally. IDs1/2 customer pink/blue pattern2 visible;3/4 HEV initially hidden;5/6 BEV initially hidden;7/8 old pink/blue visible and two background image files. Image language is unconditionally ja, not current UI language. Match signal288/297 only if signalId strict equality and signal.data truthy; both present->display3/4 and voltage/capacity data; only288->display5/6 and voltage,capacity empty; absent288->leave battery patterns hidden even if297 exists. Numeric0 data is absent by truthiness; string0 present.

createTemplateList always starts {id:B:0,kind:0,name:empty,comment:empty}. printInfo.templateList -> P:{index},kind1 retaining name/comment, then dmcTemplate.templateList -> D:{index},kind2. No filtering/sort/duplication-name validation. Kind distinguishes editability, not native role.
saveTemplate mutates printInfo.company to exactly {tel,staff,file,pict} then writes full JSON.stringify(printInfo) path printInfo.json mode1. write failure swallowed, memory remains changed.

addNewTemplate ensures printInfo.templateList[], captures old combined list, deep-copies private templateList, unshifts {name,comment}, writes JSON.stringify({templateList:newList}) mode1 (NOT full printInfo; company omitted from this write). Success updates only cache.printInfo.templateList and returns rebuilt combined list; failure returns old list.

updateTemplate finds id in combined list; absent returns old list without write. Builds only kind1 rows, replacing at matching combined-list index with {name,comment}, writes {templateList} mode1; success updates list/cache; failure old list. No worker check to forbid updating B/D IDs, but mapping only kind1 means such IDs do not alter private entries.

deleteTemplate builds kind1 rows except matching id and writes {templateList} mode1 even absent or B/D id. Same commit-on-write-success/old-list-on-rejection behavior. Both CRUD writes omit company from on-disk JSON while cached company persists until next reload. No rename rollback/retry/transaction/file deletion for template removal.

Live convertHcDataToReportData async returns {ecuCounts:0,detectedItems:0,detectedDtcs:0,cus2:1..6 arrays,cus2hev:1..5 arrays+hevBRItems:[],cus2bev:1..5 arrays+bevBRItems:[],cus1:1..3 arrays}. enhanced/generic arrays read hcViewData?.viewPane?.enhanced/generic?.rowData??[].

Computes HEV required table using presence of enhanced ECU619/632 (regardless ecuConnect) and same prefer619 exclusion; all IDs required across enhanced array. BEV likewise all IDs across enhanced. This is distinct from mounted/connected worker admission and not based on DTC values.

convCore combines CONV_REPORT_MAP.concat(CONV_REPORT_OEM_MAP) unconditionally for ALL OEMs; requires row.ecuConnect===1 AND first exact ecuId match in map; unconnected/unmapped drop (including their DTC counts). Maps classification kind/newKind/hevKind/bevKind and static reportName,static dtcs as detectedItems; actual row.dtcs?.length??0 as dtcs. Do not confuse static detectedItems with number of captured DTCs.

Enhanced mapped rows increment ecuCounts, sum detectedItems and dtcs, append {ecuId,ecuName,dtcs} preserving input order to cus2[newKind] and cus1[kind]; if complete HEV append to cus2hev[hevKind] else if BEV complete append to cus2bev[bevKind]. Generic mapped rows contribute only to detectedDtcs; do not increase ECU/item counts or category lists. Both array sources can count DTCs independently; no deduplication.

If HEV complete build report statuses for 電圧,電池容量,高電圧回路絶縁抵抗,セル間電圧バラつき,昇圧制御,内部抵抗,高電圧ヒューズ. Else if BEV complete: 電圧,電池容量,高電圧ヒューズ,セル間電圧バラつき,内部抵抗,高電圧回路絶縁抵抗. convDataBatteryStatus filters exact report table entries, selects enhanced rows with matching ECU IDs WITHOUT connection filter, and flags if any rowDtc.dtc is strictly in that ECU/report dtcs list. Returns {report,reportStatus:1 if hit else0}; triangle vs circle rendered by truthiness. If both sets complete HEV takes precedence here, unlike worker exclusive admission which rejects both.

Stored convert is synchronous and initializes ONLY counts,cus2,cus1. Same combined map/connected/mapped filter; optional crm fields; ecuName=crm.reportName truthy else row.system; detectedItems=crm.dtcs??0. Same enhanced/category and generic-DTC-only totals; no HEV/BEV complete checks, battery status lists or cus2hev/cus2bev. Normal stored report also has no live signals, so hidden battery patterns remain unavailable.

DTC ordering first timestamp support descending; numeric cycle ascending, elapsed ascending with undefined stamps last; absolute time compare formatted strings with missing last; dbIndex ascending, dtcCode lexical ascending, pending first on ties. Clone every row idx0; phase5/6 all-row odo=-; nonnormal clock or special469 all-row date/cycle/elapsed=-. All-row sort is a separate comparator using display strings, not numeric cycles; support first, missing cycle/elapsed last, lexical cycle/elapsed/date, dbIndex,dtc,pending. Return dataList per-system rows concat all-system rows; source retains exact comparator for unresolved equality cases.

ordered_behavior: CheckDmFile -> checkVimDlog({}); dmFolderValidation !== 0 sets isDataloggerValid=true. API rejection becomes {isCmdError:true,isDataloggerValid:false}; no exception escapes this command.

Controller stores both flags. isCmdError opens 003 Yes/No. Yes recursively runs checkDmFileFunc; nested finalizer resolves outer deferred with no value; No/default resolves with no value. State, not outer result, is used by continuation. Also writes unused typo ismCdError=true.

After CheckDmFile: error closes 001 and emits dashboard transition; valid flag closes 001 and opens 002 (remaining prior log); Yes ClearVim then CheckVim, No/default emits BACK_MAIN_MENU. Dialog 002 closes in finally.

ClearVim calls clearVimDlog({}), then returns commonInfo.getMountedEcuInfoList() as ecumap and assigns model.cache.ecumap (not cache.data). Rejection is swallowed and yields same return, so failure does not prevent CheckVim.
No prior-data flag proceeds directly to CheckVim while 001 remains open; 001 closes in finally on that branch.
CheckVim -> checkVimDrs({}) yields instPath default empty and dmBusPhaseList default []. On failure set isCmdError true and return same command result shape.

When checkVimDrs succeeds, split instPath on backslash, reverse, remove first filename occurrence to get directory; getFolderInformation({path:directory,includeFileList:[filename]}). Missing/empty files or folder error empties instPath but does not set isCmdError.

CheckVim result always includes mounted ecumap from commonInfo and assigns cache.ecumap. Controller saves only isCmdError in retry helper. Error opens 003; Yes recurses, catches common error, finally resolves outer deferred WITH ORIGINAL failed result; No resolves undefined. Thus retry success changes state but response3 can remain original failed response; No is guarded by isCmdError before dereference.

Successful state: save response3.instPath, dispose start view, construct/init main view, then save response3.ecumap and dmBusPhaseList and bind next/exit/link. These inner init promises are started, not returned to outer init completion.

Controller init starts the asynchronous admission chain but returns Promise.resolve from start-view then callback rather than returning checkDmFileFunc chain. There is no overall catch/finally for that admission chain; exact missing cleanup paths remain as written.

Reset customList=[]; getSpecificFolder({folderNo:1}); on error resolve error response and then attempt response.apiArgs.folderInfoList default []. Each returned folder sequentially enumerate path folderInfo+backslash+fileDataSetting1+backslash+ecuId with includeFileList:[*.json]. Each file sequentially readFile({path:...+filename}), JSON.parse data, customListInfo default []; if nonempty set ONLY first item cusId=1000 and push. JSON/read/enumeration errors swallowed. Multiple user files all receive 1000.

getDatMonSignalList({ecuId}); signalDataList default []; reset idList and isPidIdCalculatedLoadValue. ECU 546: PID337 sets calculated-load flag, PID335 and336 excluded; others append signalId to idList and retain signal. No other OEM branch.

Filter allData.pidIdList against returned allDatMonSignalList; if nonempty unshift allData into customList, else leave it out. cache.parameters takes allData.pidIdList. Each otherCustomList pid list filtered similarly; empty lists removed; retained appended after user lists and parameters concatenated.

parameters nonempty -> unique preserving first occurrence via Set; empty -> parametersLengthFlag=true and reject, stopping metadata. getDatMonList error propagates only when this flag is true; otherwise swallowed. parametersLengthFlag, parameters, allData and other cache are not globally reset on each command, so prior state can survive failures.

getTriggerItemList rejects locally when idList empty; otherwise request {ecuId}, cache triggerList. isPhaseType5(phaseType) -> add PID8100 iff absent; else for trigger IDs in DTC [29359,28348] or DTC_CHECK [29362,28349], append trigger.pidId without dedup. Any error swallowed.

Final return: if signalInfoList exists, getNewDatalist with cached parameters; filter those IDs to converters!==undefined, then map converter fields to signalId,signalName,unitName,genreId,dispInfoList projected {patternValue,dispName},dataMax,dataMin,decPntCount,defaultGraph:Line. It omits dataType and name/unit IDs in these projected entries. If metadata absent return only isDataMonitor and signalInfoList undefined.

Outer command catches any rejection and calls createReturnValue again, not a guaranteed success: if cached converter is null, filter !==undefined retains null and subsequent dereference can reject again. No fallback signal names or feature entitlement are inferred.
frontend.boundaries: PF wrapper translates custom-list names, signal list names/descriptions, metadata names/units/pattern display names and trigger names before worker transformations; exact wrapper references retained separately.

Build source by pid order using first raw metadata signalId match; defaultsrcData receives same objects. Destination shallow-copies saved items; dispItemIdList collects item.id but unused.

s37400_dl_010 appended to modal_dialog; static backdrop/keyboard false. On shown instantiate source and destination tabulators: width200,height300,fitColumns, single signalName column titled literal parameter, headerSort false, selectable true; populate arrays and update count/buttons. Add selected: no selection returns; compare signalName, not ID, against destination; append object iff name absent, then deselect only appended rows; setData destination. Remove selected deselects/deletes each row. All Remove clears destination. All Add REPLACES destination with entire current source (not union or name-dedup). Every action updates selected count and OK disabled iff count<1.

Sort cycles empty->asc->desc->empty. Asc comparator signalName<a returns-1 else1, desc opposite (equal names return1); default restores defaultsrcData; source only, destination unchanged. Label Sort by name plus ▲/▼.

setCustomList empties select; each option value=cusId; cusId0 label localized All Data, others customListName. Restore selectedIndex iff !=-1. Change finds FIRST customList entry with Number(select.val())===cusId; all user entries1000 therefore can select first duplicate. tgtCustomList initializes [] (truthy), so unmatched value is not caught by if(!tgtCustomList) and can fail at pidIdList. Reset sorting and source/defaultsrcData in target pid order; destination stays intact.

After snapshot init resolves save destination/index, bind snapshot OK/Cancel. Manager Cancel only disposes manager and leaves detail page.

initialization.support: Each radio disabled when no intersection with corresponding trigger ID array. initialization.conditions: Three independent selectors each contain value -1 localized <<Parameter select>>, then option value=paramDetailList index, signalId attribute, signalName text. Initially selectors, radios/arrows/clear/threshold sliders and AND/OR disabled; sliders min0 max1 value1. selectedOperatorId defaults AND. No duplicate-signal exclusion between selectors.

condition_editing: onClickCheckboxRadio obtains label for ID; only returns when attr(checked) === boolean true (not normal string). Clears checked ATTRIBUTE of every radio of same name, sets selected attribute true, refreshes all checkboxradio. Payload and updateBtnStatus read [checked] attributes, not :checked.

Type change enables condition selects only when type4, and enables quantity only then; calls setDisabledToTriggerConditionPane on all three without clearing existing selected parameter values. Nonparameter type therefore retains thresholds and checked condition radios; getTriggerInfo serializes any selected condition regardless of trigger type.

setDisabledToTriggerConditionPane clears min/max/current text/title and checked attributes only if selected parameter index<0; updates configParamMap[conditionId]; disables radio widget, arrows, clear and range iff disabled OR index<0. When enabled invokes matching threshold1/2/3 handler to refresh displayed value/boundaries.

Parameter change: disabled iff index<0. If valid and no operator [checked], mark equality (value1). updateBtnStatus runs before slider setup. Set configParamMap. Unit label .html(unitName|| ). Pattern list -> slider0..length-1,value0,step1, min/max pattern display labels; numeric -> min/max metadata,value=min,step=lsb. Initial decrement buttons disabled; increment disabled only if one pattern or numeric min===max.

All four arrow handlers are rebound after off(pointerdown). Immediate +/-1 or +/-10 steps; start repeated operation at100ms intervals after500ms; one document pointerup clears timeout/interval. Each step sets slider.val and triggers input. Range browser coercion handles actual value; threshold handler independently clamps local display value to min/max, disables decrement/increment on exact endpoints, then displays pattern dispName or numeric value with title. Threshold handlers1/2/3 are same algorithm with different config map/DOM indices.

Clear sets that panel select to -1, disables/clears its pane and updates buttons. If AND/OR enabled add selection class to saved button; disabling does not remove selected class. No explicit validation beyond these DOM states.

Duration, trigger-point, quantity input handlers only replace corresponding read-only text field. getOptionInfo, not used by controller, returns Number(signalId attribute) for each select whose val !== string -1.

OK/Cancel only dispatch; controller decides disposal. dispose removes body modal-open/all backdrops, hides trigger modal, empties all modal_dialog, disposes dispatcher; it has no explicit pending arrow timer cleanup outside document pointerup.

Missing operator undefined is not guarded before .length.

frontend.title: DRS settings request assembly, API order, retry and success
ordered_behavior: Controller reads snapshot.getTriggerInfo(), manager.getSelectedParameterList(), manager.getSelectedSignalIdList(), cached triggerList/signalInfo; show001. makeDrsFileFunc clears controller isCmdError then sends six named payload fields {triggerInfo,parameterList,signalIdList,triggerList,signalInfo,unitObj}. unitObj binds all 48 table label fields exactly as controller function body, pressure abs/gauge aliases share r_item_i0973..0982.

Worker deletes and recreates GLOBAL gts.util unit converter using passed unitObj; resets cache.isCmdError and isPidIdCalculatedLoadValue; reads selected cached ECU, mounted info, common vehicle options. It calls gts.util.createConverter, NOT datalogger.util.createConverter. No namespace alias is present in owned source or any authenticated member reference.

ECU546 only: when both335/336 metadata cached and selected signalIdList contains337, append335/336 IDs and raw metadata to parameterList.dataList (no dedup). These are acquisition-only inputs, later removed from imported displayed data.

For each configured trigger signal, nested-match raw selected data by signalId, build {dataType,genreId,signalId,value,decPntCount}; gts.util.createConverter returns converted METADATA object; assign returnedObject.value directly to trigger signal by intermediate array index. Actual shared converter converts bounds, not value, so this does NOT perform an inverse threshold conversion; absent bound fields can produce NaN bounds. Preserve mismatch and index-based assignment if source metadata lacks a match.

DTC type1 or check-mode7: phase5 set triggerPidId8100, append it unconditionally and append matching raw signal metadata if found. Nonphase5 iterates matching trigger IDs and retains LAST trigger.pidId, then only if not already in signalIdList appends ID and matching metadata. Regardless of found metadata/PID, append {signalId:triggerPidId,conditionType:6,value:0,genreId:0,dwUnit:1} to triggerParameterInfo.signalInfoList. No dedup of existing threshold entries.

vehicleInfo options: iterate optionList keys if nonempty, project {id:Number(id),name:option,nameId:transId}; index from optionList[0].index else undefined; vehicleInfo includes vinCode:vehicleInfo.vin,categoryNameList,carInfoList,optionInfoList,index,vehicleId.

ecuInfoList includes ALL mounted ECU entries (not filtered selected group): {ecuId,ecuNameId,ecuName,helpInfoId_V,helpInfo:description,busId,phaseType}. Start list single {ecuId:selected,signalIdList}; group list single {id:selected.groupId,ecuInfoList:allMounted}. groupName uses groupId%3 into BODY/POWERTRAIN/CHASSIS.

GetSpecificFolder({folderNo:2}) -> first folderInfo, reject if folderInfoList undefined (empty array throws in then and is caught). createDrsFile(payload) -> clearVimDlog() -> copyDrsFile() -> deleteFile({path:specificFolder2+backslash+fileDataSetting2+backslash+*}). Each failure sets cache.isCmdError true and stops remaining ordered steps; final catch returns flag instead of throwing. Initial trigger/payload setup occurs before this promise chain and can throw separately.

Controller checkRetry stores result flag; failure opens003; Yes recursively invokes entire model.makeDrsFile (fresh DOM getters are NOT reread: same captured payload objects) catches common error and resolves outer deferred in finally; No/default resolves. After resolved result: close001; if flag still true dispose manager/snapshot and dashboard; else dispose manager,snapshot,detail, initialize result view and log success then bind exit->dashboard.

Outer catch references controller.onErrorCommon without invoking, closes001 and rejects; inner result view init catch rejects but its promise is not returned. No rollback of created DRS/copied VIM state or partial deletion and no native session close is called here.

frontend.title: Import preparation, VIM file validation, measurement reading and failure flags
ordered_behavior: Import Next opens001 then readyGtseFile({}). Worker resets flags isCmdError/isDataloggerValid/isDmFileNotExist false. Each of these four errors sets isCmdError true and rejects.

Enumerate specificFolder2+backslash+settingFilePath (no include mask). If returned fileInfoList length>0 deleteFile(path+/*); empty or enumeration failure proceeds. Deletion failure sets isCmdError and stops.

checkVimDlog() -> only dmFolderValidation===1 accepts data: set isDataloggerValid=false, reset dmFileList[], push each rDmFileNameList element (no default if list missing). Otherwise set isDataloggerValid=true and reject WITHOUT isCmdError. API/other failure sets isCmdError unless valid flag already true.

copyDlogFile({toPath:specificFolder2+backslash+settingFilePath}); enumerate same path includeFileList:[*.drsp], require nonempty, read FIRST file and JSON.parse data into drspInfo. Any failure sets isCmdError. No multi-DRSP compatibility/selection check exists.

Enumerate *.dm at work path, require nonempty. Project filenames; each local DM MUST occur in VIM rDmFileNameList; first absent sets isDmFileNotExist=true and rejects WITHOUT isCmdError. It does not require every advertised VIM filename locally present. Empty/enumeration failure becomes isCmdError. Cache dmfolderInfo local enumeration order.

GetSpecificFolder1 first root plus tseFolderPath -> tseFilePath. Enumerate that directory; nonempty -> deleteFile(tsefilepath+/*); empty or enumeration failure proceeds. SpecificFolder failure and deletion failure set isCmdError. These deletions occur before all DM writes; no rollback.

Generate local current YYYYMMDDHHmm (all two-digit except year), store strDateStoredSessionTime. New DataLoggerWorkerBuffer(commonInfo,DataList,drspInfo.ecuId,minuteKey), clear rootNode; sequential for each cached filename await readDlogFile({fromPath:workpath+backslash+filename}), then buffer.save(drspInfo,readDlogInfo,tseFilePath,cache.infoMemo) and push returned root node. Each file read/save rejection marks isCmdError; no parallel or user cancel.

readDlogFile response.signalList default[]. After optional ECU546 load transform, map every signal {signalId,dataList:[{seqNumber:j+1,data:sample.data,recordTime:sample.time}]} preserving signal/sample order and raw data/time; no JS resampling, unit conversion or time-origin normalization. drspInfo is mutated across files. save receives memo cache.infoMemo (initialized undefined and never set in this worker).
Command final/catch returns {isCmdError,isDataloggerValid,isDmFileNotExist}. Existing partial work directories and cached drsp/readDlog/root data are not rolled back.

Controller branch precedence: isCmdError closes001 and shows004; Yes merely resolves callback (does NOT rerun ReadyGtseFile), No/default emits PREVIOUS_SCREEN. Else isDataloggerValid closes001 and shows013; OK previous screen. Else isDmFileNotExist closes001 and shows014; Yes merely resolves, No/default previous screen. Else call makeGtseFileFunc. Button001 is not cancelable.
readyGtseFile promise rejection has no outer catch/finally in onClickNextBtn02 and can leave001 open. Only makeGtseFile branch installs its own catch.
frontend.acquisition_boundary: Samples are returned by readDlogFile. Frontend does not define VIM log format, live acquisition timing, ECU transport, or collection authorization.

frontend.title: ECU546 calculated-load import formula and filtering
frontend.predicate: drspInfo.drspSetInfo.ecuId === 546, independent of destination/OEM setting or phaseType
transform: Filter response.signalList: remove signal335 and336 while capturing each dataList (last duplicate wins); capture337 dataList but retain signal337. When all three arrays nonempty, filter337 samples in order.

For each337 sample use .some to find first335 sample with EXACT time===sample.time, Number(data); likewise first336 exact time. Keep iff335 value truthy AND336>=0. Thus air0 is excluded; speed0 accepted. If speed===0 ->value0 else value=air/speed then cap only upper bound100 (no lower cap). Write Number(value.toFixed(0)) back into original337 sample object. Missing timestamps/NaN/negative speed reject sample.

After calculation, keep337 signal only when all335/336/filtered337 arrays nonempty; then assign filtered337 dataList. Else remove337 entirely. Always remove metadata335/336 from drspSetInfo.parameterList; also remove337 metadata when any corresponding list empty. Other metadata preserved even if response omits corresponding signal.
The mutated parameterList persists into subsequent DM files (including permanent removal of337 after an earlier invalid file). Import does not restore metadata from original DRSP per file.

Files for two calls within same millisecond can collide; no uniqueness retry.

Return root node {type:1,children:[],date:{year,month,day,hour,minute,second},time:utcDate.getTime(),hasMemo:false,functionId:DataList,dataDir:relativeSessionAndDataDir}. hasMemo remains false even if memo provided.

Normalize drspData.triggerParameterInfo.signalInfoList default[] but do not serialize trigger settings: data.trigerInfoList (exact misspelling) and flagList are always[]. Extract signalIdList from every drspSetInfo.parameterList entry in metadata order.

Find phaseType by scanning ecuGroupList and each.ecuInfoList for selected drspSetInfo.ecuId; break outer only if phaseType truthy, not merely match. No default type. Data JSON body {data:{ecuInfo:{ecuId,ecuName,ecuNameId,phaseType},customList:[{name:ALL_DATA,nameId:null,pidIdList:signalIdList}],signalInfoList:DRSP.parameterList,signalDataList:dmData,trigerInfoList:[],flagList:[]},functionId:DataList,language:DRSP.languageCode,formatVersion:0.0.1}.

First writeFile({path:storedPath+backslash+data.json,mode:0,data:JSON.stringify(dataEnvelope)}), then info.json mode0 containing same local date/shifted time,functionId:DataList,ecuInfo:{ecuId,ecuName,ecuNameId},memo:memo?memo:undefined,formatVersion:0.0.1. JSON.stringify omits undefined fields, NaN becomes null; no additional sanitizer.

Resolve root node only after info write. Catch is mgr.onErrorCommon although DataLoggerWorkerBuffer has no prototype inheritance or such method in owned body; undefined catch argument is inert and rejection propagates. No directory creation PF call or transaction is issued by this JS.
frontend.shared_write: GtsPFApi.writeFile chunks nonempty strings at20,000,000 UTF-16 JS string characters; first chunk retains requested mode, subsequent mode2; nonfinal receiveAck false; final original receiveAck; awaits sequentially. fileInfo fields exactly date,time,gtsVersion:appVersionInfo.getAppPackageVersion(),region:getDestination(),userName:userInfo.userName,userId:userInfo.userId,userType:settingFileInfo.distributorDepending.countryInformation.userType.name,formatVersion,dealerName:pcSetting.dealerInformation.dealerName,country:pcSetting.dealerInformation.countryCode,language:getLanguage(),mode:userInfo.loginMode,vim:pcSetting.vim.name,vimFirmwareVersion:versionInfo.vimVersion.

Vehicle scalar defaults null: carInfoList(default[]) id1->vehicleType,2->engineType,3->modelYear,4->vehicleName,16->numberOfCylinder,17->transMission,18->brandName; each later duplicate overwrites earlier.
