Failure stops remaining writes; .catch(mgr.onErrorCommon) has no owned handler and therefore propagates. No partial-manifest rollback. createTSENameFile returns imported VIN-based .gtse name, not encoded registration/user info.

frontend.title: GTSE archive naming, hash-generation selection, deletion and retry
ordered_behavior: MakeGtseFile constructs NEW buffer with commonInfo,DataList,drspInfo.ecuId and earlier minute key. It does NOT reset cache.isCmdError false at entry. buffer.create using current drsp/readDlog/tsePath/rootNodes/vehicleInfoMemo -> cache.tseName; getSpecificFolder({folderNo:2}) first folder path; ArchivePath=folder+backslash+storeFolderPath; buffer.flushTSE(tsePath,ArchivePath,tseName) -> cache.gtsefilename.

flushTSE only executes when tseName truthy; falsy returns undefined (caller .then then throws). createHash: packageVersion default empty, split dot, Number(first component)>2025 -> list.cpt; otherwise list.txt including NaN/empty. deleteFile({path:targetFolder+backslash+hashFile}) errors swallowed, then createHashFile({hashTarget:targetFolder,hashListName:fullHashPath}) errors propagate.

After hash generate local Date; filename=YYYY+MM(2)+DD(2)+HH(2)+mm(2)+second(unpadded numeric)+milliseconds(unpadded numeric)+_+tseName. Thus suffix seconds/milliseconds are not fixed-width. archiveFile({compress:1,fromPath:targetFolder.replace(/\\/g,backslash),toPath:exportPath+backslash+filename,overwrite:true}); resolve filename only after archive succeeds.

After successful archive deleteFile({path:tseFilePath+backslash+*}) but swallow deletion rejection; then return {isCmdError:cache.isCmdError,gtsefilename}. Catch any preceding failure sets flag true then returns same shape; stale filename can remain. No wipe of imported VIM logs at this stage.

Controller makeGtseFileFunc calls model.makeGtseFile().then(checkRetry). checkRetry stores flag and filename. Error opens009; Yes calls makeGtseFileFunc().then(checkRetry) AGAIN (duplicated checkRetry stage); finally resolve outer deferred; No/default resolves. Because worker never resets cache.isCmdError, successful retry after prior failure can remain flagged true and reopen retry dialogs. Preserve this source behavior; do not claim successful-retry guarantee.

After make chain resolves close001; if flag true emit PREVIOUS_SCREEN; else dispose import view, init makefile result with filename, log r_item_i1923, bind Exit04. Catch closes001, merely references onErrorCommon without invoking, resolves Promise; result-view inner init promise is not returned.

Import initial Exit03 emits PREVIOUS_SCREEN only; successful result Exit04 opens001, model.ClearVim (which swallows PF rejection), then PREVIOUS_SCREEN, finally close001. Settings normal exits dashboard. No additional exports to CSV, print/report generation, online upload or backend synchronization exists in owned group.

family.scope: Static, inert interprocedural contract of all supplied js/gts/rob members. No execution, tests, native behavior, or authentication implementation is asserted.
family.ownership_rule: Calls into shared owners are typed handoffs. No additional native requests, storage operations, Subaru dispatches, graph operations, or authentication checks are inferred.

state: cancelFlag=false; DL006 CANCEL sends rob.cancelProcess only.
ordered_transitions: For each behaviorCodeInfo, collect distinct defined timeStamp.keyCycle values only from codes lacking absTimeStampInfo. Each ECU traversal is inside try/catch; malformed data logs and aborts that ECU traversal but collection continues for later ECUs.
If no key cycles, set commEcuList=[] and absoluteTimeStampInfoList=[] and skip native time calls.

Otherwise await getAbsoluteTime option 1 for every truthy mounted ECU mapped to {ecuId,busId}, outputLog:0. Check model.cancelFlag only after response, then default commEcuList to []. Native resultInfo cancellation is not inspected.

If communication list is nonempty, get metadata for its first ECU and await getEcuStatus({checkDisconnected:true}); check cancelFlag after status. Only status===1 issues option 2. Disconnected or unconfirmed status leaves absolute timestamps empty.

Await getAbsoluteTime option 2 with targetEcuList=commEcuList,keyCycle=the entire distinct list,outputLog:0; check cancelFlag after response; default absoluteTimeStampInfoList to []. Cache both lists.
JSON-clone behaviorCodeInfoList; each entry branches phase6, else phase5, else phase4, generating {ecuInfo,detectPointList,behaviorCodeList}. Cache ffdDataList.
createViewDataForUtil maps absolute timestamps by keyCycle, retaining the last duplicate. Drop falsey ECU entries, sort systems by nonempty formatted behavior list first then dbIndex ascending.

Project detect points into main rows using timestamp index===0 when a timestamp list has length, otherwise {}; sort by keyCycle presence/truthiness then descending keyCycle, descending elapsedTime, ascending rawCode.

Format rows and final-sort by keyCycle truthiness/presence, descending raw keyCycle, descending elapsedTime, time/date presence then descending parsed date, ascending rawCode. Return {systemList,canceled:false}.

requests.guard: commEcuList nonempty and first ECU status===1

guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Exact 'canceled' returns {canceled:true}; other errors reject through onErrorCommon. Cancellation after the final native/status check, or on the no-key-cycle path, is not checked during projection and may return canceled:false.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Controller stores systemList only after canceled check; DL006 closes in finally. Model.getRobData accepts ecuId but controller calls it without one; worker ignores the parameter and uses cache.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: operation_history_live_alternative
state: New RobOperationHistoryView; DL005; cancelFlag=false; no model.initModel call.
ordered_transitions: DL005 CANCEL calls cancelInitRobData, not the separately defined cancelGetRobOperationHistory wrapper.
Await getOperationHistoryForRob({ecuId,getRobStatus:1,getCurrentTime:1}); if model.cancelFlag after response, return without storing data; otherwise cache response.apiArgs.getAnalyzeWorkFactorRob.
Swallow all native rejection. If cancelFlag, return {canceled:true}. Otherwise isErrored is absence of local result; existence is some anlzWrkFctData entry with wrkFctData.length>0.

Only if such data exists, JSON-clone cache and project operation history. Cache analyzeWorkFactorRoBList, default []. Return {canceled:false,isErrored,isAnlzWrkFctDataExist,analyzeWorkFactorRoBList}. isAnlzWrkFctDataExist can be undefined.
Controller canceled result stops. isErrored shows DL007. Empty list or no projected behaviorRecordList with length>0 shows DL013.

Otherwise store projected list; start showRobOpeHisView(0) without awaiting it; then await webServiceSaveRobCode(true), milMessageDialog and saveData(link resource from opeHisView,true). That submission/dialog/save chain catches every failure and fulfills undefined.
Close DL005 in finally. Projection or worker failures outside the inner swallowed save chain are not caught by initRobOperationHistory.

Dropdown parseInt(value,10) emits dropdownmenu; controller disposes current view and starts showRobOpeHisView(idx) without awaiting. Each display initializes view, then status, behavior table, options and resize, then registers dropdown callback.

projection: Sort anlzWrkFctData in place by dispOrder ascending; each row gets idx=array index, dispCode=behaviorCodeDisp??'', name=dispCode plus optional ':'+wrkFctName.

Shared timeInfo: currentTimeData dispType 4 formats data as optional Nd plus HHh MMm; 2048 gives ''. currentIgOnOff/currentCpuReset dispType 0 stringifies defined values including zero; 2048 gives ''; other cases undefined. timeAndDate is convertLocaleTime(top-level object).

Keep wrkFctData only with dispLevel<2. absoluteTime dispType 1 wins: elapsedTime=currentTimeData.data-absoluteTime.data and locale time offset=-absoluteTime.data using gts.UNIT_ID.sec. Otherwise afterCpuResetTime dispType 2 formats its data.
igOnOffCount/cpuResetCount use dispType 0 or 2048 as above. behavior uses truthy behaviorDataName or '0x'+last two uppercase hex digits of behaviorData. description=helpContents.
response_errors_results.time_format: isNaN(second) gives undefined; otherwise floor days, hours modulo 24, minutes modulo 60; seconds are discarded. Negative and coercible values are not normalized.

guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Display can race submission/save and progress closure. Native resultInfo.canceled is not checked. If an errored retry has old cached getAnalyzeWorkFactorRob, local error result is still true but old cache is not cleared.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: ffd_group_selection_projection_and_detail_ui
guarded_ordered_workflows.entry: Main-row link or Next -> applicable controller.onClickNextBtn
inputs: stored/health variants additionally pass storedData.ffdDataList,absoluteTimeStampInfoList and model.utilId
state: Allocate a fresh applicable detail view; open loader.
ordered_transitions: Live model sends rob.getFFDGroup({ecuId,ffdGroupKey}); stored/health models send rob.getFFDGroupForStoredData with all five fields.
Live worker selects cache.data.ffdDataList; stored worker uses supplied arrays and assigns utilId only when supplied utilId is truthy.
Find first ECU by strict ecuId equality; filter its formatted behaviorCodeList by strict ffdGroupKey equality. Missing targetCodeList yields empty projection object, not an error by itself.

Clone group records. Only exact phaseType===4 uses phase4 group handling: sort no ascending; for every record after the first keep only falsey timestamp/data indices; mark every duplicate-no record's existing multiData data='conflict'.

Other phase values: if every record has index-0 timestamp with defined keyCycle and elapsedTime, sort descending detection keyCycle then elapsedTime, ascending no, descending subFunc; otherwise ascending no then descending subFunc.

formatFFDData first builds one converter per signal id from the first signal definition and commonInfo.unitSetting, deletes converter.multiDataList, and emits parameter metadata sorted dispOrder: {paramName:name,unit,dispOrder,paramKey:'param'+id}.

For each behavior record inside try/catch, create tempDataMap keyed timestamp.index??0, containing {index,code,behavior,keyCycle,elapsedTime,timeAndDate,param:{}}. No timeStampList creates index 0; an empty array creates no frames. Top-level absTimeStampInfo, when present, is used for every timestamp rather than timestamp.absTimeStampInfo.

Empty behaviorDataRecordList logs and drops record. For each signal and each multiData value, find temp frame by data.index??0: missing -> {value:undefined,valueStr:undefined}; conflict -> code,behavior,keyCycle,elapsedTime,timeAndDate='?' and signal {value:undefined,valueStr:'?'}; factorDataFlag===1 and dataType===2 -> getPatternFunc(dispInfoList)(data.data); otherwise converter.convertFunc(data.data).

Only utilId 64/1064 appends factorDataFlag and helpInfo, with helpInfo empty for falsey flag. Keep a frame when any time field is not undefined or any parameter has both value and valueStr not undefined. Sort frames by index. Return {frameId:original sorted record index,frameNo:no,dataList}; drop per-record exceptions.

Return {phaseType,paramInfoList,ffdData,ffdGroup}; ffdGroup is two-character uppercase suffix of ffdGroupKey.toString(16) if Number(ffdGroupKey) is not NaN, else '-'. Numeric strings are not first converted before toString(16).

Controller stores group result, disposes current view and initializes detail view. Set group/status. For utilId64/1064 call setViewArea12; else phase4 predicate takes first three frame groups and setViewArea02; otherwise setViewArea04. Register Back callback. Loader always closes at onClickNextBtn boundary.

setViewArea02 sorts top-level columns descending dispOrder, selectable=true. setViewArea04 reverses group order, selectable=true. setViewArea12 reverses groups, shows description, sets isID64=true, selectable=false.

Transpose five shared fields plus parameterInfoList into rows. Nested fields are 'frame'+frameId+'_'+index; zero index title is detection resource, other indices stringify. Group titles use r_item_i+(2123+groupCount-index-1). Compare each flattened frame to its immediate predecessor across group boundaries; changed means current!==undefined && current!==previous. Store cell {value,rowUpdatedFlag,factorDataFlag,helpInfo}; row updateStatus is any changed cell.

Render changed rows/cells with v_rob_update/v_rob_def. Factor cells show '- No Data -' only for ID64 mode, flag truthy, value===undefined; otherwise nullish value gives '-'. Truthy factor value is clickable: toggle parameter/unit/cell selection and HTML help after convertCRtoBR.
Back disposes detail and starts main view initialization without native reacquisition.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: No native snapshot request is issued: groups derive from cached/supplied data. Converter-map construction errors reject the overall call; per-record format errors log/drop that record. Missing arrays can throw. onClickNextBtn catches/logs/swallow including show-detail failures.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Detail is allocated before retrieval and old current view remains until retrieval succeeds. Detail constructors set isID64=false; dispose does not reset it or printData. Cell selector text has the source's incomplete '[class*="..."' selector and cursor fallback is misspelled 'defualt'; neither is corrected.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: clear_native_race_and_hidden_parallel_alternative
guarded_ordered_workflows.entry: RobController.onClickClearBtn -> DL010 YES -> deleteRoB; RobHealthController guarded clear -> deleteRoB; direct RobModel.deleteRoBHidden API
state: DL009 progress; successCount initially false; worker clear does not reset cancelFlag.
ordered_transitions: Controller constructs buttonPromise. CANCEL starts cancelDeleteRobData(cancelKey) without awaiting, then fulfills undefined. Live unexpected button rejects; health unexpected button fulfills undefined.
Race native model.deleteRoB(ecuId,cancelKey) against buttonPromise. Worker determines phaseType and builds {ecuId}.
Phase6 predicate: filter ECU functions to ids47,48,49, retain functions containing detail21, map to {funcId}; assign userDefDtcList even when empty.
Call clearRob(para,true). If immediate response.cancelId!==undefined, register cancel id under key and return response.response to be assimilated; otherwise return response directly.

On final response, resultInfo.cancel rejects 'canceled'; otherwise successCount=1. Rejection arriving at the second then's rejection callback is swallowed, leaving successCount false. Cancellation rejection thrown inside its success callback reaches outer catch and becomes {canceled:true}. Other outer errors use rejecting onErrorCommon.
Worker returns {isNormalResponse:successCount>0,phaseType}; finally clearCancelIds(cancelKey).

Controller race result absent or canceled rejects undefined. False normal response shows DL015 for phase5/6 predicates, otherwise DL008. Success live shows DL011; OK disposes current view and starts initRob. Success health shows DL016; YES emits TRANSIT_FUNCTION with gts.CONTROLLER_ID.ROB and ecuId; NO does nothing.
Progress dialog closes in controller finally, including cancel-winning race. No controller catch is attached in deleteRoB; callers generally launch it detached.

Hidden alternative directly calls clearRob({ecuId},true) concurrently using Promise.all for ECU ids [327,234,236] in that map order. Each registers cancelId if supplied, checks resultInfo.cancel, and catches every failure/cancellation as false. Count successes and return {isNormalResponse:count>0}; finally clear cancel IDs. No supplied controller invokes deleteRoBHidden.

requests.guard: direct hidden alternative

guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Normal native result codes are not otherwise validated here; any response not marked resultInfo.cancel is counted successful. Hidden clear succeeds if at least one call succeeds.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Race does not cancel the losing promise automatically. Native completion and worker final cleanup can occur after controller race exits. Cancellation flag itself is not examined by deleteRoB/deleteRoBHidden. Registration may race cancelCommand.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: cancellation_bridge_contract
guarded_ordered_workflows.entry: RobModel/RobHealthModel cancellation methods or direct RobWorkerApi cancellation wrappers
state: worker cancelProcess only assigns cancelFlag=true and returns {}.
ordered_transitions: cancelInitRobData starts cancelAllAwaiting() and send('rob.cancelProcess',{}) together in Promise.all.
cancelGetRobOperationHistory has the same parallel operations, but no supplied model method/controller calls this wrapper.
cancelGetRobData only sends cancelProcess; it does not cancel native awaiting calls.
cancelDeleteRobData starts cancelCommand(cancelKey) and send('rob.cancelProcess',{}) together in Promise.all.
Controllers do not await these cancellation promises before continuing their progress-dialog race/result handling.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Bridge cancellation behavior is shared-owned. Promise.all rejects if either operation rejects; controller callbacks do not handle those returned promises. No native cancellation guarantees are inferred.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: initRob/getRobData/getRoBOperationHistory reset cancelFlag=false on entry; cancel has no request identity. Later starts may erase earlier cancel state and a late cancel can affect a different operation.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: automatic_web_submission_and_mil_dialog
ordered_transitions: If saveRobCode?.url is absent, return disabled result without generating rows or making a web call.

Operation-history mode reprojects a JSON clone only when cached raw data contains any nonempty wrkFctData; map each analysis group, not each behavior record, to {robCode:dispCode,ecuId:cache ECU,ecuName:cache ECU,keyCycle:Number(timeInfo.keyCycle),elapsedTime:timeInfo.elapsedTime,timeandDate:timeInfo.timeAndDate??''}.

Normal mode lazily builds and caches ffdDataList if missing using the worker generation functions; project main view and use only systemList[0], falling back to cache ECU identity. Map its recordList to {robCode:code,ecuId,ecuName,keyCycle:Number(keyCycle),elapsedTime,timeandDate:timeAndDate??''}.
Build {milInput:{vehicleConnectSession,version,vin,date,language,userTypeCode,type:'RobCode',milRob}} and JSON.stringify into requestData.
Await executeGenWebService({url,method:'POST',contentType:'JSON',requestData,serverId:saveRobCode.id}).

Parse response.apiArgs.responseData; parse failure gives {}. commonResult/apiResult default {}. Filter milMessages to case-insensitive critical,information,confirmation. Priority critical -> S_70100_DL-005, else information -> S_70100_DL-006, else confirmation -> S_70100_DL-004, otherwise None. Preserve all allowed messages, not only the winning severity.
Return isExecute:true,isRevoke:commonResult.statusCode==='MIR4000000',milMessage:{kind,messages}. Web-chain rejection returns disabled result.
Controller milMessageDialog: !isExecute resolves; isRevoke emits ControllerTransEvent.LOGOUT and rejects undefined; kind None resolves; otherwise await custom dialog promise.

Custom dialog selects exact screen/page/id configuration, loads view, appends critical caution icons or other information icons, injects title HTML and message HTML with CRLF replaced by br, messageId as text. Modal is static/non-keyboard; OK hides/removes and resolves {id:'OK'}.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Disabled result is {isExecute:false,isRevoke:false,milMessage:{kind:'None',messages:[]}}. Row construction and settings access happen before the returned executeGenWebService promise chain and can throw rather than becoming disabled results. Malformed message collection/types can reject inside the chain and then become disabled. Normal acquisition stops before persistence/display on revoke; operation-history inner catch swallows revoke rejection after emitting logout.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: No cancellation. Successful dialog creation resolves only on OK. Loading failure rejects deferred without a reason. Invalid sScreenId fails while accessing missing dialogSetting before loading.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: persistence_buffer_and_stored_reopen
state: Worker cache and buffer; separate storedCache.
ordered_transitions: saveData first mutates cache.data.operationHistoryFlg. Await createBuffer('RoB',cache.data.ecuInfo.ecuId), replace model.buffer, await buffer.save(cache.data), then await buffer.outputActivityReportForLink(resourceData.linkToTheStoredData). Rejections rethrow.
RobBuffer.init delegates to GtsBaseBuffer.init(port,path); cmdSave calls saveToPlatform(param) without returning its result.

closeBuffer, when explicitly called, awaits buffer.close then sets buffer=null; clearBuffer delegates buffer.clear. No supplied command handler, controller dispose, or save workflow calls either helper.
Stored controller constructs main/operation-history views and RobStoredModel, opens loader and sends rob.getStoredData({storedId:param}).
Worker awaits StoredDataManager.instance.getStoredData(storedId,true). If cacheData.language differs strictly from commonInfo.getLanguage(), await translateStr(cacheData); otherwise use unchanged.

Assign storedCache={data:cacheData.data}. If operationHistoryFlg truthy, return {funcInfoList,getAnalyzeWorkFactorRob,operationHistoryFlg,analyzeWorkFactorRoBList,ecuInfo}; this alternative does not return utilId or reproject saved analysis.

Normal alternative lazily creates ffdDataList if missing using worker generation functions, calls checkTarget(funcInfoList), builds systemList with worker createViewDataForUtil, and returns {utilId,currentTimeInfo:formatCurrentTimeInfo,systemList,ffdDataList,absoluteTimeStampInfoList,operationHistoryFlg,ecuInfo}.

Controller saves entire result in storedData, sets model utilId and ECU info. History stores saved list and starts showRobOpeHisView(0) without awaiting; normal stores currentTimeInfo/systemList and awaits main display.

Stored history directly indexes opeHisData[idx].timeInfo and behaviorRecordList without an empty-list guard. Main reads only systemList[0]; a truthy empty array is not protected. Loader closes in finally and controller catch logs/swallows.

Stored disposal invokes disposeView on each existing main/detail/history view, even non-current initialized objects, disposes controller dispatcher, and resolves. No worker or storage buffer cleanup is initiated.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Save returns activity-link output, not a specifically constructed result. Worker stored-data failures reject; frontend stored controller catches/swallow. Operation-history stored utilId becomes undefined in frontend, while worker utilId is not reset by that branch.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Persistence stores raw, formatted and cached fields as present; no owned pruning or snapshot locking. Buffer replacement does not close previous buffer. No cancellation.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: stored_translation
state: Mutates saved nested objects; no replacement cache language assignment.
ordered_transitions: Sort raw anlzWrkFctData by optional dispOrder ascending. Build one paramList and one serial promise chain on an unresolved deferred.

Queue each translation request item as {parameterName,id,defaultStr}; each queued chain callback calls GtsPFApi.setTranslateStr(mapping,target,translationStrList) and forwards the same entire translation list.

Traversal order: root ECU ecuName; function-list name/help; each raw behavior ECU ecuName; each behavior's signal name/unit then dispInfo.dispName; behavior name/divname; timestamp elapsedTimeUnit; currentTimeInfo elapsedTimeUnit.

Then each ffdData detect point name/divname, signal name/unit, timestamps elapsedTimeUnit; then each formatted behavior name/divname, signal name/unit and dispInfo.dispName, timestamps elapsedTimeUnit.
Then each sorted raw analysis group wrkFctName; update every saved projected analysis row with matching dispCode to behaviorCodeDisp+':'+translated wrkFctName unconditionally including colon.
For every raw work-factor item queue behaviorDataName/helpContents, then parameterName for igOnOffCount,afterCpuResetTime,cpuResetCount when present.

Work-factor callback splits original behaviorDataName by ':', translates, splits translated name, and addresses saved projected behaviorRecordList by the unfiltered raw item index. If translated name has fewer than two pieces and original first piece matches projected behavior first piece, projected behavior becomes existing prefix+':'+translated name when prior behavior had a colon, otherwise existing prefix alone. Description is translated helpContents. Raw dispLevel filtering is not accounted for in index matching.
Call getPFResourceForStored(paramList,cacheData.language) once; on fulfillment resolve deferred, letting queued setTranslateStr callbacks run serially; finally return original cacheData.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Native resource rejection has no catch and is not connected to deferred.reject, so returned translation promise can remain pending. Callback exceptions reject the serial chain. Missing behaviorDataName can throw at split. Root and nested assignments rely on shared setTranslateStr mutation semantics: local reassignment is not written back to parent arrays.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Does not translate factorData.helpInfo, root ffdData.ecuInfo, or recompute formatCurrentTimeInfo. Does not update cacheData.language. No cancellation or resource batching loop beyond the one request.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: health_and_health_stored_alternatives
state: Applicable main view; RobHealthStoredOperationHistoryView in both alternatives; applicable health model; live-health additionally creates RobCmnDlg and HealthCheckWorkerApi.
ordered_transitions: Open loader; call model.getHealthData(ecuId), constructing {ecuId,functionId:'rob'}, through RobWorkerApi to healthCheck.getHealthCheckEcuData. This command belongs to health owner, not RobWorkerModel.

Store result in controller.storedData; set utilId,ecuInfo. History stores analyzeWorkFactorRoBList and starts history display(0) detached; normal stores currentTimeInfo/systemList and awaits main display. Catch logs/swallow; finally closes loader.

Both reuse stored-style FFD detail retrieval on supplied arrays and RobHealthStoredDetailView. Health-stored main phase is model ECU phaseType; live-health main uses commonInfo.getEcuPhaseType(first system ECU).
Live-health main name uses getCurrentEcuName()??model ECU name; its detail and history use getCurrentEcuName()||model ECU name. Health-stored uses saved ECU name.
Live-health history guards an empty analysis array, displaying {} status and [] records; health-stored and ordinary stored history do not guard empty arrays.

Live-health main removes clear button when !isExistRobData; refresh remains. Clear callback first awaits healthCheckApi.isHealthCheckRunning({}). If running, show DL018, await OK and stop. Otherwise show DL010 and await YES/NO; YES starts deleteRoB detached.

Refresh first awaits isHealthCheckRunning({}); if running show DL019 and await OK. Otherwise show DL017; YES emits TRANSIT_FUNCTION,gts.CONTROLLER_ID.ROB,current ECU id; NO stops. No direct native acquisition or in-place health cache refresh is performed.
Successful live-health clear uses DL016 YES transition to live utility, as in clear workflow. It does not mutate storedData or remove cleared records locally.

Main health-back or history health-back invokes controller callback. RobHealthController emits 'backToHealthCheck'; RobHealthStoredController emits 'backToHealthCheckStored'. Live-health history view emits its own 'backToHealthCheckStored' event, which the controller maps to its live-health output event.
Back/dropdown dispose current view and restart relevant display without awaiting. Dispose invokes all existing views' disposal and controller dispatcher disposal.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Health result is a typed handoff expected to contain the stored-style projection fields; no owned Rob worker implementation or native requests are inferred for that command. Health main checks robDataList!==undefined, not null/empty, then indexes [0]. Health-stored does the same. Ordinary stored/live main use truthiness but still fail on [].
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: The local getStoredData function declared in RobHealthStoredController.init is unused. No automatic RoB save or web submission occurs in either health entry workflow. Health stored has no running check, native clear, or live transition refresh callbacks.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: main_ui_filter_selection_and_print_all_variants
guarded_ordered_workflows.entry: Applicable main/history/detail view initialization and print DOM callbacks
state: View-owned printData is an array used as a string-keyed map; main/history init resets it; detail init does not.
ordered_transitions: Load page through ViewUtil.getView(page,'gts_main_panel'), append status/view/control children, initialize DOM handlers and resource rendering, set title and status pane, trigger resize. Non-live views add stored_message styling and resource r_item_b0496 marker.

Main status holds current keyCycle/elapsedTime. Main table stores initially filtered data in printData.rob and full input in recordList. Columns are ffdGroup,code,behavior,timeAndDate,keyCycle,elapsedTime. History stores status and behavior tables in rob_status and rob_ope.

Main group cell displays resource r_item_i1060 for absent value; ordinary stored uses truthiness fallback, others nullish fallback. Link emits Next only when display differs from symbol and ecuId!==389. Row selection for non-389 stores key and ECU and enables Next; live falls back to current ECU for nullish row ecuId. Empty selection does not clear prior key/ECU or disable Next.

Selection callbacks remove visual selection, deselect first Tabulator row, then add CSS selection to that row. History additionally clears description for no data or injects first description HTML after CRLF-to-br; live history uses '#v_rob_description span' and nullish fallback, stored history uses p and truthy fallback.

setControlArea hides ordinary dropdown; phase6 predicate shows UDD dropdown. Initial selectedUddPullDown='' becomes '0'; later selection survives dispose/reinit because not reset. '1' retains robType===18; '0'/default retains all.
UDD change updates selectedUddPullDown and Tabulator setData(filterRecordList(recordList)); does not explicitly update printData.rob.data or clear stale selection.

Print click calls ViewUtil.getView of print_pattern_rob.html, print_pattern_rob_opehis.html, or print_pattern_rob_detail.html with id vdr_item; takes elementList[0]. Build report payload with template vehicle_diagnostic_report/s_vehiclediagnosticreport_template.html and cssList bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css,gts/vehicle_diagnostic_report.css,gts/rob.css.

Main nonempty cached table: append report title, status-data block, generated table to vdr_report; always append screen-image title to vdr_beforeScreenImage, with page_break. Print identity for all main/history views comes from commonInfo.vehicleInfo.currentEcuInfo.ecuName, even when initialization title used saved ECU name.

History nonempty cached behavior table: append status title, four-column status table, report title, behavior table and behavior/description detail table. Always append page-breaking screen-image title with selected analysis name.

Detail nonempty cached table: append report title, FFD group/current status block and pivot table. Build optional ID64 detail tables independently; append detail title and detail tables when generated. Always append screen-image title; ordinary stored detail adds page_break only when main report data exists, live and health-stored detail always add it.

Detail pivot printing flattens nested columns, partitions four data columns per table with repeated parameter/unit columns and blank padding. Derive grouped headers; page_break after first table. Render text cells. For ID64 flagged undefined use '- No Data -'; other object values with falsey contained value can render '-' due to source truthiness fallback.

Factor detail printing loops every nested frame column and rows index>=5; emits parameter,value,help, using help only when factorDataFlag===1 and CRLF-to-br HTML. isPrint is enabled by any named parameter after five shared rows but forced false unless isID64. Source reads detailInfoList?.[0].head?.title, so an empty list can throw before returning false.
Instantiate VehicleDiagnosticReport(commonInfo) and call print(printData) without returning/awaiting its result. Report internals and platform print are shared-owned.

Dispose empties panes, disposes dispatcher, hides title/function button, unregisters resize. Main/history also clear printData. Resize redraws main/detail to calculated height, subtracts description height in detail when visible, and subtracts 130 for history.
guarded_ordered_workflows.response_errors_results: Print exists only as HTML/report handoff, not an owned graph/CSV operation. Template load uses shared view error handler; later DOM/projection errors reject the print callback chain. Report.print failure is not assimilated when returned as a promise. Print cached table data need not match a later UDD filter.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: No print cancellation. Main init resets ecuId and assigns ffdGroup=null rather than clearing ffdGroupKey. Reused dispatchers are disposed then used again according to shared EventDispatcher semantics; no owned replacement occurs.

generation_oem_contract.branch_resolution: Generation routing calls shared isPhaseType6/isPhaseType5/isPhaseType4 predicates. Do not equate every predicate to a single numeric equality; exact FFD phase4 conflict handling alone compares phaseType===4. Unmatched worker preprocessing takes phase4 implementation. No owned explicit Subaru/OEM dispatch exists here.

worker_generation_algorithms.detect_phase4: Keep records with defined rawCode and either no===-1 or any timestamp.index===0. Undefined elements are rejected; null is not safely handled.
worker_generation_algorithms.detect_phase5: Keep defined rawCode and no===-1 or 1<=no<=255; JSON-clone; set first timestamp index=0 if nonempty. Suppress subFunc1/2/3 when corresponding17/18/19 has same dispCode and first timestamp keyCycle/elapsedTime; comparison exceptions mean no suppression.
worker_generation_algorithms.detect_phase6: Keep defined rawCode and no===-1, or ssrType0 with no1..31, or ssrType1 with no1..61439; clone and normalize first timestamp index. Suppress robType19 in presence of17 or18, and18 in presence of17, matching dispCode and first timestamp keyCycle/elapsedTime; exceptions mean no match.
worker_generation_algorithms.format_phase4: JSON-clone each record; timeStampList??=[{index:0}], then directly assign timeStampList[0].absTimeStampInfo. Explicit empty array therefore throws. Assign group key, filter truthy, pad frames. Assumes behaviorDataRecordList/multiDataList exist.
format_phase5: Group by rawCode; then group by ((no&65280)>>8)||(no&255). Within each group, duplicate exact no and subFunc records collapse to the first clone with every existing signal value replaced by 'conflict'; remove other duplicates.
Partition remaining group by subFunc. First record with defined rawCode and no===-1 or no1..255 is detection; groups without one are dropped.

Clone detection; ensure timestamp list nonempty and first index0; attach top-level abs timestamp to first timestamp. Ensure behaviorDataRecordList and each multiDataList; first existing data index=0 or add missing index0. Assign group key.

Sequence records match high byte to detection low byte and same subFunc. If detection and all sequence first timestamps define keyCycle/elapsedTime, count sequence elapsedTime<=detection elapsedTime without comparing keyCycle; assign indices starting -count||1, sort ascending keyCycle/elapsedTime/no, increment and skip zero.

Otherwise sort sequence no descending, assign indices -sequence.length through -1. Copy first sequence timestamp and attach sequence abs timestamp; copy first signal datum per signal and merge by signal id, adding newly encountered signals.
Sort timestamps by index, signals by dispOrder and values by index; per-partition try/catch logs/drops failures; padding occurs after that catch and can still reject overall formatting.

After flattening, suppress subFunc1/2/3 against17/18/19 by rawCode and index0 timestamp whose keyCycle/elapsedTime are defined. Missing qualifying timestamps on both sides compare undefined===undefined and can suppress records.
format_phase6: Create shared pattern1SetXXCond once per formatting call: rs=239 down through135 in decrements8, no=14 down through1; each inclusive range rs-7..rs collects ssrType0 sequence records. These buckets are not reset between rawCode groups, allowing cross-rawCode sequence contamination.

Group by rawCode. ssrType0 and no!==-1: low detection frame only when (no&65504)===0; also append matching128..239 range records to pattern buckets. ssrType1 and no!==-1: group by ((no&4294901760)>>>16)||(no&65535). Other records group by no, including -1. Falsey frameNo is skipped.
If every grouped record has ssrType===0, clone nonempty pattern buckets and assign one bucket at a time to detection groups sorted frame number descending. Empty group set passes every vacuously.
Collapse duplicates by exact no and robType, replacing existing values with conflict; partition by robType; detect first no===-1 or ssrType0/no1..31 or ssrType1/no1..61439.
Normalize/clone detection, data and group key as phase5. For ssrType0 sequence selection is other no with same robType.

For other ssrType, source expression '(behaviorCode.no & 0xFFFF0000) >>> 16 === robRecord.no & 0x0000FFFF && behaviorCode.robType === robRecord.robType' retains JavaScript precedence: equality is evaluated before bitwise &, effectively masking a boolean comparison against full robRecord.no, not a parenthesized low-word comparison.

Timestamp ordering/index assignment, merging, per-partition error dropping, padding and flattening follow phase5. Final priority suppression uses robType19 versus17/18,18 versus17, matching dispCode and qualified detection timestamps; missing qualified timestamps can compare equal.
worker_generation_algorithms.padding: Sort timestamps/data indices and signal dispOrder. Compute min/max across timestamps and every signal. If min+length-1!==max, append timestamp {index} and signal {data:'missing',index} to fill gaps and trailing indices, then sort. Arrays are appended during forEach, which visits only its initial length. No deduplication or finite-bound validation is added.
worker_generation_algorithms.group_keys: kind===1 returns ffdGroup.value. Otherwise worker phase4 returns rawCode+':'+no; worker phase5/6 returns truthy dispCode or rawCode+':'+no.
main_row_mapping: Absent dispCode and falsey rawCode returns undefined; rawCode0 without dispCode is treated absent. Callers do not filter undefined formatted rows before final sorting.
code=truthy dispCode or X plus last four uppercase hex digits. ffdGroup.kind===1 gives last two uppercase hex digits; ffdGroup is dereferenced without optional chaining.
behavior=dispCode?name:'???'. Main name includes space+divname only when both keys exist and divname.length is truthy.
Intermediate field is vehiclebehavior but formatter reads vehicleBehavior; projected vehicleBehavior is therefore normally lost.

absTimeStampInfo wins; DS4 calls convertLocaleTime(info) directly. Non-DS4 adds new Date().getTimezoneOffset()*60000*-1 with decoded ms array. Otherwise timestamp.clockType!==1 uses absoluteTimeStampMap[keyCycle],elapsedTime,elapsedTimeUnitId.

keyCycle/elapsedTime use shared convertCycleKey/convertElapsedTime. Output includes ecuId,ffdGroup,code,behavior,timeAndDate,keyCycle,elapsedTime,vehicleBehavior,triggerCondition,countermeasure,ffdGroupKey,sortKeyCycle,sortElapsedTime,sortTimeAndDate,sortRawCode,robType.

robUtil_distinctions: Operation-history projection duplicates worker behavior and sorts its input analysis array in place.
Phase4 formatting explicitly supplies a timestamp for an empty array as well as undefined; unlike worker it does not use nullish assignment and can fail on null.

Phase5 detect suppression matches rawCode, whereas worker detect suppression matches dispCode. Utility phase5 formatting timestamp tests and final suppression lack the worker's protective catches; failures may drop a partition or escape the final filter.

Utility phase6 grouping skips no===-1 instead of worker fallback grouping. Pattern classification and sequence selection use patternFlag===1 instead of ssrType===0. Utility detection inside formatter treats any nonzero ssrType like upper limit61439, unlike worker explicit0/1 restriction.

Utility phase6 retains the same bitwise/equality precedence expression, shared pattern-bucket cross-group accumulation, duplicate resolution, timestamp indexing and padding. Its timestamp checks/final suppression lack worker protective catches.

Utility createViewDataForUtil excludes only undefined rather than all falsey ECU entries; absoluteTimeStampInfoList is required. Names always include a space even without divname, and intermediate row also carries divname.

Utility row hex formatting uses convertByteToHexString; group phase5/6 keys use nullish dispCode fallback rather than truthy fallback, retaining ''. It also has the vehiclebehavior/vehicleBehavior mismatch.
Utility padding helper meargeIndexMinMax has a required second destructured argument, supplied by its owned caller; worker version provides defaults.
No supplied controller/model/worker calls robUtil formatting, so these differences must not be substituted into worker workflows.
generation_oem_contract.hidden_projection: createViewDataForHidden is defined but uncalled. It formats current time using convertElapsedTime rather than initRob's convertKeyCycleElapsedTime; chooses timestamp with falsey index; omits absTimeStampInfo/robType from intermediate rows and calls formatBehaviorCodeList without ecuInfo. Normal valid rows then fail when group-key generation dereferences ecuInfo.phaseType. No hidden-read native workflow is present.
generation_oem_contract.oem_boundary: Only explicit special ECU gates are 234/236 utility support, hidden clear ECUs327/234/236, and main snapshot navigation exclusion389. DS4 only changes absolute-time conversion. Dedicated Subaru frontend dispatch remains at the specified parent menu owner.

results_persistence_and_ui_contract.display_scope: All controllers display only the first system's recordList, although worker projections may contain multiple systems. Web normal-mode upload also uses only first system.

dialogs.common_dialog_handoff: RobCmnDlg returns createCommonDialog(config); callers use returned buttonPressed and progress close().

results_persistence_and_ui_contract.storage: Automatic live saves use buffer type 'RoB' and selected cache ECU id. Domain storage/report/CSV projection bodies remain under recorder_contracts.frontend. No owned explicit CSV export exists.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.print: All supplied view families provide direct print handlers; BTN_VDR_PRINT event constants are defined but handlers call report printing directly rather than emitting them.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.custom_lists_and_graph: No custom datalist list editing, graph setup, graph native request, graph playback, or graph cleanup is present. UDD 'All'/'Maintenance Information' is a local main-table filter, not a custom list API.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.cleanup: Live controller disposes currentView only and nulls view/model references; stored/health controllers dispose all existing view objects. None calls worker closeBuffer/clearBuffer, cancelAllAwaiting, or native disconnect on disposal.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.html_semantics: Several descriptions, report cells, titles and MIL messages are inserted via html/innerHTML without owned escaping. Text-based detail print cells differ from HTML-based main/history table cells; preserve these source mappings.

family.name: predictive_ffd
family.analysis_mode: Static, inert, interprocedural source contract. No execution or tests performed.
family.scope: All supplied predictive_ffd full members and the supplied decoded shared enum evidence.
negative_scope: No owned health-check controller, health entry, or health-specific alternative is present in the supplied family.
No print command, CSV export command, report projection body, authentication operation, or Subaru dedicated frontend dispatch occurs in these members.
Custom-list export writes a .cl file; it is not a CSV or report export.
Shared inherited routines are typed ownership handoffs, not reconstructed implementations.
family.evidence_convention: Member paths in exact_evidence are relative to js/gts/predictive_ffd/ unless an explicit shared path is given. Paired live/stored members have separate ownership even where their behavior is identical.

entry_points.behavior: initArgs is logged but does not select an ECU or alter the workflow. The ECU comes from commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(). Starts acquisition, persistence, and main-view initialization.
Reacquires for the current ECU; successful persistence precedes disposal and reinitialization of the captured main view.
Loads and possibly translates stored data without live ECU acquisition or automatic resave.
Singleton PredictiveFFDWorkerModel; init(commonInfo,ecuCache,commandThread) registers seven commands and resets instance specificFolder.
PredictiveFFDBuffer delegates init to GtsBaseBuffer; cmdSave(param) calls saveToPlatform(param) without returning its result.
Main selection/next, live exit/refresh, detail back/filter/new/remove/manager, graph navigation/selection/drop/flags/steps, manager OK/cancel and live save/export.
Keyword selection/service-information URL and help URL handoffs; no owned registration of these actions is shown.

worker_transport.construction: Both frontend models construct new PredictiveFFDWorkerApi() without commonInfo, although its constructor accepts commonInfo and passes it to new GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo).
worker_transport.envelope: Frontend wrappers send a plain parameter object; worker handlers consume param.parameter. The envelope conversion belongs to GtsWorkerApi/framework.
worker_transport.return_behavior: Each wrapper returns send(command,param) directly; no response normalization, cancellation command, or error interception.

worker_state.initial: buffer, commonInfo, ecuCache, cache, commandThread, storedCache are null; commandHandler is {}.
worker_state.init: commonInfo, ecuCache, commandThread are assigned; specificFolder becomes {folderNo1:undefined,folderNo2:undefined}. ecuCache and commandThread have no further owned use.
worker_state.static: PredictiveFFDWorkerModel.settingData and folderInfoList initially null and persist across worker-model init calls.
worker_state.live_cache: {data:{ecuInfo:{ecuId,ecuNameId,ecuName,phaseType},dtcList:[],customList:{customListInfo:[],customListUser:[]}}}; busId is used in requests but is not copied into cached ecuInfo.
worker_state.stored_cache: {data:cacheData.data}; stored loading does not populate model.cache.
worker_state.concurrency: No operation IDs, locks, cancellation tokens, snapshot isolation, or disposed-state guards. Multiple acquisitions share and replace model.cache; static folder/settings state is also shared.

frontend_state.models: Both retain DTC lists, supported DB/user custom lists, selected DTC, time columns, initial rows, management lists, filter list, default custom-list number, graph titles/original/current series, current time index, base-point index, graph-screen rows, and displayedParamInfo. Stored model additionally retains ecuInfo.
frontend_state.defaults: Lists start empty; selected DTC undefined; time/base/default indices zero; displayedParamInfo null. screenIrems is retained with its original misspelling.
frontend_state.resource_inputs: Controllers collect r_item_i1537, i1538, i1539, i1540, i4628. i1537 is the missing-data display and i1538 the time-axis suffix.
frontend_state.events: Most controller handlers read evt.args[1]; graph drop/select handlers instead read evt.detail.args[1]. Preserve that inconsistency at the EventDispatcher boundary.
frontend_state.state_assignment: Most setters directly assign references, not copies. DB/user custom-list setters additionally mutate each pidIdList by intersecting it with all unique FFD IDs across the currently assigned DTC list.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: live_init_refresh_persist_and_cancel
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: init constructs main view, model, PredictiveFFDDialog and title activity log; refresh reuses the model/dialog and captures controller.view.
ordered_transitions: init logs the title resource r_item_i1540 using ActivityLogger.logForTitle, constructs owned objects, and gets the current ECU. Refresh starts directly with the existing view/model and current ECU.
Create S31200-DL-001 progress dialog with CANCEL, autoClose:false, title r_item_i1540 and message r_msg_l0287. Attach a separately running buttonPressed continuation.
Call model.initPredictiveFFD(ecuId), which sends predictive_ffd.initPredictiveFFD with {ecuId}. Worker acquisition follows the next workflow.

On response.isDtcError, close progress dialog and showCommonErrorDialog({sErrorCode:response.detailCode,execResultCode:response.code}); resolve without waiting for the error dialog and without navigating or rendering new data.
Only after the DTC-error check, test cancelFlg. If true, resolve without persistence or rendering.
Build {linkToTheStoredData:controller.view.getResourceData('r_item_i1560')} and await model.saveCacheData(resourceData).
After save/report completion, close progress dialog; assign response.dtcList, then DB custom lists, then user custom lists; clear selected DTC.
On init, initialize the captured new main view. On refresh, dispose the captured view then reinitialize the same object.
After view initialization, subscribe main row selection, exit, refresh and next callbacks. Row selection stores evt.args[1]; exit emits backToUtilityMenu.
All rejection paths on this returned acquisition/persistence/render chain go to inherited controller.onErrorCommon; no owned finally closes the progress dialog.
response_errors_results: DTC error is a fulfilled sentinel object, not a rejected worker result.
Cancel does not stop native requests, user-file reads, additional-information requests, or worker cache mutations.
An acquisition rejection may leave progress open unless the shared error handler handles it.
The buttonPressed promise is not joined to the returned acquisition promise.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: Init CANCEL sets cancelFlg, closes progress, and calls backPreviousScreen, emitting backToUtilityMenu. Refresh CANCEL only sets the flag and closes progress; old frontend data stays visible.
DTC-error handling precedes cancellation, so a canceled acquisition can still open an error dialog.
Cancellation is checked once before save. Cancel during save does not prevent subsequent model assignment/view initialization; on init it can render after navigation away.
dispose() disposes current view, controller dispatcher, and any manager view; it does not cancel acquisition or dispose the model/dialog/worker/buffer.
Refresh disposal/reinitialization reuses a view whose event dispatcher has been disposed; dispatcher reusability is a shared-framework handoff, not repaired here.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: worker_live_acquisition_order_and_partial_failure
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Replace model.cache immediately with fresh live cache. Construct GtsPFApi.
ordered_transitions: Resolve ECU information and initialize the cache before starting the returned promise chain.
Await getDtc({ecuId,busId,phaseType,getDtcList:[{getDtcId:30,getDtcDetailList:[{getDtcDetailId:71,option:1}]}]}). Use response?.apiArgs?.dtcList ?? [].
Iterate returned DTCs in array order through a promise chain: await each getFfd before starting the next. Request {ecuId,dtcCode,busId,phaseType,dtcFlag:0,sdrNoList:dtc?.sdrNoList ?? []}.

For each FFD response default timeStampList and ffdList to []; read odoInfo default {} and absTimeStampInfo default [] but do not use either. Set dtc.timeStampList only when its old value is undefined and returned timestamps are nonempty. Always set dtc.ffdList.
After all initial FFDs succeed, assign cache.data.dtcList.
Await getCustomListInfo({ecuId,needContents:1,funcTypeList:[0,3]}). Assign response.apiArgs.customListInfo if not undefined, otherwise [].

If static folderInfoList is truthy, skip both folder lookups. Otherwise await getSpecificFolder({folderNo:1}), then folderNo:2. Each response overwrites static folderInfoList with response.apiArgs.folderInfoList || []; assign the first folder's folderInfo to the corresponding instance specificFolder slot, or undefined.

If static settingData is truthy, skip settings. Otherwise await getSettingFileInfo({fileType:2,keyList:['specificSubFolders','customListUser']}), then the analogous customListExport request; assign their apiArgs.fileData and only then publish static settingData.

For each entry in static folderInfoList, serially repeat a lookup of the same path specificFolder.folderNo1 + '\\' + settingData.customListUser + '\\' + ecuInfo.ecuId with includeFileList:['*.cl']. The loop's folder value is unused.
Within each returned fileInfoList || [], serially read folderInfo + '\\' + fileInfo.fileName; JSON.parse(apiArgs.data); concatenate dataObject.customListInfo when not undefined, otherwise [].
Await optional additional-information workflow.
Return {dtcList:createDtcViewData(cache.data.dtcList),dbCustomListInfo:cache.data.customList.customListInfo,userCustomListInfo:cache.data.customList.customListUser}.
requests: GtsPFApi.getSpecificFolder 1 then 2, unless static cache truthy
GtsPFApi.getSettingFileInfo user then export, unless static cache truthy
GtsPFApi.getFolderInformation and serial readFile per static folder-list entry
Optional getDtc detail 109 then parallel getFfd
response_errors_results: Initial getDtc/getFfd failures are rethrown internally, then transformed to rejection {code:reason.resultInfo.code,detailCode:reason.resultInfo.detailCode,isDtcError:true}; outer catch fulfills this object.
That transformation assumes reason.resultInfo exists. A malformed rejection can throw while constructing the sentinel, falling into generic outer handling.
Every individual user-file read/parse/concatenation-chain rejection is swallowed; folder-information/readFile chain failure is swallowed to fulfilled []. Previously accumulated users remain.
Other returned-chain failures call model.onErrorCommon() without the caught result, hence normally reject undefined.
ECU resolution/cache construction occur before the returned chain and can throw synchronously.
No native resultInfo.result check is performed on the initial getDtc/getFfd/custom-list/folder/settings paths.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: Static folderInfoList ends with folderNo:2's list, not a merged list. Its length determines how many times the folderNo:1 user path is read, causing duplicate concatenation or no user reads.
A truthy [] skips future folder lookups. Reinitializing the worker instance resets specificFolder but retains the static list; subsequent paths can therefore begin with undefined.
Partial cache/settings/folder mutations are not rolled back on failure.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: optional_additional_predictive_information
ordered_transitions: Inside try, call ecuInfo.isFuncSupported(30,109); if false throw Error, swallowed by catch.

Await getDtc with {ecuId,busId,phaseType,getDtcList:[{getDtcId:30,getDtcDetailList:[{getDtcDetailId:109,option:1}]}]}. Filter optional dtcList to entries whose dtcCode !== undefined; default absent list to [].
Start getFfd for all filtered DTCs through Promise.all(dtcList.map(async ...)), with {ecuId,dtcCode,busId,phaseType,dtcFlag:0,pffNo:dtc.pffNo,vehicleType:dtc.vehicleType}. No sdrNoList field is sent.
Each getFfd rejection is locally converted to a fulfilled error value. Inspect getFfdResponse.resultInfo.result; if !== 0 return from that item.
For successful replies only when vehicle category is not TypeOther, set dtc.timeStampList = dtc.timeStampList ?? response.apiArgs.timeStampList and dtc.ffdList = response.apiArgs.ffdList ?? [].
After Promise.all fulfills, push all filtered DTC objects into cache in their original getDtc order, including TypeOther and per-item nonzero-result cases.
requests: Parallel getFfd per filtered additional DTC
response_errors_results: All outer errors are swallowed and the helper resolves undefined.
A rejected getFfd value with a usable resultInfo.result !== 0 is skipped for enrichment but still appended later.

A malformed rejection/reply without resultInfo can throw in one task; Promise.all rejects and the final push is skipped for the whole batch. Other started tasks are not canceled and can still mutate their DTC objects.
No deduplication against initial DTCs; no explicit result-code check on the additional getDtc reply.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: No cancellation or rollback; support failure suppresses all additional requests.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: cache_persistence_and_view_unit_conversion
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Raw live cache remains distinct from returned display DTCs.
ordered_transitions: createDtcViewData JSON-round-trips dtcList when not undefined, otherwise []; iterates each truthy dtc.ffdList and every FFD.
Create converter with gts.util.createConverter(ffd,unitSetting); set ffd.ConvertUnit=converter.unit without replacing ffd.unit.

For each multiDataList ?? [] entry call converter.convertFunc(multiData.data). Emit only {data,value,valueStr,index,ffdType}; data and valueStr are converted valueStr, value is converted numeric value. All three become undefined when isNaN(converted.value).
Replace multiDataList only if the mapped list has nonzero length. Other FFD/DTC fields survive the JSON clone.

Persistence awaits gts.util.createBuffer('PredictiveFFD',cache.data.ecuInfo.ecuId), assigns model.buffer, awaits buffer.save(model.cache.data), then returns buffer.outputActivityReportForLink(resourceData.linkToTheStoredData).
response_errors_results: Save resolves only after activity-report-link output resolves; save or report failure is rethrown unchanged.
The worker saves raw cached values, not createDtcViewData's converted clone.

JSON cloning has ordinary JSON loss/coercion behavior and can throw. Live init converts inside its chain and masks generic failures through onErrorCommon(); stored conversion rejects through onErrorCommon(reason).
mutations_cleanup_cancel: Each save creates/assigns a buffer; no owned buffer disposal or cache rollback.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: stored_load_translation_and_main_initialization
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: New stored main view/model; worker storedCache separate from live cache.
ordered_transitions: Open loader; send predictive_ffd.getStoredData({storedId}). Worker awaits StoredDataManager.instance.getStoredData(storedId,true).
If cacheData.language === commonInfo.getLanguage(), retain cacheData directly; otherwise await translateStr(cacheData).

Translation builds one paramList and a deferred-dependent serial application chain in traversal order: ECU ecuName/ecuNameId; each DTC name/nameId and divName/divNameId; each FFD name/nameId and unit/unitId; each FFD dispInfo dispName/dispNameId; each DTC timestamp elapsedTimeUnit/elapsedTimeUnitId; each DB custom list customListName/customListNameId. Each request item contains parameterName,id,defaultStr, even when field values are undefined.

Call gtsPFApi.getPFResourceForStored(paramList,cacheData.language); only its fulfillment resolves the deferred with translationStrList. Each queued application calls setTranslateStr(mapping,object,translationStrList), then forwards the same list.
Return original cacheData after applications; assign model.storedCache={data:cacheData.data}. Return ecuInfo, converted DTC clone, DB custom list and user custom list.
Controller sets ECU info, DTC list, DB list, user list, then selected DTC undefined; initializes stored main view and subscribes row selection and next.
Returned controller chain catches inherited onErrorCommon and finally closes loader.
response_errors_results: Stored worker catch(model.onErrorCommon) rejects its received reason; onErrorCommon does not use this.

Translation resource rejection has no rejection handler connecting it to the deferred: application chain remains pending, worker stored load remains pending, and controller finally/loader close is not reached.
setTranslateStr results are assigned to local variables only. Replacement objects are not explicitly written into parents; effective persistence depends on the shared helper's mutation behavior.
User custom-list names are not translated; cacheData.language is not updated.
The stored path assumes data.customList exists; no fallback is provided for missing customList.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: No stored cancellation UI, live acquisition, automatic resave, or health alternative. Stored dispose matches live view/dispatcher/manager cleanup.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: main_to_detail_projection_and_back
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Both controllers and models implement equivalent detail routing/projection.
ordered_transitions:
Main table maps each DTC to {Code:dtc.codeDisp,Description:r_item_i1411 with '
' replaced by newline,Dtc:dtc}; absent/empty list yields one placeholder Code:r_item_i1410.

Main table is single-select. Next starts disabled and is disabled for no selection, placeholder code, missing ffdList, or empty ffdList. A real selected row emits its DTC when rows.length !== 0, even if FFD is empty.
Controller stores evt.args[1]. Next without selected DTC resolves immediately. Otherwise scan timestamps; any index !== 0 selects Detail04, even undefined index. No such timestamp selects Detail03.
Dispose old view, create selected detail view, reset model filter list, analyze DTC, analyze custom lists, initialize view with codeDisp,time columns,rows,management lists.
After view init, apply default custom-group filter, then subscribe back/change/new/remove/manager and, for Detail04 only, graph. Detail row-selection events have no owned controller subscription.

Detail03 has one TimeAxisLabel0 titled '0'+i1538. Each FFD maps to {DispNumber:position,Id:id,Parameter:name or '',Unit:unit or '',Categories:[{patternValue,dispName}],TimeAxisLabel0:i1537}; first multiData.index === 0 replaces the cell with multiData.data, ignoring ffdType.
Detail04 finds first timestamp index === 0. If absent, return without resetting existing time/row/graph state. initScreen04 still analyzes custom lists, so stale projection can be displayed.
Retain timestamps with strict equal keyCycle to base; sort elapsedTime ascending; locate base object by identity. TypeOther uses dynamic time columns; recognized categories use fixed columns.

Create one row per FFD and initialize display/numeric/per-cell-change fields for each time column. Nested multiData/timestamp loops match both index and ffdType; set TimeAxisLabelN=multiData.valueStr and TimeAxisLabelNValue=multiData.value. Later matches overwrite earlier ones, and timestamp positions beyond fixed column count can create extra row properties.

Scan display columns in order using truthiness: absent/falsy display becomes i1537 and clears previous value; a truthy value differing strictly from previous truthy value marks that cell and row variable.
Detail04 variable rows receive gray CSS; changed cells receive brown CSS on render. Classes are added but not explicitly removed by formatters.

Detail back disposes detail, creates a new main view using retained DTCs, and rebinds callbacks; no acquisition or persistence. Selected DTC is not cleared, though new main selection/next UI starts unselected/disabled.
requests: ViewUtil.getView for corresponding main/detail page; no native ECU request on detail navigation/back
response_errors_results: Dynamic kindFlag === 0 times are elapsed differences divided by 1000 only for base elapsedTimeUnitId in [158,74]. Nonzero titles use toFixed(3)+suffix, zero uses '0'+suffix; titleValue is seconds times 1000.
For any other kindFlag, labels are ordinal position minus base position, no unit suffix, titleValue is that ordinal times 1000.
Detail navigation has no added controller catch; view init uses inherited view.onErrorCommon. Back-to-main catches inherited controller.onErrorCommon.
Main row callback's rows.length check is separate from the data.length guard; inconsistent runtime data/rows arrays can cause access errors.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: View disposal empties panes/table, disposes dispatcher, resets local sort counters, hides title and unregisters resize; stored variants additionally remove stored-message span.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: custom_groups_filters_and_manager_editing
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Frontend management list, filters and manager modal; live worker user cache for live OK.
ordered_transitions: Both models derive unique signalDataList from all DTC FFDs by first strict-equal signalId match. DB/user setters intersect pidIdList against these IDs, not only selected-DTC IDs.

analyzeCustomListInfo resets default number to zero. Skip empty pid lists. DB Index is original DB position; user Index is original DB length plus original user position. Build exclusion filters for initial rows whose Id is not in pidIdList.
Map CustomListNameId,CustomListName,DispOrder (default 1000),PidIdList,FilterList; DB entries additionally carry DefaultDispFlag. UserCustomListInfo is false for DB and true for user.

For a DB cusId === 0, set default index only while current default number === 0. Thus an index-zero match leaves the sentinel condition true for later matches. Sort management entries by DispOrder without renumbering Index.
Group change selects matching numeric Index, else []; clearFilter, setFilter, deselect every selected row, disable new/remove, return FilterList and assign model.filterList.

New list with selected rows excludes every initial row whose object reference is not in selectedRowData; setFilter, deselect, disable. Remove concatenates exclusions for selected DispNumbers to existing filters. If no selection both Do routines return undefined, which controller assigns to filterList.
Row selection enables/disables new/remove and emits first Parameter or ''. getKeyword returns all truthy selected rows' Parameter, or undefined.

Manager open receives evt.args[1]. Live first awaits getLatestCutomListUser, sets supported user list and rebuilds management lists; stored opens from current lists directly. Construct manager with commonInfo,all-DTC signals,management list,selected Index.

Manager signalIdSupport writes lowercase pidIdList filtered from uppercase PidIdList, but init/change consume original uppercase PidIdList. Selected-group lookup dereferences [0] without a missing-group guard.

Initialize both source and destination from selected group's supported signals, cloning items into {id,name} lists. Source is not automatically all signals. Bootstrap shown callback creates tables with independent selectedIdList and JSON-cloned noSortData.
Source row selection toggles move-right; destination selection toggles move-left. IDs parsed from first cell become Number unless NaN. Tables render names using innerHTML and title attributes.

Move-left removes selected destination IDs from data/noSortData and clears destination selection. Move-right adds selected source items not already in destination; clears only successfully added source IDs. Move-all-left empties destination; move-all-right adds missing source IDs. Source contents are not removed by moving right.

Update selected count and disable OK when destination empty; live also disables save/export. Changing custom group replaces only source data/noSortData and clears its selection, leaving destination intact.

Manager sort cycles '' -> asc -> desc -> ''. Nonempty directions call DatalistModel.sortParamInfoByName for both lists; empty direction restores deep-cloned noSortData. Sort buttons display resource label plus triangle.

Live OK sends setCustomList with name r_item_i0102 and destination IDs; worker replaces every exact-case name match or pushes {ecuId,customListName,pidIdList}. Then fetch latest supported users, rebuild groups, redraw options and apply matching group or {Index:0}.

Stored OK constructs the same name with stored ecuId, updates user list locally through customListToSaveViewData, rebuilds groups, redraws and applies matching group or {Index:0}. No worker write or stored-data save.
Both OK handlers start a chain without returning it; catch inherited error handler and finally dispose manager. Cancel disposes manager and sets controller.dataManageView=null.
response_errors_results: Latest worker list intersects each cached user pidIdList with unique IDs across raw cache DTC FFDs; omits empty results and returns new {ecuId,customListName,pidIdList} objects without changing cached lists.

Stored customListToSaveViewData checks exact name across all management entries, but updates only matching user entries when a name exists. A collision with a DB-only name can therefore suppress insertion without updating it.

Live model's separate customListToSaveViewData(index,cusInfo), not called by supplied controller flows, mutates an existing management item or appends {CusId:-1,Index:index,CustomListNameId:-1,DispOrder:-1,DefaultDispFlag:0,UserCustomListInfo:false,...}.
Both views' onClickDataManageBtnOK helpers, not called by supplied controllers, reset dropdown to zero and build exclusions by DispNumber equality, unlike the object-identity new-list helper.
getDispDataList, not used in graph-button routing, excludes rows solely by filter.value equality, ignoring filter.field/type; undefined filterList can make it throw.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: OK finally disposes manager but leaves dataManageView non-null; later controller dispose can dispose it again.

Request getFolderInformation({path:root+suffix,includeFileList:['*.cl']}); return uppercase fileName list.

Await writeFile({path,mode,data:JSON.stringify({customListInfo:[targetCustomList]})}); return targetCustomList regardless of native response contents.

response_errors_results: File lookup and write rejection are propagated; no owned catch surrounds save/export controller flow.
The outer method's promise resolves after opening the first dialog, not after its button chain/save. Nested dialog promises are not returned into that outer chain; failures there are detached.
Overwrite confirmation affects whether save runs, not worker mode directly; worker independently determines mode from cache/isExport.
Export can mutate an existing cached user list even though new exports are not added. Write failure does not roll back mutation/push.
User listing's numeric-coerced ECU path differs from user writing's original ECU string path.
DL009 additionally defines getCustomListName() returning undefined, but the controller uses getText(). No success dialog is shown.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: graph_projection_callbacks_reentry_and_known_faults
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Graph data uses display-row positions, not native signal IDs.
ordered_transitions: Detail04 graph click gets getData(true); empty list returns without event. Otherwise emit graphBtn with active displayed rows.

Controller disposes detail and creates Detail05 before checking selected DTC. If none, resolve leaving the new graph view uninitialized. Otherwise store evt.args[1], await graph-view init, set current time index to base position.

Model graph titles, prepared during Detail04 analysis, carry {categories,defaultIndex:DispNumber,id:DispNumber,name,selected:false,unit,value:last numeric column}. Original series carry per time column {categories,defaultIndex,id,name,selected:false,unit,time:titleValue,frame,value,valueStr}. Missing first numeric value becomes 0; later missing values remain undefined and unit becomes ''. Display valueStr is string concatenation of table display value.

For each active row in its current order, scan original titles and series for matching DispNumber/id. Mutate matching title id/defaultIndex to compact position; mutate all series point ids to position and defaultData to position, not defaultIndex. Push original references, not clones; no break terminates scans.
Set graphRowData and displayedParamInfo to same series array. Pass compact title subset,series,base index to setParameterInfoList.
View builds 300px data cards from series[current index], writes tag=row DOM ID onto that point, marks selected title rows, then calls showGraph.

initView creates a StaticGraph; showGraph replaces it with another StaticGraph without disposing the first. Attach StaticGraph DROP_ITEM/REMOVE_GRAPH callbacks, init graph, bind graph table-row events, then emit CHANGE_SHOWN_PARAM before controller adds its graph callbacks.

Only after setParameterInfoList returns, bind graph back to onClickNextBtn, plus flag/drop/select/clear/change/steps. Back reanalyzes the selected DTC and restores default group, losing the prior filter/sort state.

StaticGraph drop/remove callbacks emit CHANGE_SHOWN_PARAM. Controller obtains nested plot ID lists, flattens them, destructively splices matching series out of displayedParamInfo, marks their points selected, appends unshown series with points selected=false, and replaces displayedParamInfo with selected-first order; update card display at current index.

Step view handlers call graph.goNextFrame/goPrevFrame first, then emit controller event. Controller adjusts index and calls updateViewData only if it changed. updateViewData refreshes cards and adds red T1,T2,... lines using each series[current index].recordTime, a field not produced by the model.

Flag click requires nonempty plot-items outer array and not isEditFlagMode; controller calls onClickFlag(current column.titleValue), setting edit mode true, opacity .3 and adding an unnamed blue millisecond vertical line. No owned exit from edit mode or flag-count increment. drawFlag helper adds a named blue line.
Card hide/show toggles graph width between window width minus 40 and minus 380 and updates icon/title resources; resize sets both panel heights and matching width.

Select-item handler reads evt.detail.args[1] and indexes the full model graphRowTitleData by compact id. Clear selection sets selected=false on series arrays themselves, not their points or graph titles.

Drag/drop helper always reports canDrop:true; parses table numbers from parent div IDs, emits DROP_ITEM then resets sort directions to 'default'. Controller calls model.sortByDnD(dropInfo) and passes the getTimeAxisLabelIndex function object, not its result, to updateDisplayParamInfo.

Card updates add selected='selected' when true but do not remove it when false; schedule graphPanel.redrawRowColor via setTimeout(0). Dispose disposes only the current graph instance, empties panes, hides title/functions/status, unregisters resize.
requests: StaticGraph API calls and ViewUtil.getView only; no native ECU acquisition
response_errors_results: forwardTimeAxisLabelIndex increments while index !== length, permitting index==length, one beyond last valid column. Subsequent card/flag access can throw. Back only guards zero.
sortByDnD has no owned implementation in either supplied model. Any inherited implementation is a framework handoff; the erroneous function-valued time index remains regardless.

Graph ID remapping mutates original arrays during nested scans and can cause later matching collisions or selection-to-title mismatches. Full graphRowTitleData is not replaced with the compact subset.

adjustGraphDataList exists in both models but is not called by owned workflows: it linearly fills bounded undefined-value gaps when time difference is nonzero and holds previous value through trailing gaps. Leading undefined gaps can access index -1; ordinary generated first points are forced to zero.
drawViewPane(selectViewData) calls setParameterInfoList with only one argument although the latter requires title data,series,time index; not called by supplied controllers.
Deferred redraw callback has no disposed-state check and may run after graphPanel becomes null.
View declares changeTableDisp/deleteFlag/editFlagComment event names but owned code does not emit them. Table-display toggle acts locally.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: No graph persistence, native cancellation or flag-save path. Stored graph behavior retains the same faults, including references to PredictiveFFDModel.SortDirection in its drop helper.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: sorting_service_information_help_and_view_lifecycle

Main pages are live s31200_02 and stored s31200_06; Detail03 pages _03/_07; Detail04 _04/_08; Detail05 _05/_09. Manager pages are s31200_manager.html and s31200_stored_manager.html.

All view initialization awaits ViewUtil.getView(page,id), appends relevant pane children, draws resources/icon titles, initializes local widgets/events and triggers resize; catches inherited view.onErrorCommon.

mutations_cleanup_cancel: No owned service-info cancellation interpretation beyond inherited dialog promise behavior.

generation_oem_contract.other: TypeOther for every value not strictly included in those lists, including undefined and numeric strings. Category checks run Phase6HV, MG, RearMG, then Other.

generation_oem_contract.phase_passthrough: ECU phaseType and busId are forwarded in DTC/FFD native requests. PredictiveFFDController.phaseType.PHASE4=4 is declared but unused. There is no separate PHASE_5=20, PHASE_6=22, SUBARU_OEM=52, MAZDA_OEM=21, DAIHATSU_UDS=84 or SUZUKI_P5=116 branch.
