generation_oem_contract.oem_dispatch: No actual Subaru dispatch call exists here; any dedicated Subaru frontend dispatch is owned by parent menus.sources.gts.js.gts.img_ope_ddr_sbr, not inferred from phase values.
generation_oem_contract.unreferenced_shared_enums: RoB.TARGET, availability, destination, ExecuteGenWebService method/content type and ImgOpeDdr.prevFunction do not drive any supplied family call.

results_persistence_and_ui_contract.live_result: {dtcList:converted JSON clone,dbCustomListInfo,userCustomListInfo}; DTC failures may instead fulfill {code,detailCode,isDtcError:true}.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.raw_persistence: Live acquisition automatically saves raw cache.data before exposing a new main view, then outputs an activity-report link. Stored reading and manager edits have no automatic diagnostic-data resave.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.custom_file_projection: writeFile data is JSON {customListInfo:[{ecuId,customListName,pidIdList}]}; imported .cl files concatenate their customListInfo without schema validation.
results_persistence_and_ui_contract.display_unit_behavior: Converter exposes ConvertUnit, while model table rows use ffd.unit. Preserve that distinction rather than replacing table units with ConvertUnit.

results_persistence_and_ui_contract.cleanup_limits: No explicit Tabulator destroy, cancellation of pending requests/timers, buffer disposal, worker cache reset, or dialog cleanup is called by controller dispose.

family.analysis_mode: Static, inert analysis of every supplied full member body; no execution, tests, native behavior, or inferred calls.
family.purpose: Authenticated frontend for reading operation/image FFD and DDR, producing VDAS files, converting existing VDAS files to CSV, and opening configured external viewers/folders/URLs.
family.owned_chain: ImgOpeDdrController -> ImgOpeDdrModel -> ImgOpeDdrWorkerApi -> GtsWorkerApi.send -> ImgOpeDdrWorkerModel command handler -> GtsPFApi; results return to controller and view callbacks.
scope_limits: No owned health-check entry, StoredDataManager workflow, report projection, print, graph, translation API, inherited Datalist, custom-list persistence, or buffer workflow occurs in these members.
The existing-file alternative is native VDAS-folder enumeration and conversion, not a stored_data/report workflow.
Authentication is an enclosing-framework condition; these members do not perform login or authentication checks.
No actual dedicated Subaru frontend dispatch occurs in these bodies. The SBR branch invokes a native dialog utility or reports no support; it does not instantiate img_ope_ddr_sbr.

entry_points.inputs: prevFunction === 1 means Home; optional param.triggerId defaults to ''.
entry_points.effects: Creates model, initial view, common-dialog owner and activity report; requests initialization and chooses SBR/TOS/read-or-convert/description paths.
Stores all three arguments and binds 15 img_ope_ddr.* command handlers to (model,param). ecuCache and commandThread are not subsequently used by the supplied feature bodies.

entry_points.transport: Each ImgOpeDdrWorkerApi method returns this.api.send(the identically named command,param), without response transformation or catch. Framework supplies worker param.parameter wrapping.

entry_points.contract: Controller binds controller as the first callback argument. Payload-bearing handlers read evt.args[1]. EstimatedTime Next instead binds its read-time result before the event argument; its handler intentionally treats its second argument as the bound result.

entry_points.effects: createHelpInfoUrl(commonInfo,'17_pcs_data/index.html'), then window.open(url,'_blank'); no registration of this method is present here.

controller.history: pushCurrentView suppresses only adjacent duplicate screen names. Back pops current then previous and reinitializes only CheckList, CmcList, NoFfd, NoImageData, ChooseProcess or CreateCsv; any other name rejects. Reinitialization pushes the selected screen again and resets that view's DOM defaults.
controller.reentry: init creates a new model and resets aduParam, but does not explicitly reset preViewList, isInterruption or interruptionDialog.
controller.init_callback_bug: The normal-function initialization .then writes this.isSHA256Available, not controller.isSHA256Available. Receiver depends on runtime function-call semantics; routing nevertheless uses result.isSHA256Available.

model.camera_display_state: setDispCameraList replaces the local object and resolves; getDispCameraList returns it directly.
model.cancel_state: executeCreateVdasFile creates a new gts.util.createCancelKey(); executeInterruption uses the currently stored key.
model.wrapping: Most methods forward their input unchanged. Other wrappers build exactly the named payload fields described by the workflows.

worker_cache.reset_point: getInitViewData replaces model.cache with {data:...}; other commands assume initialization has completed.
worker_cache.accumulation: Repeated non-skip pattern requests do not clear availability, paramEcuInfoList, DDR/key-cycle/elapsed/P6 arrays or timestamp-mode success flags. Availability can remain true after a later response no longer advertises it. paramEcuInfoList is pushed, yet optional funcIdList is assigned using the current response index rather than the newly appended index.

input_and_state_contract.native_response_shape: Native success handlers consume response.apiArgs. Cancellable requests may first return {cancelId,response}, where response is then returned into the promise chain; final response.resultInfo.cancel is checked. Rejected responses are not normalized by this feature.
input_and_state_contract.error_layers: Worker onErrorCommon returns Promise.reject(response). Controller onErrorCommon closes loader and calls showCommonErrorDialog but returns no promise. Most controller catches therefore swallow into undefined after scheduling a dialog. Dialog buttonPressed chains are generally neither returned nor caught.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: initialize_and_route
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: New initial view and model; worker cache reset; loader displayed.
ordered_transitions: Log title, initialize s32401_015, draw view/control panes, register immediate Exit -> backPreviousScreen.
model.getInitViewData({isPrevFunctionHome}) -> worker API -> command.
Worker requests permission, then PC-common setting batch, then distributor-common batch, then user-type batch. Each batch uses Promise.all; batches are serial.
Call isPcsSbrVehicle({ecuId:729}); rejection is swallowed, leaving isSbrVehicle=false.
If not SBR: serial cancelAutoPowerOff for 454,6034,6534, swallowing each failure; get folder 1; get folder 4; delete temporary log wildcard, swallowing deletion failure; determine TOS and VIN.
If SBR, skip all power-off/folder/delete/TOS/VIN work.
Construct initialization result; any unswallowed error rejects.
Controller SBR: if distributor region is 1 or 3, start executeDialogUtility in a detached inner chain; on success close loader and leave. Otherwise show no-support dialog.
Non-SBR with TOS: require isGotVin, then ConsentForm; otherwise no-VIN dialog. Non-TOS: SHA256 available -> ChooseProcess; otherwise Description.
Consent Next logs agreement, queries cached SHA256 availability and selects ChooseProcess or Description. Consent URL is optional and does not gate checkbox agreement.
response_errors_results: Setting apiArgs.fileData is passed to gts.util.parseSettingResponse; cache keys are comma-joined keyList arrays.
Distributor screen/viewer/timestamp availability and language are copied directly from commonInfo; timestamp mode requires exactly 1.
folderInfoList defaults []; only matching folderNo entries assign paths. VDAS folder appends '\\'; GTS folder does not.
SBR means sbrVehicleFlag !== 0, including undefined.
isGotVin becomes true on Home regardless of VIN; otherwise Boolean(commonInfo.getVIN()), only in non-SBR branch.
Return fields: isDisplayTOS,isGotVin,isSHA256Available,isReadyConsentFormUrl,isSbrVehicle,isDisplayDialogUtility. Consent URL readiness directly accesses .length and may throw.
SHA256 requires exactly 1; dialog-utility visibility uses distributor region 1/3, while its function ID uses separately loaded vehicleDBRegion.
Permission/settings/folder/utility failures propagate through worker; controller displays common error. Utility routing does not return the inner utility promise.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Initial Exit does not cancel initialization. A late initialization response can still attempt routing after view disposal. No cancellation guard exists here.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: discover_functions_timestamps_and_display_patterns
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Selected lists are replaced with supplied values or []; aduOperationFFDReadFlag becomes isReadOpeFfd?1:0 on every request.
ordered_transitions: Description Next sends {isSkipGetPcsFuncList:false,selectedKeyCycleList:[]}.
Non-skip: getPcsFunctionList(); cache ECU/security information and run availability judges in order FCM(TSS3),CSP,PCS,FCM,LCS,PVM,RC,DMC,ADS,Airbag, then ADU P6 judge.

If Airbag_P6 or ADU available: serial getAduDdr(case-info), then P6 getDdr(case-info). If either corresponding key-cycle and elapsed arrays are nonempty, set isGetP6TimeStamp=true and serial getAbsoluteTime -> getImageFfdStorageList if ADU_FFD -> delete logs -> no-op getDateTimeLocale -> createTimeStamp.

Else, if timestamp mode and ADS available: serial optional legacy Airbag getDdr(case-info) -> getAdsFfd(targetTrigger:1); if local key-cycle array has length, set isGetTimeStamp=true and serial getAbsoluteTime -> delete logs -> no-op locale step -> createTimeStamp.
After the above, getImageSpecInfo iff skip is true OR neither cached timestamp-success flag is true.
Serial pure transformations: judge availability pattern -> FRC -> CMC -> ADC -> RC -> DMC -> ADU FRC/CMC -> ADU DMC -> stored-display booleans -> P6 display rows.
Initial controller routing prioritizes P6List, then AdsKeyCycle, then stored-display alternatives. Subsequent skip responses bypass timestamp screens and route directly by stored booleans.

requests.P6_addition: dtcCodeList included only if cached ADU dtcCodeList.length>0

response_errors_results: getPcsFunctionList rejection propagates. Its ecuInfoList/securityAccessInfoList default []; param ECU projection includes ecuId,connect,busId,phaseType and optional funcIdList.
All case-info DDR/ADS, absolute-time, storage-list, image-spec and temporary-delete failures are swallowed.

ADU/P6 DDR lists default []; each record is mutated with isAdu=true/false and appended. Truthy keyCycle values are concatenated into local and cached lists; elapsedTimeList[0] is concatenated only when the list has positive length. ADU response replaces dtcCodeList with response list or [].
ADS keyCycleList is concatenated without defaulting, so undefined can become an array element.

Absolute timestamps default []; for each local key cycle choose first strict key match and convertLocaleTime, otherwise '-'; Map deduplicates by key cycle and final sort uses a.keyCycle < b.keyCycle ? -1 : 1.
Storage response maps memoryAreaList/imageSpecInfo, memoryAreaAduPvmList/imageSpecInfoAduPvm, memoryAreaAduDmcList/imageSpecInfoAduDmc to local variables, lists default [].
Image-spec success replaces cache FCM/PVM/RC/DMC from imageSpecInfo/imageSpecInfoPvm/imageSpecInfoRc/imageSpecInfoDmc and clears isGetImageSpecInfoError; failure preserves old values.

P6 row validity computes all six invalidAbsTimeStampInfo fields before checking field presence. A row is excluded iff all invalidKeyCycle, invalidElapsedTimeList[0], invalidClockType are nonzero AND absolute time is invalid, OR triggerList[0] is ''.

Valid absolute time maps year/month/day/hour/minute/second to gpsTime* fields and calls convertLocaleTime(timeStampInfo,new Date().getTimezoneOffset()*60000*-1,[158,74]). Otherwise it finds cached timestamp by strict equality against the record keyCycle and dereferences timeStamp.date without checking a match.

P6 row fields: keyCycle, converted dispKeyCycle or '-', elapsedTime=elapsedTimeList[0], converted dispElapsedTime or '-', clock from getPatternFunc(clockType.dispInfoList)(clockType.data), timeDate, triggerName=triggerList[0], isImage, triggerId={upper:first upper ID,lower:first lower ID}, isAdu. Clock value 0 displays '-'; invalid clock displays ''.

isImage ORs FCM/PVM/DMC trigger matches using Ddr.imageMap[22][function-51 ECU][imageType][spec]. image types are 'imageSpecInfo','imageSpecInfoAduPvm','memoryAreaAduDmc'. Only truthy specs are checked. Stored-area mapping entries are iterated; upper-only triggers compare upper, upper-lower compare both after parseInt. Missing map entries can throw.
P6 rows are sorted after each loop iteration using the same nonzero equality comparator.

Return: isStoredDdr,isStoredOperationFfd,isStoredImageFfd, all seven display lists,isGetTimeStamp,timeStampList,isGetP6TimeStamp,dispList,isP6AduDdrGot. isP6AduDdrGot is local and returns false on skip requests even if cached ADU records exist.
mutations_cleanup_cancel: Controller initially stores result.isP6AduDdrGot in aduParam.
P6 view initialization queries getIsAduAvailable twice, serially, once before control setup and once before table setup; it actually means ADU_FFD availability.
ADS Next passes selected key cycles with skip=true. P6 Next passes selectedList and isReadOpeFfd with skip=true.
On stored image route, controller replaces model display camera lists; P6 route additionally stores selectedList in controller.aduParam. Other P6 routes do not update that controller list.
Repeated discovery can accumulate duplicate cached records and stale timestamp flags. Skip always refreshes image specs but performs no case-info retrieval.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: camera_trigger_and_direction_selection
guarded_ordered_workflows.inputs: Seven camera display lists, controller.selectTriggerId, aduParam and selected table rows.
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: Each new checklist recreates tables and selection defaults; no selection restoration from worker.
ordered_transitions: For every nonempty display list, create a Tabulator table with resource-rendered dataName/detail, id equal to original display-list index and value from the static table.
Find trigger-string matches across each list; the last matching row index wins. Empty selectTriggerId selects all rows; otherwise select the one matching row if any.

ADU combined/DMC tables additionally retain rows only if no P6 ADU data was obtained, or selectedP6DataList is empty, or an isAdu selected record matches one of the row's numeric upper/optional lower trigger IDs.
Next reads selected data only from displayed tables and emits all seven selected-list properties.

Controller concatenates values, flattening scalar/array values one level and preserving order/duplicates: FRC and ADU combined -> selectMemoryAreaList; CMC and the same ADU combined -> selectMemoryAreaPvmList; ADC -> Ads; RC -> Rc; DMC and ADU DMC -> Dmc.
Await setCameraList. If PVM list empty, estimate immediately; otherwise open CmcList.
CmcList initializes all four directions checked. Next calls setCmcDirection(getChoosedCameraType()) without await, then immediately requests read time.
response_errors_results: Worker setCameraList assigns all five array references and resolves. setCmcDirection assigns the list and returns undefined.
No checklist rule requires any selected image row before Next.
CmcList checkbox changes disable Next and add v_img_ope_ddr_button_disabled iff all directions are unchecked.
Unawaited direction transport may race the estimate command; no owned synchronization or catch is attached to it.
ADU selected-row IDs remain original indices even after filtering.
guarded_ordered_workflows.mutations_cleanup_cancel: Worker arrays persist until replaced or initialization resets cache. Back navigation recreates checklists and direction defaults rather than restoring prior choices.

guarded_ordered_workflows.name: estimate_and_validate_readable_data
guarded_ordered_workflows.entry: Checklist without PVM; CmcList Next; NoFfd Next; NoImageData Next
guarded_ordered_workflows.inputs: Cached ECU projection, selected image areas/directions, selected P6/key cycles and availability.
guarded_ordered_workflows.state: readTime=0; isStoredData=false; isCheckedImageData is recalculated from sum of all five selected memory-area lengths.
ordered_transitions: Show loader/read-time loader. Existing loader is reused, so a generic loader already present is not replaced by read-time text.
Request getPcsReadTime once.
On success calculate time, copy all returned read flags, derive isStoredData.
Return {isStoredData,readTime}; true opens EstimatedTime, false opens no-valid-data dialog whose OK leaves the feature.
EstimatedTime Next passes its bound readTime object into Reading; Back uses history rules.

payload.selectList: Only if selectedP6DataList nonempty; every row maps to {keyCycle,elapsedTime,triggerIdUpper:triggerId.upper,triggerIdLower:triggerId.lower}, without isAdu filtering.

response_errors_results: If no Airbag_P6/ADU, timestamp mode true and cached timestamp list nonempty: count each selected key cycle's occurrences in DDR and ADS cached lists. If DDR exists and FCM spec<=4, add readTime-adsReadTime unscaled; otherwise multiply that component by DDR selected-match count / DDR length. Add adsReadTime * ADS selected-match count / ADS length when ADS exists. Ceil total.

typed_handoffs.input_boundary: Per-function saved diagnostic logs/hex data; acquired from native plugins through current SourceQualified CommFrameCtrl. Managed parsers do not send UDS/KWP/CAN frames.
typed_handoffs.native_join_readiness: Use only named closed contracts and their exact-source proof. RecorderNative aggregate remains explicitly incomplete; no 58-unit completion inferred. TSS3 AB11/12/13 acquires/logs wire groups but emits only DID0501 keycycle metadata in result list; viewer owns payload dictionary. Main GPS native plugin emits availability plus six raw calendar PID values, not UTC/host timezone conversion.
typed_handoffs.result_boundary: Logs admitted independently asASCIIhex+CRLF, malformed or partiallog can yield familywarnings/partialimages; acquisition result/protocol status remainsnativeowner.
typed_handoffs.log_rollback: Main provider TransportProtocols.main.CCommFrameCtrl.SetCommLogFilePointer.10038d50 performs SetFilePointer(FILE_BEGIN) then SetEndOfFile; either failure returns0x90020706.
typed_handoffs.DMC_bulk_boundary: AB33+BE16/BE32 requests six datasets per accepted capture. Opaque image payloads are only in communication log; result20 exposes dataset1 DID0501 BE16 trip. Rejected captures request checkpoint seek and truncation; per-record read/decode/cancel errors suppress to0, descriptor errors fatal. Concrete entry DDR-header composition remains owner11 work.
typed_handoffs.PCS_header_boundary: Rawheaders IDs4/5/F/10/11/1E/1F only in communication log. FileCopy10to11 requires1 else90020706. Only decoded CCmdString20 is VIN from selectors86/103/11E RX3.. via ANSI CP_ACP to UTF16; later fallback overwrites prior VIN and output is not reset. Native unbounded256byte stack copy and partial255 memset are native behavior, not managed parser policy. J1979Set(0,0) is attempted, not proof accepted mutation.
typed_handoffs.RoBP6_boundary: UserDefinedDTC IDs11/12/13 carry requested FLAGMASKS, not record counts; last duplicate wins. Generic AB8 BehaviorDataRecordList retains raw BCD calendar fields, while dedicated calendar FFDs328/3D8/488/538/5E8/698 contain converted decimal. Preserve FFD.type44=4, its buffer and MultiData.tag1C=0 for type4 extraction. Expanded frames with soft detail status10 still append partially filled. A004020B means no effective request, not no behavior records. Accepted NRC31 clears RX/status0, sets effectiveFlag1 and may return0/empty. Native display prefix is XP/XC/XB/XU plus6HEX(rawDTC&0x3FFFFF), not full24-bit or low8-bit formatting.

typed_handoffs.request_response: TypedUTF8 JSON command+result fields/IDs and per-entry signatures in viewer API contract; host CN/LN/IF/UP dispatch behavior remainsPlatformSession.
typed_handoffs.host_transport_delivery: Host targetSend awaits FleckSend task; broadcasts discard individual FleckSend tasks and await component iteration only. Broadcast completion is not delivery proof; this does not change client wrapper receive/default semantics.
typed_handoffs.host_ordering: CN000001 binds exactGUIName and clamps MaxNum to16. CN000002 creates/stores challenge perSessionID through Security AuthenticationManagerWrapper.CreateChallengeCode; CN000003 CheckAuthentication writes ApiAuthentication. This is not licence,diagnosis or mutex proof. LN/UP dispatch to queue6 webservice worker; IF exceptIF000004 dispatches queue2. LN000004/IF000012 service semantics join adapter-manager settings/native serializers,not an observed liveendpoint.
typed_handoffs.error_cancel: Client receivesnextone response;missing/invalidResultInfo caught todefaults atwrapperlevel; connectCTS100seconds only, Send/Receive CancellationToken.None.

typed_handoffs.interface: Savedhistory/report web actions are notimplementedby this offlineviewer; typed container imports/export paths belongchild graph+CSV contracts. No inference from commonbasename or extension.

typed_handoffs.interface: Three distinct formats: managed template RingBufferParser saved TSE, native DatMon versioned tables/ring memory serialization, and native CommandDataLib/FileManager DRS outer/row serialization. No cross-format equivalence by basename, timestamp width, table count or shared CCmd type.

closed_DatMon.format: LE numeric widths, packed unaligned fields; native ring 38-byte header, first4 timestamp bytes, mode1 serialDelta adjustment; frame serialization256 slots for BOTH products despite main runtime1024.
